1.arabicText: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ۝١ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ ۝٢
1.transliteration: Bismillaahir Rahmaanir Raheem (1) Alhamdu lillaahi Rabbil 'aalameen (2)
1.translationEn: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. [1] [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds - [2]

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
ayahs.transliteration: Bismillaahir Rahmaanir Raheem
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

ayahs.arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahi Rabbil 'aalameen
ayahs.translation: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds -

2.translationEn: The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful, [3] Sovereign of the Day of Recompense. [4]

ayahs.arabic: ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
ayahs.transliteration: Ar-Rahmaanir-Raheem
ayahs.translation: The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,

ayahs.arabic: مَٰلِكِ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Maaliki Yawmid-Deen
ayahs.translation: Sovereign of the Day of Recompense.

3.translationEn: It is You we worship and You we ask for help. [5]

ayahs.arabic: إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ
ayahs.transliteration: Iyyaaka na'budu wa lyyaaka nasta'een
ayahs.translation: It is You we worship and You we ask for help.

4.translationEn: Guide us to the straight path - [6]

ayahs.arabic: ٱهْدِنَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
ayahs.transliteration: Ihdinas-Siraatal-Mustaqeem
ayahs.translation: Guide us to the straight path -

5.arabicText: صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ ۝٧
5.translationEn: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray. [7]

ayahs.arabic: صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Siraatal-lazeena an'amta 'alaihim ghayril-maghdoobi 'alaihim wa lad-daaalleen
ayahs.translation: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray.

6.arabicText: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ۝١ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ ۝٢ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ۝٣ مَٰلِكِ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ ۝٤
6.transliteration: Bismillaahir Rahmaanir Raheem (1) Alhamdu lillaahi Rabbil 'aalameen (2) Ar-Rahmaanir-Raheem (3) Maaliki Yawmid-Deen (4)
6.translationEn: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. [1] [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds - [2] The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful, [3] Sovereign of the Day of Recompense. [4]

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
ayahs.transliteration: Bismillaahir Rahmaanir Raheem
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

ayahs.arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahi Rabbil 'aalameen
ayahs.translation: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds -

ayahs.arabic: ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
ayahs.transliteration: Ar-Rahmaanir-Raheem
ayahs.translation: The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,

ayahs.arabic: مَٰلِكِ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Maaliki Yawmid-Deen
ayahs.translation: Sovereign of the Day of Recompense.

7.arabicText: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ۝١ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ ۝٢ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ۝٣ مَٰلِكِ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ ۝٤ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ ۝٥ ٱهْدِنَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ ۝٦ صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ ۝٧
7.transliteration: Bismillaahir Rahmaanir Raheem (1) Alhamdu lillaahi Rabbil 'aalameen (2) Ar-Rahmaanir-Raheem (3) Maaliki Yawmid-Deen (4) Iyyaaka na'budu wa lyyaaka nasta'een (5) Ihdinas-Siraatal-Mustaqeem (6) Siraatal-lazeena an'amta 'alaihim ghayril-maghdoobi 'alaihim wa lad-daaalleen (7)
7.translationEn: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. [1] [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds - [2] The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful, [3] Sovereign of the Day of Recompense. [4] It is You we worship and You we ask for help. [5] Guide us to the straight path - [6] The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray. [7]

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
ayahs.transliteration: Bismillaahir Rahmaanir Raheem
ayahs.translation: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

ayahs.arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahi Rabbil 'aalameen
ayahs.translation: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds -

ayahs.arabic: ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
ayahs.transliteration: Ar-Rahmaanir-Raheem
ayahs.translation: The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,

ayahs.arabic: مَٰلِكِ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Maaliki Yawmid-Deen
ayahs.translation: Sovereign of the Day of Recompense.

ayahs.arabic: إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ
ayahs.transliteration: Iyyaaka na'budu wa lyyaaka nasta'een
ayahs.translation: It is You we worship and You we ask for help.

ayahs.arabic: ٱهْدِنَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
ayahs.transliteration: Ihdinas-Siraatal-Mustaqeem
ayahs.translation: Guide us to the straight path -

ayahs.arabic: صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Siraatal-lazeena an'amta 'alaihim ghayril-maghdoobi 'alaihim wa lad-daaalleen
ayahs.translation: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray.

8.arabicText: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝١ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ ۝٢ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝٣ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ ۝٤
8.transliteration: Qul huwal laahu ahad (1) Allah hus-samad (2) Lam yalid wa lam yoolad (3) Wa lam yakul-lahu kufuwan ahad (4)
8.translationEn: Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One, [1] Allah, the Eternal Refuge. [2] He neither begets nor is born, [3] Nor is there to Him any equivalent." [4]

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
ayahs.transliteration: Qul huwal laahu ahad
ayahs.translation: Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One,

ayahs.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ
ayahs.transliteration: Allah hus-samad
ayahs.translation: Allah, the Eternal Refuge.

ayahs.arabic: لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
ayahs.transliteration: Lam yalid wa lam yoolad
ayahs.translation: He neither begets nor is born,

ayahs.arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa lam yakul-lahu kufuwan ahad
ayahs.translation: Nor is there to Him any equivalent."

9.arabicText: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ ۝١ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝٢ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝٣
9.transliteration: Qul a'uzoo bi rabbil-falaq (1) Min sharri ma khalaq (2) Wa min sharri ghasiqin iza waqab (3)
9.translationEn: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak [1] From the evil of that which He created [2] And from the evil of darkness when it settles [3]

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ
ayahs.transliteration: Qul a'uzoo bi rabbil-falaq
ayahs.translation: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak

ayahs.arabic: مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
ayahs.transliteration: Min sharri ma khalaq
ayahs.translation: From the evil of that which He created

ayahs.arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa min sharri ghasiqin iza waqab
ayahs.translation: And from the evil of darkness when it settles

10.arabicText: وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ ۝٤ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ۝٥
10.transliteration: Wa min sharrin-naffaa-thaati fil 'uqad (4) Wa min shar ri haasidin iza hasad (5)
10.translationEn: And from the evil of the blowers in knots [4] And from the evil of an envier when he envies." [5]

ayahs.arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa min sharrin-naffaa-thaati fil 'uqad
ayahs.translation: And from the evil of the blowers in knots

ayahs.arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa min shar ri haasidin iza hasad
ayahs.translation: And from the evil of an envier when he envies."

11.arabicText: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ ۝١ مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ ۝٢ إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ ۝٣
11.transliteration: Qul a'uzu birabbin naas (1) Malikin naas (2) Ilaahin naas (3)
11.translationEn: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, [1] The Sovereign of mankind. [2] The God of mankind, [3]

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.transliteration: Qul a'uzu birabbin naas
ayahs.translation: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,

ayahs.arabic: مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.transliteration: Malikin naas
ayahs.translation: The Sovereign of mankind.

ayahs.arabic: إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.transliteration: Ilaahin naas
ayahs.translation: The God of mankind,

12.arabicText: مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ ۝٤ ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ ۝٥ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ ۝٦
12.transliteration: Min sharril was waasil khannaas (4) Al lazee yuwas wisu fee sudoorin naas (5) Minal jinnati wan naas (6)
12.translationEn: From the evil of the retreating whisperer - [4] Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind - [5] From among the jinn and mankind." [6]

ayahs.arabic: مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ
ayahs.transliteration: Min sharril was waasil khannaas
ayahs.translation: From the evil of the retreating whisperer -

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.transliteration: Al lazee yuwas wisu fee sudoorin naas
ayahs.translation: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -

ayahs.arabic: مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.transliteration: Minal jinnati wan naas
ayahs.translation: From among the jinn and mankind."

13.arabicText: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝١ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ ۝٢ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝٣ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ ۝٤
13.transliteration: Qul huwal laahu ahad (1) Allah hus-samad (2) Lam yalid wa lam yoolad (3) Wa lam yakul-lahu kufuwan ahad (4)
13.translationEn: Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One, [1] Allah, the Eternal Refuge. [2] He neither begets nor is born, [3] Nor is there to Him any equivalent." [4]

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
ayahs.transliteration: Qul huwal laahu ahad
ayahs.translation: Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One,

ayahs.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ
ayahs.transliteration: Allah hus-samad
ayahs.translation: Allah, the Eternal Refuge.

ayahs.arabic: لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
ayahs.transliteration: Lam yalid wa lam yoolad
ayahs.translation: He neither begets nor is born,

ayahs.arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa lam yakul-lahu kufuwan ahad
ayahs.translation: Nor is there to Him any equivalent."

14.arabicText: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ ۝١ مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ ۝٢ إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ ۝٣ مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ ۝٤ ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ ۝٥ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ ۝٦
14.transliteration: Qul a'uzu birabbin naas (1) Malikin naas (2) Ilaahin naas (3) Min sharril was waasil khannaas (4) Al lazee yuwas wisu fee sudoorin naas (5) Minal jinnati wan naas (6)
14.translationEn: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, [1] The Sovereign of mankind. [2] The God of mankind, [3] From the evil of the retreating whisperer - [4] Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind - [5] From among the jinn and mankind." [6]

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.transliteration: Qul a'uzu birabbin naas
ayahs.translation: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,

ayahs.arabic: مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.transliteration: Malikin naas
ayahs.translation: The Sovereign of mankind.

ayahs.arabic: إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.transliteration: Ilaahin naas
ayahs.translation: The God of mankind,

ayahs.arabic: مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ
ayahs.transliteration: Min sharril was waasil khannaas
ayahs.translation: From the evil of the retreating whisperer -

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.transliteration: Al lazee yuwas wisu fee sudoorin naas
ayahs.translation: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -

ayahs.arabic: مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.transliteration: Minal jinnati wan naas
ayahs.translation: From among the jinn and mankind."

15.arabicText: إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ ۝١ فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ ۝٢ إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ ۝٣
15.transliteration: Innaa a'taina kal kauthar (1) Fa salli li rabbika wanhar (2) Inna shani-aka huwal abtar (3)
15.translationEn: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar. [1] So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone]. [2] Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off. [3]

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa a'taina kal kauthar
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar.

ayahs.arabic: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa salli li rabbika wanhar
ayahs.translation: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ
ayahs.transliteration: Inna shani-aka huwal abtar
ayahs.translation: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.

16.arabicText: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ ۝١ فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ ۝٢ وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ ۝٣
16.transliteration: Ara-aital lazee yu kazzibu bid deen (1) Fa zaalikal lazi yadu'ul-yateem (2) Wa la ya huddu 'alaa ta'amil miskeen (3)
16.translationEn: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense? [1] For that is the one who drives away the orphan [2] And does not encourage the feeding of the poor. [3]

ayahs.arabic: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Ara-aital lazee yu kazzibu bid deen
ayahs.translation: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?

ayahs.arabic: فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa zaalikal lazi yadu'ul-yateem
ayahs.translation: For that is the one who drives away the orphan

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa la ya huddu 'alaa ta'amil miskeen
ayahs.translation: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.

17.arabicText: فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ ۝٤ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ ۝٥ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ ۝٦ وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ ۝٧
17.transliteration: Fa wai lul-lil mu salleen (4) Al lazeena hum 'an salaatihim sahoon (5) Al lazeena hum yuraa-oon (6) Wa yamna'oonal ma'oon (7)
17.translationEn: So woe to those who pray [4] [But] who are heedless of their prayer - [5] Those who make show [of their deeds] [6] And withhold [simple] assistance. [7]

ayahs.arabic: فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa wai lul-lil mu salleen
ayahs.translation: So woe to those who pray

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Al lazeena hum 'an salaatihim sahoon
ayahs.translation: [But] who are heedless of their prayer -

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Al lazeena hum yuraa-oon
ayahs.translation: Those who make show [of their deeds]

ayahs.arabic: وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa yamna'oonal ma'oon
ayahs.translation: And withhold [simple] assistance.

18.arabicText: لِإِيلَٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ ۝١ إِۦلَٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ ۝٢ فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ ۝٣ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍۢ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ ۝٤
18.transliteration: Li-ilaafi quraish (1) Elaafihim rihlatash shitaa-i wass saif (2) Fal y'abudu rabba haazal-bait (3) Allazi at'amahum min ju'inw-wa-aamana hum min khawf (4)
18.translationEn: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh - [1] Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer - [2] Let them worship the Lord of this House, [3] Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear. [4]

ayahs.arabic: لِإِيلَٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ
ayahs.transliteration: Li-ilaafi quraish
ayahs.translation: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh -

ayahs.arabic: إِۦلَٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ
ayahs.transliteration: Elaafihim rihlatash shitaa-i wass saif
ayahs.translation: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer -

ayahs.arabic: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fal y'abudu rabba haazal-bait
ayahs.translation: Let them worship the Lord of this House,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍۢ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Allazi at'amahum min ju'inw-wa-aamana hum min khawf
ayahs.translation: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.

19.arabicText: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ ۝١ أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍۢ ۝٢ وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ ۝٣
19.transliteration: Alam tara kaifa fa'ala rabbuka bi ashaabil feel (1) Alam yaj'al kai dahum fee tad leel (2) Wa arsala 'alaihim tairan abaabeel (3)
19.translationEn: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant? [1] Did He not make their plan into misguidance? [2] And He sent against them birds in flocks, [3]

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
ayahs.transliteration: Alam tara kaifa fa'ala rabbuka bi ashaabil feel
ayahs.translation: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Alam yaj'al kai dahum fee tad leel
ayahs.translation: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?

ayahs.arabic: وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa arsala 'alaihim tairan abaabeel
ayahs.translation: And He sent against them birds in flocks,

20.arabicText: تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍۢ مِّن سِجِّيلٍۢ ۝٤ فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍۢ مَّأْكُولٍۭ ۝٥
20.transliteration: Tar meehim bi hi jaaratim min sij jeel (4) Faja 'alahum ka'asfim m'akool (5)
20.translationEn: Striking them with stones of hard clay, [4] And He made them like eaten straw. [5]

ayahs.arabic: تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍۢ مِّن سِجِّيلٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Tar meehim bi hi jaaratim min sij jeel
ayahs.translation: Striking them with stones of hard clay,

ayahs.arabic: فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍۢ مَّأْكُولٍۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Faja 'alahum ka'asfim m'akool
ayahs.translation: And He made them like eaten straw.

21.arabicText: إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ ۝١ فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ ۝٢ إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ ۝٣
21.transliteration: Innaa a'taina kal kauthar (1) Fa salli li rabbika wanhar (2) Inna shani-aka huwal abtar (3)
21.translationEn: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar. [1] So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone]. [2] Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off. [3]

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa a'taina kal kauthar
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar.

ayahs.arabic: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa salli li rabbika wanhar
ayahs.translation: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ
ayahs.transliteration: Inna shani-aka huwal abtar
ayahs.translation: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.

22.arabicText: وَٱلْعَصْرِ ۝١ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ ۝٢ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ ۝٣
22.transliteration: Wal' asr (1) Innal insaana lafee khusr (2) Il lal lazeena aamanu wa 'amilus saali haati wa tawa saw bil haqqi wa tawa saw bis sabr (3)
22.translationEn: By time, [1] Indeed, mankind is in loss, [2] Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience. [3]

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْعَصْرِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wal' asr
ayahs.translation: By time,

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ
ayahs.transliteration: Innal insaana lafee khusr
ayahs.translation: Indeed, mankind is in loss,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
ayahs.transliteration: Il lal lazeena aamanu wa 'amilus saali haati wa tawa saw bil haqqi wa tawa saw bis sabr
ayahs.translation: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.

23.arabicText: وَيْلٌۭ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍۢ لُّمَزَةٍ ۝١ ٱلَّذِى جَمَعَ مَالًۭا وَعَدَّدَهُۥ ۝٢ يَحْسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُۥٓ أَخْلَدَهُۥ ۝٣ كَلَّا ۖ لَيُنۢبَذَنَّ فِى ٱلْحُطَمَةِ ۝٤
23.transliteration: Wai lul-li kulli hu mazatil-lumaza (1) Al-lazi jama'a maalaw wa'addadah (2) Yahsabu anna maalahu akhladah (3) Kalla layum ba zanna fil hutamah (4)
23.translationEn: Woe to every scorner and mocker [1] Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it. [2] He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal. [3] No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher. [4]

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌۭ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍۢ لُّمَزَةٍ
ayahs.transliteration: Wai lul-li kulli hu mazatil-lumaza
ayahs.translation: Woe to every scorner and mocker

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَمَعَ مَالًۭا وَعَدَّدَهُۥ
ayahs.transliteration: Al-lazi jama'a maalaw wa'addadah
ayahs.translation: Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.

ayahs.arabic: يَحْسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُۥٓ أَخْلَدَهُۥ
ayahs.transliteration: Yahsabu anna maalahu akhladah
ayahs.translation: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا ۖ لَيُنۢبَذَنَّ فِى ٱلْحُطَمَةِ
ayahs.transliteration: Kalla layum ba zanna fil hutamah
ayahs.translation: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.

24.arabicText: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحُطَمَةُ ۝٥ نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ ۝٦ ٱلَّتِى تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ ۝٧ إِنَّهَا عَلَيْهِم مُّؤْصَدَةٌۭ ۝٨ فِى عَمَدٍۢ مُّمَدَّدَةٍۭ ۝٩
24.transliteration: Wa maa adraaka mal-hutamah (5) Narul laahil-mooqada (6) Al latee tat tali'u 'alalafidah (7) Innaha 'alaihim moosada (8) Fee 'amadim-mu mad dadah (9)
24.translationEn: And what can make you know what is the Crusher? [5] It is the fire of Allah, [eternally] fueled, [6] Which mounts directed at the hearts. [7] Indeed, Hellfire will be closed down upon them [8] In extended columns. [9]

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحُطَمَةُ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa adraaka mal-hutamah
ayahs.translation: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?

ayahs.arabic: نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ
ayahs.transliteration: Narul laahil-mooqada
ayahs.translation: It is the fire of Allah, [eternally] fueled,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّتِى تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ
ayahs.transliteration: Al latee tat tali'u 'alalafidah
ayahs.translation: Which mounts directed at the hearts.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهَا عَلَيْهِم مُّؤْصَدَةٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Innaha 'alaihim moosada
ayahs.translation: Indeed, Hellfire will be closed down upon them

ayahs.arabic: فِى عَمَدٍۢ مُّمَدَّدَةٍۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Fee 'amadim-mu mad dadah
ayahs.translation: In extended columns.

25.arabicText: أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ ۝١ حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ ۝٢ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۝٣ ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۝٤
25.transliteration: Al haaku mut takathur (1) Hatta zurtumul-maqaabir (2) Kalla sawfa ta'lamoon (3) Thumma kalla sawfa ta'lamoon (4)
25.translationEn: Competition in [worldly] increase diverts you [1] Until you visit the graveyards. [2] No! You are going to know. [3] Then no! You are going to know. [4]

ayahs.arabic: أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ
ayahs.transliteration: Al haaku mut takathur
ayahs.translation: Competition in [worldly] increase diverts you

ayahs.arabic: حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ
ayahs.transliteration: Hatta zurtumul-maqaabir
ayahs.translation: Until you visit the graveyards.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Kalla sawfa ta'lamoon
ayahs.translation: No! You are going to know.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Thumma kalla sawfa ta'lamoon
ayahs.translation: Then no! You are going to know.

26.arabicText: كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ ٱلْيَقِينِ ۝٥ لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ ۝٦ ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ ٱلْيَقِينِ ۝٧ ثُمَّ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ ۝٨
26.transliteration: Kalla law ta'lamoona 'ilmal yaqeen (5) Latara-wun nal jaheem (6) Thumma latara wunnaha 'ainal yaqeen (7) Thumma latus alunna yauma-izin 'anin na'eem (8)
26.translationEn: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty... [5] You will surely see the Hellfire. [6] Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty. [7] Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure. [8]

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ ٱلْيَقِينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Kalla law ta'lamoona 'ilmal yaqeen
ayahs.translation: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...

ayahs.arabic: لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ
ayahs.transliteration: Latara-wun nal jaheem
ayahs.translation: You will surely see the Hellfire.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ ٱلْيَقِينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Thumma latara wunnaha 'ainal yaqeen
ayahs.translation: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayahs.transliteration: Thumma latus alunna yauma-izin 'anin na'eem
ayahs.translation: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.

27.arabicText: ٱلْقَارِعَةُ ۝١ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ ۝٢ وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ ۝٣ يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ ۝٤ وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ ٱلْمَنفُوشِ ۝٥
27.transliteration: Al qaari'ah (1) Mal qaariah (2) Wa maa adraaka mal qaari'ah (3) Yauma ya koonun naasu kal farashil mabthooth (4) Wa ta koonul jibalu kal 'ihnil manfoosh (5)
27.translationEn: The Striking Calamity - [1] What is the Striking Calamity? [2] And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity? [3] It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed, [4] And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up. [5]

ayahs.arabic: ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
ayahs.transliteration: Al qaari'ah
ayahs.translation: The Striking Calamity -

ayahs.arabic: مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
ayahs.transliteration: Mal qaariah
ayahs.translation: What is the Striking Calamity?

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa adraaka mal qaari'ah
ayahs.translation: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ
ayahs.transliteration: Yauma ya koonun naasu kal farashil mabthooth
ayahs.translation: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,

ayahs.arabic: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ ٱلْمَنفُوشِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ta koonul jibalu kal 'ihnil manfoosh
ayahs.translation: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.

28.arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ ۝٦ فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍۢ رَّاضِيَةٍۢ ۝٧ وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ ۝٨ فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٌۭ ۝٩ وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهْ ۝١٠ نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌۢ ۝١١
28.transliteration: Fa-amma man thaqulat mawa zeenuh (6) Fahuwa fee 'ishatir raadiyah (7) Wa amma man khaffat mawa zeenuh (8) Fa-ummuhu haawiyah (9) Wa maa adraaka maa hiyah (10) Naarun hamiyah (11)
28.translationEn: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds], [6] He will be in a pleasant life. [7] But as for one whose scales are light, [8] His refuge will be an abyss. [9] And what can make you know what that is? [10] It is a Fire, intensely hot. [11]

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa-amma man thaqulat mawa zeenuh
ayahs.translation: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],

ayahs.arabic: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍۢ رَّاضِيَةٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Fahuwa fee 'ishatir raadiyah
ayahs.translation: He will be in a pleasant life.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa amma man khaffat mawa zeenuh
ayahs.translation: But as for one whose scales are light,

ayahs.arabic: فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa-ummuhu haawiyah
ayahs.translation: His refuge will be an abyss.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهْ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa adraaka maa hiyah
ayahs.translation: And what can make you know what that is?

ayahs.arabic: نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Naarun hamiyah
ayahs.translation: It is a Fire, intensely hot.

29.arabicText: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ ۝١ وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ ۝٢ لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍۢ ۝٣ تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ ۝٤ سَلَٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ ۝٥
29.transliteration: Innaa anzalnaahu fee lailatil qadr (1) Wa maa adraaka ma lailatul qadr (2) Lailatul qadri khairum min alfee shahr (3) Tanaz zalul malaa-ikatu war roohu feeha bi izni-rab bihim min kulli amr (4) Salaamun hiya hattaa mat la'il fajr (5)
29.translationEn: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree. [1] And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree? [2] The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months. [3] The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter. [4] Peace it is until the emergence of dawn. [5]

ayahs.arabic: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa anzalnaahu fee lailatil qadr
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa adraaka ma lailatul qadr
ayahs.translation: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?

ayahs.arabic: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Lailatul qadri khairum min alfee shahr
ayahs.translation: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

ayahs.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Tanaz zalul malaa-ikatu war roohu feeha bi izni-rab bihim min kulli amr
ayahs.translation: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.

ayahs.arabic: سَلَٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ
ayahs.transliteration: Salaamun hiya hattaa mat la'il fajr
ayahs.translation: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.

30.arabicText: لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ ۝١ رَسُولٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًۭا مُّطَهَّرَةًۭ ۝٢ فِيهَا كُتُبٌۭ قَيِّمَةٌۭ ۝٣ وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ ۝٤
30.transliteration: Lam ya kunil lazeena kafaru min ahlil kitaabi wal mushri keena mun fak keena hattaa ta-tiya humul bayyinah (1) Rasoolum minal laahi yatlu suhufam mutahharah (2) Feeha kutubun qaiyimah (3) Wa maa tafarraqal lazeena ootul kitaaba il-la mim b'adi ma jaa-at humul baiyyinah (4)
30.translationEn: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief] until there came to them clear evidence - [1] A Messenger from Allah, reciting purified scriptures [2] Within which are correct writings. [3] Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided until after there had come to them clear evidence. [4]

ayahs.arabic: لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
ayahs.transliteration: Lam ya kunil lazeena kafaru min ahlil kitaabi wal mushri keena mun fak keena hattaa ta-tiya humul bayyinah
ayahs.translation: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief] until there came to them clear evidence -

ayahs.arabic: رَسُولٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًۭا مُّطَهَّرَةًۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Rasoolum minal laahi yatlu suhufam mutahharah
ayahs.translation: A Messenger from Allah, reciting purified scriptures

ayahs.arabic: فِيهَا كُتُبٌۭ قَيِّمَةٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Feeha kutubun qaiyimah
ayahs.translation: Within which are correct writings.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa tafarraqal lazeena ootul kitaaba il-la mim b'adi ma jaa-at humul baiyyinah
ayahs.translation: Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided until after there had come to them clear evidence.

31.arabicText: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ ۝٥ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ ۝٦ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ ۝٧ جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًۭا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ ۝٨
31.transliteration: Wa maa umiroo il-la liy'abu dul laaha mukhliseena lahud-deena huna faa-a wa yuqeemus salaahta wa yu-tuz zakaata; wa zaalika deenul qaiyimah (5) Innal lazeena kafaru min ahlil kitaabi wal mushri keena fee nari jahan nama khaali deena feeha; ulaa-ika hum shar rul ba reeyah (6) Innal lazeena aamanu wa 'amilus saalihaati ula-ika hum khairul bareey yah (7) Jazaa-uhum inda rabbihim jan naatu 'adnin tajree min tahtihal an haaru khalideena feeha abada; radiy-yallaahu 'anhum wa ra du 'an zaalika liman khashiya rabbah. (8)
31.translationEn: And they were not commanded except to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakah. And that is the correct religion. [5] Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures. [6] Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures. [7] Their reward with Allah will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allah being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord. [8]

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa umiroo il-la liy'abu dul laaha mukhliseena lahud-deena huna faa-a wa yuqeemus salaahta wa yu-tuz zakaata; wa zaalika deenul qaiyimah
ayahs.translation: And they were not commanded except to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakah. And that is the correct religion.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
ayahs.transliteration: Innal lazeena kafaru min ahlil kitaabi wal mushri keena fee nari jahan nama khaali deena feeha; ulaa-ika hum shar rul ba reeyah
ayahs.translation: Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
ayahs.transliteration: Innal lazeena aamanu wa 'amilus saalihaati ula-ika hum khairul bareey yah
ayahs.translation: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.

ayahs.arabic: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًۭا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ
ayahs.transliteration: Jazaa-uhum inda rabbihim jan naatu 'adnin tajree min tahtihal an haaru khalideena feeha abada; radiy-yallaahu 'anhum wa ra du 'an zaalika liman khashiya rabbah.
ayahs.translation: Their reward with Allah will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allah being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord.

32.arabicText: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ ۝١ وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ ۝٢ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ ۝٣ وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ ۝٤
32.transliteration: Alam nashrah laka sadrak (1) Wa wa d'ana 'anka wizrak (2) Allazee anqada zahrak (3) Wa raf 'ana laka zikrak (4)
32.translationEn: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast? [1] And We removed from you your burden [2] Which had weighed upon your back [3] And raised high for you your repute. [4]

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ
ayahs.transliteration: Alam nashrah laka sadrak
ayahs.translation: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast?

ayahs.arabic: وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa wa d'ana 'anka wizrak
ayahs.translation: And We removed from you your burden

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ
ayahs.transliteration: Allazee anqada zahrak
ayahs.translation: Which had weighed upon your back

ayahs.arabic: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa raf 'ana laka zikrak
ayahs.translation: And raised high for you your repute.

33.arabicText: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا ۝٥ إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًۭا ۝٦ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ ۝٧ وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب ۝٨
33.transliteration: Fa inna ma'al usri yusra (5) Inna ma'al 'usri yusra (6) Fa iza faragh ta fansab (7) Wa ilaa rabbika far ghab (8)
33.translationEn: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease. [5] Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease. [6] So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship]. [7] And to your Lord direct [your] longing. [8]

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
ayahs.transliteration: Fa inna ma'al usri yusra
ayahs.translation: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Inna ma'al 'usri yusra
ayahs.translation: Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa iza faragh ta fansab
ayahs.translation: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].

ayahs.arabic: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ilaa rabbika far ghab
ayahs.translation: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.

34.arabicText: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ ۝١ وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ ۝٢ مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ ۝٣ وَلَلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۝٤ وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ ۝٥ أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًۭا فَـَٔاوَىٰ ۝٦
34.transliteration: Wad duhaa (1) Wal laili iza sajaa (2) Ma wad da'aka rabbuka wa ma qalaa (3) Walal-aakhiratu khairul laka minal-oola (4) Wa la sawfa y'uteeka rabbuka fatarda (5) Alam ya jidka yateeman fa aawaa (6)
34.translationEn: By the morning brightness [1] And [by] the night when it covers with darkness, [2] Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you]. [3] And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life]. [4] And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied. [5] Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge? [6]

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wad duhaa
ayahs.translation: By the morning brightness

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wal laili iza sajaa
ayahs.translation: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,

ayahs.arabic: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Ma wad da'aka rabbuka wa ma qalaa
ayahs.translation: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].

ayahs.arabic: وَلَلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Walal-aakhiratu khairul laka minal-oola
ayahs.translation: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].

ayahs.arabic: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa la sawfa y'uteeka rabbuka fatarda
ayahs.translation: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًۭا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Alam ya jidka yateeman fa aawaa
ayahs.translation: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?

35.arabicText: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ ۝١ وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ ۝٢ لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍۢ ۝٣ تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ ۝٤ سَلَٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ ۝٥
35.transliteration: Innaa anzalnaahu fee lailatil qadr (1) Wa maa adraaka ma lailatul qadr (2) Lailatul qadri khairum min alfee shahr (3) Tanaz zalul malaa-ikatu war roohu feeha bi izni-rab bihim min kulli amr (4) Salaamun hiya hattaa mat la'il fajr (5)
35.translationEn: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree. [1] And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree? [2] The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months. [3] The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter. [4] Peace it is until the emergence of dawn. [5]

ayahs.arabic: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa anzalnaahu fee lailatil qadr
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa adraaka ma lailatul qadr
ayahs.translation: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?

ayahs.arabic: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Lailatul qadri khairum min alfee shahr
ayahs.translation: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

ayahs.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Tanaz zalul malaa-ikatu war roohu feeha bi izni-rab bihim min kulli amr
ayahs.translation: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.

ayahs.arabic: سَلَٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ
ayahs.transliteration: Salaamun hiya hattaa mat la'il fajr
ayahs.translation: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.

36.arabicText: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ ۝١ وَطُورِ سِينِينَ ۝٢ وَهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ ۝٣ لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍۢ ۝٤
36.transliteration: Wat teeni waz zaitoon (1) Wa toori sineen (2) Wa haazal balad-il ameen (3) Laqad khalaqnal insaana fee ahsani taqweem (4)
36.translationEn: By the fig and the olive [1] And [by] Mount Sinai [2] And [by] this secure city [Makkah], [3] We have certainly created man in the best of stature; [4]

ayahs.arabic: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wat teeni waz zaitoon
ayahs.translation: By the fig and the olive

ayahs.arabic: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa toori sineen
ayahs.translation: And [by] Mount Sinai

ayahs.arabic: وَهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa haazal balad-il ameen
ayahs.translation: And [by] this secure city [Makkah],

ayahs.arabic: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Laqad khalaqnal insaana fee ahsani taqweem
ayahs.translation: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;

37.arabicText: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَٰفِلِينَ ۝٥ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۢ ۝٦ فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ ۝٧ أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ ۝٨
37.transliteration: Thumma ra dad naahu asfala saafileen (5) Ill-lal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati; falahum ajrun ghairu mamnoon (6) Fama yu kaz zibuka b'adu bid deen (7) Alai sal laahu bi-ahkamil haakimeen (8)
37.translationEn: Then We return him to the lowest of the low, [5] Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted. [6] So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense? [7] Is not Allah the most just of judges? [8]

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَٰفِلِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Thumma ra dad naahu asfala saafileen
ayahs.translation: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Ill-lal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati; falahum ajrun ghairu mamnoon
ayahs.translation: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fama yu kaz zibuka b'adu bid deen
ayahs.translation: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?

ayahs.arabic: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Alai sal laahu bi-ahkamil haakimeen
ayahs.translation: Is not Allah the most just of judges?

38.arabicText: ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ۝١ خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ ۝٢ ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ ۝٣ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَ بِٱلْقَلَمِ ۝٤ عَلَّمَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ ۝٥ كَلَّآ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَيَطْغَىٰٓ ۝٦ أَن رَّءَاهُ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰٓ ۝٧ إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلرُّجْعَىٰٓ ۝٨
38.transliteration: Iqra bismi rab bikal lazee khalaq (1) Khalaqal insaana min 'alaq (2) Iqra wa rab bukal akram (3) Al lazee 'allama bil qalam (4) 'Al lamal insaana ma lam y'alam (5) Kallaa innal insaana layatghaa (6) Ar-ra aahus taghnaa (7) Innna ilaa rabbikar ruj'aa (8)
38.translationEn: Recite in the name of your Lord who created - [1] Created man from a clinging substance. [2] Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous - [3] Who taught by the pen - [4] Taught man that which he knew not. [5] No! [But] indeed, man transgresses [6] Because he sees himself self-sufficient. [7] Indeed, to your Lord is the return. [8]

ayahs.arabic: ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ
ayahs.transliteration: Iqra bismi rab bikal lazee khalaq
ayahs.translation: Recite in the name of your Lord who created -

ayahs.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ
ayahs.transliteration: Khalaqal insaana min 'alaq
ayahs.translation: Created man from a clinging substance.

ayahs.arabic: ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ
ayahs.transliteration: Iqra wa rab bukal akram
ayahs.translation: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَ بِٱلْقَلَمِ
ayahs.transliteration: Al lazee 'allama bil qalam
ayahs.translation: Who taught by the pen -

ayahs.arabic: عَلَّمَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ
ayahs.transliteration: 'Al lamal insaana ma lam y'alam
ayahs.translation: Taught man that which he knew not.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَيَطْغَىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Kallaa innal insaana layatghaa
ayahs.translation: No! [But] indeed, man transgresses

ayahs.arabic: أَن رَّءَاهُ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Ar-ra aahus taghnaa
ayahs.translation: Because he sees himself self-sufficient.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلرُّجْعَىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Innna ilaa rabbikar ruj'aa
ayahs.translation: Indeed, to your Lord is the return.

39.arabicText: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يَنْهَىٰ ۝٩ عَبْدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰٓ ۝١٠ أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ۝١١ أَوْ أَمَرَ بِٱلتَّقْوَىٰٓ ۝١٢ أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ ۝١٣ أَلَمْ يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ ۝١٤ كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ ۝١٥ نَاصِيَةٍۢ كَٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍۢ ۝١٦ فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُۥ ۝١٧ سَنَدْعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ ۝١٨ كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب ۩ ۝١٩
39.transliteration: Ara-aital lazee yanhaa (9) 'Abdan iza sallaa (10) Ara-aita in kana 'alal hudaa (11) Au amara bit taqwaa (12) Ara-aita in kaz zaba wa ta walla (13) Alam y'alam bi-an nal lahaa yaraa (14) Kalla la illam yantahi la nasfa'am bin nasiyah (15) Nasiyatin kazi batin khaatiyah (16) Fal yad'u naadiyah (17) Sanad 'uz zabaaniyah (18) Kalla; la tuti'hu wasjud waqtarib (19)
39.translationEn: Have you seen the one who forbids [9] A servant when he prays? [10] Have you seen if he is upon guidance [11] Or enjoins righteousness? [12] Have you seen if he denies and turns away - [13] Does he not know that Allah sees? [14] No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock - [15] A lying, sinning forelock. [16] Then let him call his associates; [17] We will call the angels of Hell. [18] No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allah]. [19]

ayahs.arabic: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يَنْهَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Ara-aital lazee yanhaa
ayahs.translation: Have you seen the one who forbids

ayahs.arabic: عَبْدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: 'Abdan iza sallaa
ayahs.translation: A servant when he prays?

ayahs.arabic: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Ara-aita in kana 'alal hudaa
ayahs.translation: Have you seen if he is upon guidance

ayahs.arabic: أَوْ أَمَرَ بِٱلتَّقْوَىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Au amara bit taqwaa
ayahs.translation: Or enjoins righteousness?

ayahs.arabic: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Ara-aita in kaz zaba wa ta walla
ayahs.translation: Have you seen if he denies and turns away -

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Alam y'alam bi-an nal lahaa yaraa
ayahs.translation: Does he not know that Allah sees?

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
ayahs.transliteration: Kalla la illam yantahi la nasfa'am bin nasiyah
ayahs.translation: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock -

ayahs.arabic: نَاصِيَةٍۢ كَٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Nasiyatin kazi batin khaatiyah
ayahs.translation: A lying, sinning forelock.

ayahs.arabic: فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُۥ
ayahs.transliteration: Fal yad'u naadiyah
ayahs.translation: Then let him call his associates;

ayahs.arabic: سَنَدْعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ
ayahs.transliteration: Sanad 'uz zabaaniyah
ayahs.translation: We will call the angels of Hell.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب ۩
ayahs.transliteration: Kalla; la tuti'hu wasjud waqtarib
ayahs.translation: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allah].

40.arabicText: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ۝١ وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ۝٢ وَوَالِدٍۢ وَمَا وَلَدَ ۝٣ لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ ۝٤ أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌۭ ۝٥ يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًۭا لُّبَدًا ۝٦ أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّمْ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ ۝٧ أَلَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عَيْنَيْنِ ۝٨ وَلِسَانًۭا وَشَفَتَيْنِ ۝٩ وَهَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلنَّجْدَيْنِ ۝١٠
40.transliteration: Laaa uqsimu bihaazal balad (1) Wa anta hillum bihaazal balad (2) Wa waalidinw wa maa walad (3) Laqad khalaqnal insaana fee kabad (4) Ayahsabu al-lai yaqdira 'alaihi ahad (5) Yaqoolu ahlaktu maalal lubadaa (6) Ayahsabu al lam yarahooo ahad (7) Alam naj'al lahoo 'aynayn (8) Wa lisaananw wa shafatayn (9) Wa hadaynaahun najdayn (10)
40.translationEn: I swear by this city, Makkah - [1] And you, [O Muhammad], are free of restriction in this city - [2] And [by] the father and that which was born [of him], [3] We have certainly created man into hardship. [4] Does he think that never will anyone overcome him? [5] He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance." [6] Does he think that no one has seen him? [7] Have We not made for him two eyes? [8] And a tongue and two lips? [9] And have shown him the two ways? [10]

ayahs.arabic: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
ayahs.transliteration: Laaa uqsimu bihaazal balad
ayahs.translation: I swear by this city, Makkah -

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa anta hillum bihaazal balad
ayahs.translation: And you, [O Muhammad], are free of restriction in this city -

ayahs.arabic: وَوَالِدٍۢ وَمَا وَلَدَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa waalidinw wa maa walad
ayahs.translation: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him],

ayahs.arabic: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ
ayahs.transliteration: Laqad khalaqnal insaana fee kabad
ayahs.translation: We have certainly created man into hardship.

ayahs.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Ayahsabu al-lai yaqdira 'alaihi ahad
ayahs.translation: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?

ayahs.arabic: يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًۭا لُّبَدًا
ayahs.transliteration: Yaqoolu ahlaktu maalal lubadaa
ayahs.translation: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."

ayahs.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّمْ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
ayahs.transliteration: Ayahsabu al lam yarahooo ahad
ayahs.translation: Does he think that no one has seen him?

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عَيْنَيْنِ
ayahs.transliteration: Alam naj'al lahoo 'aynayn
ayahs.translation: Have We not made for him two eyes?

ayahs.arabic: وَلِسَانًۭا وَشَفَتَيْنِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa lisaananw wa shafatayn
ayahs.translation: And a tongue and two lips?

ayahs.arabic: وَهَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلنَّجْدَيْنِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa hadaynaahun najdayn
ayahs.translation: And have shown him the two ways?

41.arabicText: فَلَا ٱقْتَحَمَ ٱلْعَقَبَةَ ۝١١ وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْعَقَبَةُ ۝١٢ فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ ۝١٣ أَوْ إِطْعَٰمٌۭ فِى يَوْمٍۢ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍۢ ۝١٤ يَتِيمًۭا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ ۝١٥ أَوْ مِسْكِينًۭا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍۢ ۝١٦ ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ ۝١٧ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ ۝١٨ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ ۝١٩ عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌۭ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ ۝٢٠
41.transliteration: Falaq tahamal-'aqabah (11) Wa maaa adraaka mal'aqabah (12) Fakku raqabah (13) Aw it'aamun fee yawmin zee masghabah (14) Yateeman zaa maqrabah (15) Aw miskeenan zaa matrabah (16) Summa kaana minal lazeena aamanoo wa tawaasaw bissabri wa tawaasaw bilmarhamah (17) Ulaaa'ika As-haabul maimanah (18) Wallazeena kafaroo bi aayaatinaa hum as-haabul Mash'amah (19) Alaihim naarum mu'sadah (20)
41.translationEn: But he has not broken through the difficult pass. [11] And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass? [12] It is the freeing of a slave [13] Or feeding on a day of severe hunger [14] An orphan of near relationship [15] Or a needy person in misery [16] And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion. [17] Those are the companions of the right. [18] But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left. [19] Over them will be fire closed in. [20]

ayahs.arabic: فَلَا ٱقْتَحَمَ ٱلْعَقَبَةَ
ayahs.transliteration: Falaq tahamal-'aqabah
ayahs.translation: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْعَقَبَةُ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maaa adraaka mal'aqabah
ayahs.translation: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?

ayahs.arabic: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ
ayahs.transliteration: Fakku raqabah
ayahs.translation: It is the freeing of a slave

ayahs.arabic: أَوْ إِطْعَٰمٌۭ فِى يَوْمٍۢ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Aw it'aamun fee yawmin zee masghabah
ayahs.translation: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger

ayahs.arabic: يَتِيمًۭا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ
ayahs.transliteration: Yateeman zaa maqrabah
ayahs.translation: An orphan of near relationship

ayahs.arabic: أَوْ مِسْكِينًۭا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Aw miskeenan zaa matrabah
ayahs.translation: Or a needy person in misery

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
ayahs.transliteration: Summa kaana minal lazeena aamanoo wa tawaasaw bissabri wa tawaasaw bilmarhamah
ayahs.translation: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.

ayahs.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
ayahs.transliteration: Ulaaa'ika As-haabul maimanah
ayahs.translation: Those are the companions of the right.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wallazeena kafaroo bi aayaatinaa hum as-haabul Mash'amah
ayahs.translation: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.

ayahs.arabic: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌۭ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Alaihim naarum mu'sadah
ayahs.translation: Over them will be fire closed in.

42.arabicText: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ ۝١ وَطُورِ سِينِينَ ۝٢ وَهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ ۝٣ لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍۢ ۝٤ ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَٰفِلِينَ ۝٥ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۢ ۝٦ فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ ۝٧ أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ ۝٨
42.transliteration: Wat teeni waz zaitoon (1) Wa toori sineen (2) Wa haazal balad-il ameen (3) Laqad khalaqnal insaana fee ahsani taqweem (4) Thumma ra dad naahu asfala saafileen (5) Ill-lal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati; falahum ajrun ghairu mamnoon (6) Fama yu kaz zibuka b'adu bid deen (7) Alai sal laahu bi-ahkamil haakimeen (8)
42.translationEn: By the fig and the olive [1] And [by] Mount Sinai [2] And [by] this secure city [Makkah], [3] We have certainly created man in the best of stature; [4] Then We return him to the lowest of the low, [5] Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted. [6] So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense? [7] Is not Allah the most just of judges? [8]

ayahs.arabic: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wat teeni waz zaitoon
ayahs.translation: By the fig and the olive

ayahs.arabic: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa toori sineen
ayahs.translation: And [by] Mount Sinai

ayahs.arabic: وَهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa haazal balad-il ameen
ayahs.translation: And [by] this secure city [Makkah],

ayahs.arabic: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Laqad khalaqnal insaana fee ahsani taqweem
ayahs.translation: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَٰفِلِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Thumma ra dad naahu asfala saafileen
ayahs.translation: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Ill-lal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati; falahum ajrun ghairu mamnoon
ayahs.translation: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fama yu kaz zibuka b'adu bid deen
ayahs.translation: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?

ayahs.arabic: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Alai sal laahu bi-ahkamil haakimeen
ayahs.translation: Is not Allah the most just of judges?

43.arabicText: وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا ۝١ وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا ۝٢ وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا ۝٣ وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا ۝٤ وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا ۝٥ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا ۝٦ وَنَفْسٍۢ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا ۝٧
43.transliteration: Wash shamsi wa duhaa haa (1) Wal qamari izaa talaa haa (2) Wannahaari izaa jallaa haa (3) Wallaili izaa yaghshaa haa (4) Wassamaaa'i wa maa banaahaa (5) Wal ardi wa maa tahaahaa (6) Wa nafsinw wa maa sawwaahaa (7)
43.translationEn: By the sun and its brightness [1] And [by] the moon when it follows it [2] And [by] the day when it displays it [3] And [by] the night when it covers it [4] And [by] the sky and He who constructed it [5] And [by] the earth and He who spread it [6] And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it [7]

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Wash shamsi wa duhaa haa
ayahs.translation: By the sun and its brightness

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Wal qamari izaa talaa haa
ayahs.translation: And [by] the moon when it follows it

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Wannahaari izaa jallaa haa
ayahs.translation: And [by] the day when it displays it

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Wallaili izaa yaghshaa haa
ayahs.translation: And [by] the night when it covers it

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Wassamaaa'i wa maa banaahaa
ayahs.translation: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Wal ardi wa maa tahaahaa
ayahs.translation: And [by] the earth and He who spread it

ayahs.arabic: وَنَفْسٍۢ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa nafsinw wa maa sawwaahaa
ayahs.translation: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it

44.arabicText: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا ۝٨ قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا ۝٩ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا ۝١٠ كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ ۝١١ إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا ۝١٢ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَٰهَا ۝١٣ فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا ۝١٤ وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَٰهَا ۝١٥
44.transliteration: Fa-alhamahaa fujoorahaa wa taqwaahaa (8) Qad aflaha man zakkaahaa (9) Wa qad khaaba man dassaahaa (10) Kazzabat Samoodu bi taghwaahaaa (11) Izim ba'asa ashqaahaa (12) Faqaala lahum Rasoolul laahi naaqatal laahi wa suqiyaahaa (13) Fakazzaboohu fa'aqaroohaa fadamdama 'alaihim Rabbuhum bizambihim fasaw waahaa (14) Wa laa yakhaafu'uqbaahaa (15)
44.translationEn: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness, [8] He has succeeded who purifies it, [9] And he has failed who instills it [with corruption]. [10] Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression, [11] When the most wretched of them was sent forth. [12] And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink." [13] But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them]. [14] And He does not fear the consequence thereof. [15]

ayahs.arabic: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Fa-alhamahaa fujoorahaa wa taqwaahaa
ayahs.translation: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,

ayahs.arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Qad aflaha man zakkaahaa
ayahs.translation: He has succeeded who purifies it,

ayahs.arabic: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa qad khaaba man dassaahaa
ayahs.translation: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].

ayahs.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ
ayahs.transliteration: Kazzabat Samoodu bi taghwaahaaa
ayahs.translation: Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,

ayahs.arabic: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Izim ba'asa ashqaahaa
ayahs.translation: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.

ayahs.arabic: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Faqaala lahum Rasoolul laahi naaqatal laahi wa suqiyaahaa
ayahs.translation: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink."

ayahs.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Fakazzaboohu fa'aqaroohaa fadamdama 'alaihim Rabbuhum bizambihim fasaw waahaa
ayahs.translation: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa laa yakhaafu'uqbaahaa
ayahs.translation: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.

45.arabicText: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ ۝١ وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ ۝٢ وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ ۝٣ إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ ۝٤ فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ ۝٥ وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۝٦ فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ ۝٧ وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ ۝٨ وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۝٩ فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ ۝١٠
45.transliteration: Wallaili izaa yaghshaa (1) Wannahaari izaa tajalla (2) Wa maa khalaqaz zakara wal unthaa (3) Inna sa'yakum lashattaa (4) Fa ammaa man a'taa wattaqaa (5) Wa saddaqa bil husnaa (6) Fasanu yassiruhoo lilyusraa (7) Wa ammaa mam bakhila wastaghnaa (8) Wa kazzaba bil husnaa (9) Fasanu yassiruhoo lil'usraa (10)
45.translationEn: By the night when it covers [1] And [by] the day when it appears [2] And [by] He who created the male and female, [3] Indeed, your efforts are diverse. [4] As for he who gives and fears Allah [5] And believes in the best [reward], [6] We will ease him toward ease. [7] But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need [8] And denies the best [reward], [9] We will ease him toward difficulty. [10]

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wallaili izaa yaghshaa
ayahs.translation: By the night when it covers

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wannahaari izaa tajalla
ayahs.translation: And [by] the day when it appears

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa khalaqaz zakara wal unthaa
ayahs.translation: And [by] He who created the male and female,

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Inna sa'yakum lashattaa
ayahs.translation: Indeed, your efforts are diverse.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa ammaa man a'taa wattaqaa
ayahs.translation: As for he who gives and fears Allah

ayahs.arabic: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa saddaqa bil husnaa
ayahs.translation: And believes in the best [reward],

ayahs.arabic: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Fasanu yassiruhoo lilyusraa
ayahs.translation: We will ease him toward ease.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ammaa mam bakhila wastaghnaa
ayahs.translation: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need

ayahs.arabic: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa kazzaba bil husnaa
ayahs.translation: And denies the best [reward],

ayahs.arabic: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Fasanu yassiruhoo lil'usraa
ayahs.translation: We will ease him toward difficulty.

46.arabicText: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ ۝١١ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ ۝١٢ وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْءَاخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ ۝١٣ فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًۭا تَلَظَّىٰ ۝١٤ لَا يَصْلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى ۝١٥ ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ ۝١٦ وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى ۝١٧ ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ ۝١٨ وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍۢ تُجْزَىٰٓ ۝١٩ إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ ۝٢٠ وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ ۝٢١
46.transliteration: Wa maa yughnee 'anhu maaluhooo izaa taraddaa (11) Inna 'alainaa lal hudaa (12) Wa inna lanaa lal Aakhirata wal oolaa (13) Fa anzartukum naaran talazzaa (14) Laa yaslaahaaa illal ashqaa (15) Allazee kazzaba wa tawallaa (16) Wa sa yujannnabuhal atqaa (17) Allazee yu'tee maalahoo yatazakkaa (18) Wa maa li ahadin 'indahoo min ni'matin tujzaaa (19) Illab tighaaa'a wajhi rabbihil a 'laa (20) Wa lasawfa yardaa (21)
46.translationEn: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls? [11] Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance. [12] And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life]. [13] So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing. [14] None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one. [15] Who had denied and turned away. [16] But the righteous one will avoid it - [17] [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself [18] And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded [19] But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High. [20] And he is going to be satisfied. [21]

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa yughnee 'anhu maaluhooo izaa taraddaa
ayahs.translation: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Inna 'alainaa lal hudaa
ayahs.translation: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْءَاخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa inna lanaa lal Aakhirata wal oolaa
ayahs.translation: And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].

ayahs.arabic: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًۭا تَلَظَّىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa anzartukum naaran talazzaa
ayahs.translation: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.

ayahs.arabic: لَا يَصْلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى
ayahs.transliteration: Laa yaslaahaaa illal ashqaa
ayahs.translation: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one.

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Allazee kazzaba wa tawallaa
ayahs.translation: Who had denied and turned away.

ayahs.arabic: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى
ayahs.transliteration: Wa sa yujannnabuhal atqaa
ayahs.translation: But the righteous one will avoid it -

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Allazee yu'tee maalahoo yatazakkaa
ayahs.translation: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍۢ تُجْزَىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa li ahadin 'indahoo min ni'matin tujzaaa
ayahs.translation: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Illab tighaaa'a wajhi rabbihil a 'laa
ayahs.translation: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa lasawfa yardaa
ayahs.translation: And he is going to be satisfied.

47.arabicText: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ ۝١ وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ ۝٢ مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ ۝٣ وَلَلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۝٤ وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ ۝٥ أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًۭا فَـَٔاوَىٰ ۝٦
47.transliteration: Wad duhaa (1) Wal laili iza sajaa (2) Ma wad da'aka rabbuka wa ma qalaa (3) Walal-aakhiratu khairul laka minal-oola (4) Wa la sawfa y'uteeka rabbuka fatarda (5) Alam ya jidka yateeman fa aawaa (6)
47.translationEn: By the morning brightness [1] And [by] the night when it covers with darkness, [2] Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you]. [3] And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life]. [4] And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied. [5] Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge? [6]

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wad duhaa
ayahs.translation: By the morning brightness

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wal laili iza sajaa
ayahs.translation: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,

ayahs.arabic: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Ma wad da'aka rabbuka wa ma qalaa
ayahs.translation: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].

ayahs.arabic: وَلَلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Walal-aakhiratu khairul laka minal-oola
ayahs.translation: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].

ayahs.arabic: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa la sawfa y'uteeka rabbuka fatarda
ayahs.translation: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًۭا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Alam ya jidka yateeman fa aawaa
ayahs.translation: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?

48.arabicText: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّۭا فَهَدَىٰ ۝٧ وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًۭا فَأَغْنَىٰ ۝٨ فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ ۝٩ وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ ۝١٠ وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ ۝١١
48.transliteration: Wa wa jadaka daal lan fahada (7) Wa wa jadaka 'aa-ilan fa aghnaa (8) Fa am mal yateema fala taqhar (9) Wa am mas saa-ila fala tanhar (10) Wa amma bi ni'mati rabbika fahad dith (11)
48.translationEn: And He found you lost and guided [you], [7] And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient. [8] So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him]. [9] And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him]. [10] But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it]. [11]

ayahs.arabic: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّۭا فَهَدَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa wa jadaka daal lan fahada
ayahs.translation: And He found you lost and guided [you],

ayahs.arabic: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًۭا فَأَغْنَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa wa jadaka 'aa-ilan fa aghnaa
ayahs.translation: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa am mal yateema fala taqhar
ayahs.translation: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa am mas saa-ila fala tanhar
ayahs.translation: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa amma bi ni'mati rabbika fahad dith
ayahs.translation: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].

49.arabicText: وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا ۝١ وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا ۝٢ وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا ۝٣ وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا ۝٤ وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا ۝٥ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا ۝٦ وَنَفْسٍۢ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا ۝٧ فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا ۝٨ قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا ۝٩ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا ۝١٠ كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ ۝١١ إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا ۝١٢ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَٰهَا ۝١٣ فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا ۝١٤ وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَٰهَا ۝١٥
49.transliteration: Wash shamsi wa duhaa haa (1) Wal qamari izaa talaa haa (2) Wannahaari izaa jallaa haa (3) Wallaili izaa yaghshaa haa (4) Wassamaaa'i wa maa banaahaa (5) Wal ardi wa maa tahaahaa (6) Wa nafsinw wa maa sawwaahaa (7) Fa-alhamahaa fujoorahaa wa taqwaahaa (8) Qad aflaha man zakkaahaa (9) Wa qad khaaba man dassaahaa (10) Kazzabat Samoodu bi taghwaahaaa (11) Izim ba'asa ashqaahaa (12) Faqaala lahum Rasoolul laahi naaqatal laahi wa suqiyaahaa (13) Fakazzaboohu fa'aqaroohaa fadamdama 'alaihim Rabbuhum bizambihim fasaw waahaa (14) Wa laa yakhaafu'uqbaahaa (15)
49.translationEn: By the sun and its brightness [1] And [by] the moon when it follows it [2] And [by] the day when it displays it [3] And [by] the night when it covers it [4] And [by] the sky and He who constructed it [5] And [by] the earth and He who spread it [6] And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it [7] And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness, [8] He has succeeded who purifies it, [9] And he has failed who instills it [with corruption]. [10] Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression, [11] When the most wretched of them was sent forth. [12] And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink." [13] But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them]. [14] And He does not fear the consequence thereof. [15]

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Wash shamsi wa duhaa haa
ayahs.translation: By the sun and its brightness

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Wal qamari izaa talaa haa
ayahs.translation: And [by] the moon when it follows it

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Wannahaari izaa jallaa haa
ayahs.translation: And [by] the day when it displays it

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Wallaili izaa yaghshaa haa
ayahs.translation: And [by] the night when it covers it

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Wassamaaa'i wa maa banaahaa
ayahs.translation: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Wal ardi wa maa tahaahaa
ayahs.translation: And [by] the earth and He who spread it

ayahs.arabic: وَنَفْسٍۢ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa nafsinw wa maa sawwaahaa
ayahs.translation: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it

ayahs.arabic: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Fa-alhamahaa fujoorahaa wa taqwaahaa
ayahs.translation: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,

ayahs.arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Qad aflaha man zakkaahaa
ayahs.translation: He has succeeded who purifies it,

ayahs.arabic: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa qad khaaba man dassaahaa
ayahs.translation: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].

ayahs.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ
ayahs.transliteration: Kazzabat Samoodu bi taghwaahaaa
ayahs.translation: Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,

ayahs.arabic: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Izim ba'asa ashqaahaa
ayahs.translation: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.

ayahs.arabic: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Faqaala lahum Rasoolul laahi naaqatal laahi wa suqiyaahaa
ayahs.translation: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink."

ayahs.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Fakazzaboohu fa'aqaroohaa fadamdama 'alaihim Rabbuhum bizambihim fasaw waahaa
ayahs.translation: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa laa yakhaafu'uqbaahaa
ayahs.translation: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.

50.arabicText: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى ۝١ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ ۝٢ وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ ۝٣ وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ ۝٤ فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ ۝٥ سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ ۝٦ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ ۝٧ وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ ۝٨ فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ ۝٩
50.transliteration: Sabbihisma Rabbikal A'laa (1) Allazee khalaqa fasawwaa (2) Wallazee qaddara fahadaa (3) Wallazeee akhrajal mar'aa (4) Faja'alahoo ghusaaa'an ahwaa (5) Sanuqri'uka falaa tansaaa (6) Illaa maa shaaa'al laah; innahoo ya'lamul jahra wa maa yakhfaa (7) Wa nu-yassiruka lilyusraa (8) Fazakkir in nafa'atizzikraa (9)
50.translationEn: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High, [1] Who created and proportioned [2] And who destined and [then] guided [3] And who brings out the pasture [4] And [then] makes it black stubble. [5] We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget, [6] Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden. [7] And We will ease you toward ease. [8] So remind, if the reminder should benefit; [9]

ayahs.arabic: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى
ayahs.transliteration: Sabbihisma Rabbikal A'laa
ayahs.translation: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Allazee khalaqa fasawwaa
ayahs.translation: Who created and proportioned

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wallazee qaddara fahadaa
ayahs.translation: And who destined and [then] guided

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wallazeee akhrajal mar'aa
ayahs.translation: And who brings out the pasture

ayahs.arabic: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Faja'alahoo ghusaaa'an ahwaa
