ayahs.translation: And [then] makes it black stubble.

ayahs.arabic: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Sanuqri'uka falaa tansaaa
ayahs.translation: We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Illaa maa shaaa'al laah; innahoo ya'lamul jahra wa maa yakhfaa
ayahs.translation: Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.

ayahs.arabic: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa nu-yassiruka lilyusraa
ayahs.translation: And We will ease you toward ease.

ayahs.arabic: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Fazakkir in nafa'atizzikraa
ayahs.translation: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;

51.arabicText: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ ۝١٠ وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى ۝١١ ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ ۝١٢ ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ ۝١٣ قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ ۝١٤ وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ ۝١٥ بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۝١٦ وَٱلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ ۝١٧ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۝١٨ صُحُفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ ۝١٩
51.transliteration: Sa yazzakkaru maiyakhshaa (10) Wa yatajannabuhal ashqaa (11) Allazee yaslan Naaral kubraa (12) Summa laa yamootu feehaa wa laa yahyaa (13) Qad aflaha man tazakkaa (14) Wa zakaras ma Rabbihee fasallaa (15) Bal tu'siroonal hayaatad dunyaa (16) Wal Aakhiratu khairunw wa abqaa (17) Inna haazaa lafis suhu fil oolaa (18) Suhufi Ibraaheema wa Moosaa (19)
51.translationEn: He who fears [Allah] will be reminded. [10] But the wretched one will avoid it - [11] [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire, [12] Neither dying therein nor living. [13] He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself [14] And mentions the name of his Lord and prays. [15] But you prefer the worldly life, [16] While the Hereafter is better and more enduring. [17] Indeed, this is in the former scriptures, [18] The scriptures of Abraham and Moses. [19]

ayahs.arabic: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Sa yazzakkaru maiyakhshaa
ayahs.translation: He who fears [Allah] will be reminded.

ayahs.arabic: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى
ayahs.transliteration: Wa yatajannabuhal ashqaa
ayahs.translation: But the wretched one will avoid it -

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Allazee yaslan Naaral kubraa
ayahs.translation: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Summa laa yamootu feehaa wa laa yahyaa
ayahs.translation: Neither dying therein nor living.

ayahs.arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Qad aflaha man tazakkaa
ayahs.translation: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself

ayahs.arabic: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa zakaras ma Rabbihee fasallaa
ayahs.translation: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.

ayahs.arabic: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
ayahs.transliteration: Bal tu'siroonal hayaatad dunyaa
ayahs.translation: But you prefer the worldly life,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Wal Aakhiratu khairunw wa abqaa
ayahs.translation: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Inna haazaa lafis suhu fil oolaa
ayahs.translation: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,

ayahs.arabic: صُحُفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Suhufi Ibraaheema wa Moosaa
ayahs.translation: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.

52.arabicText: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْغَٰشِيَةِ ۝١ وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَٰشِعَةٌ ۝٢ عَامِلَةٌۭ نَّاصِبَةٌۭ ۝٣ تَصْلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةًۭ ۝٤ تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ ءَانِيَةٍۢ ۝٥ لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍۢ ۝٦ لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍۢ ۝٧ وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ نَّاعِمَةٌۭ ۝٨ لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌۭ ۝٩ فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍۢ ۝١٠ لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَٰغِيَةًۭ ۝١١ فِيهَا عَيْنٌۭ جَارِيَةٌۭ ۝١٢ فِيهَا سُرُرٌۭ مَّرْفُوعَةٌۭ ۝١٣ وَأَكْوَابٌۭ مَّوْضُوعَةٌۭ ۝١٤ وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌۭ ۝١٥ وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ ۝١٦
52.transliteration: Hal ataaka hadeesul ghaashiyah (1) Wujoohuny yawma 'izin khaashi'ah (2) 'Aamilatun naasibah (3) Taslaa naaran haamiyah (4) Tusqaa min 'aynin aaniyah (5) Laisa lahum ta'aamun illaa min daree' (6) Laa yusminu wa laa yughnee min joo' (7) Wujoohuny yawma 'izin naa'imah (8) Lisa'yihaa raadiyah (9) Fee jannatin 'aaliyah (10) Laa tasma'u feehaa laaghiyah (11) Feehaa 'aynun jaariyah (12) Feehaa sururum marfoo'ah (13) Wa akwaabum mawdoo 'ah (14) Wa namaariqu masfoofah (15) Wa zaraabiyyu mabsoosah (16)
52.translationEn: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]? [1] [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled, [2] Working [hard] and exhausted. [3] They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire. [4] They will be given drink from a boiling spring. [5] For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant [6] Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger. [7] [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure. [8] With their effort [they are] satisfied [9] In an elevated garden, [10] Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech. [11] Within it is a flowing spring. [12] Within it are couches raised high [13] And cups put in place [14] And cushions lined up [15] And carpets spread around. [16]

ayahs.arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْغَٰشِيَةِ
ayahs.transliteration: Hal ataaka hadeesul ghaashiyah
ayahs.translation: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?

ayahs.arabic: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَٰشِعَةٌ
ayahs.transliteration: Wujoohuny yawma 'izin khaashi'ah
ayahs.translation: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,

ayahs.arabic: عَامِلَةٌۭ نَّاصِبَةٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: 'Aamilatun naasibah
ayahs.translation: Working [hard] and exhausted.

ayahs.arabic: تَصْلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةًۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Taslaa naaran haamiyah
ayahs.translation: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.

ayahs.arabic: تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ ءَانِيَةٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Tusqaa min 'aynin aaniyah
ayahs.translation: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.

ayahs.arabic: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Laisa lahum ta'aamun illaa min daree'
ayahs.translation: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant

ayahs.arabic: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Laa yusminu wa laa yughnee min joo'
ayahs.translation: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.

ayahs.arabic: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ نَّاعِمَةٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Wujoohuny yawma 'izin naa'imah
ayahs.translation: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.

ayahs.arabic: لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Lisa'yihaa raadiyah
ayahs.translation: With their effort [they are] satisfied

ayahs.arabic: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Fee jannatin 'aaliyah
ayahs.translation: In an elevated garden,

ayahs.arabic: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَٰغِيَةًۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Laa tasma'u feehaa laaghiyah
ayahs.translation: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.

ayahs.arabic: فِيهَا عَيْنٌۭ جَارِيَةٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Feehaa 'aynun jaariyah
ayahs.translation: Within it is a flowing spring.

ayahs.arabic: فِيهَا سُرُرٌۭ مَّرْفُوعَةٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Feehaa sururum marfoo'ah
ayahs.translation: Within it are couches raised high

ayahs.arabic: وَأَكْوَابٌۭ مَّوْضُوعَةٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa akwaabum mawdoo 'ah
ayahs.translation: And cups put in place

ayahs.arabic: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa namaariqu masfoofah
ayahs.translation: And cushions lined up

ayahs.arabic: وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa zaraabiyyu mabsoosah
ayahs.translation: And carpets spread around.

53.arabicText: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ ۝١٧ وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ ۝١٨ وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ ۝١٩ وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ ۝٢٠ فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌۭ ۝٢١ لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ ۝٢٢ إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ ۝٢٣ فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ ۝٢٤ إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ ۝٢٥ ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم ۝٢٦
53.transliteration: Afalaa yanzuroona ilalibili kaifa khuliqat (17) Wa ilas samaaa'i kaifa rufi'at (18) Wa ilal jibaali kaifa nusibat (19) Wa ilal ardi kaifa sutihat (20) Fazakkir innama anta Muzakkir (21) Lasta 'alaihim bimusaitir (22) Illaa man tawallaa wa kafar (23) Fa yu'azzibuhul laahul 'azaabal akbar (24) Innaa ilainaaa iyaabahum (25) Summa inna 'alainaa hisaabahum (26)
53.translationEn: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created? [17] And at the sky - how it is raised? [18] And at the mountains - how they are erected? [19] And at the earth - how it is spread out? [20] So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder. [21] You are not over them a controller. [22] However, he who turns away and disbelieves - [23] Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment. [24] Indeed, to Us is their return. [25] Then indeed, upon Us is their account. [26]

ayahs.arabic: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Afalaa yanzuroona ilalibili kaifa khuliqat
ayahs.translation: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?

ayahs.arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ilas samaaa'i kaifa rufi'at
ayahs.translation: And at the sky - how it is raised?

ayahs.arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ilal jibaali kaifa nusibat
ayahs.translation: And at the mountains - how they are erected?

ayahs.arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ilal ardi kaifa sutihat
ayahs.translation: And at the earth - how it is spread out?

ayahs.arabic: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Fazakkir innama anta Muzakkir
ayahs.translation: So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder.

ayahs.arabic: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
ayahs.transliteration: Lasta 'alaihim bimusaitir
ayahs.translation: You are not over them a controller.

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
ayahs.transliteration: Illaa man tawallaa wa kafar
ayahs.translation: However, he who turns away and disbelieves -

ayahs.arabic: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa yu'azzibuhul laahul 'azaabal akbar
ayahs.translation: Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa ilainaaa iyaabahum
ayahs.translation: Indeed, to Us is their return.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم
ayahs.transliteration: Summa inna 'alainaa hisaabahum
ayahs.translation: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.

54.arabicText: وَٱلْفَجْرِ ۝١ وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍۢ ۝٢ وَٱلشَّفْعِ وَٱلْوَتْرِ ۝٣ وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ ۝٤ هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌۭ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ ۝٥ أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ ۝٦ إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلْعِمَادِ ۝٧ ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ ۝٨ وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُوا۟ ٱلصَّخْرَ بِٱلْوَادِ ۝٩ وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِى ٱلْأَوْتَادِ ۝١٠ ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ ۝١١ فَأَكْثَرُوا۟ فِيهَا ٱلْفَسَادَ ۝١٢ فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ ۝١٣ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ ۝١٤
54.transliteration: Wal-Fajr (1) Wa layaalin 'ashr (2) Wash shaf'i wal watr (3) Wallaili izaa yasr (4) Hal fee zaalika qasamul lizee hijr (5) Alam tara kaifa fa'ala rabbuka bi'aad (6) Iramaa zaatil 'imaad (7) Allatee lam yukhlaq misluhaa fil bilaad (8) Wa samoodal lazeena jaabus sakhra bil waad (9) Wa fir'awna zil awtaad (10) Allazeena taghaw fil bilaad (11) Fa aksaroo feehal fasaad (12) Fasabba 'alaihim Rabbuka sawta 'azaab (13) Inna Rabbaka labil mirsaad (14)
54.translationEn: By the dawn [1] And [by] ten nights [2] And [by] the even [number] and the odd [3] And [by] the night when it passes, [4] Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception? [5] Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with 'Aad - [6] [With] Iram - who had lofty pillars, [7] The likes of whom had never been created in the land? [8] And [with] Thamud, who carved out the rocks in the valley? [9] And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes? - [10] [All of] whom oppressed within the lands [11] And increased therein the corruption. [12] So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment. [13] Indeed, your Lord is in observation. [14]

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْفَجْرِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-Fajr
ayahs.translation: By the dawn

ayahs.arabic: وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa layaalin 'ashr
ayahs.translation: And [by] ten nights

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلشَّفْعِ وَٱلْوَتْرِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wash shaf'i wal watr
ayahs.translation: And [by] the even [number] and the odd

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wallaili izaa yasr
ayahs.translation: And [by] the night when it passes,

ayahs.arabic: هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌۭ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ
ayahs.transliteration: Hal fee zaalika qasamul lizee hijr
ayahs.translation: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
ayahs.transliteration: Alam tara kaifa fa'ala rabbuka bi'aad
ayahs.translation: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with 'Aad -

ayahs.arabic: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلْعِمَادِ
ayahs.transliteration: Iramaa zaatil 'imaad
ayahs.translation: [With] Iram - who had lofty pillars,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
ayahs.transliteration: Allatee lam yukhlaq misluhaa fil bilaad
ayahs.translation: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?

ayahs.arabic: وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُوا۟ ٱلصَّخْرَ بِٱلْوَادِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa samoodal lazeena jaabus sakhra bil waad
ayahs.translation: And [with] Thamud, who carved out the rocks in the valley?

ayahs.arabic: وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِى ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa fir'awna zil awtaad
ayahs.translation: And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes? -

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
ayahs.transliteration: Allazeena taghaw fil bilaad
ayahs.translation: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands

ayahs.arabic: فَأَكْثَرُوا۟ فِيهَا ٱلْفَسَادَ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa aksaroo feehal fasaad
ayahs.translation: And increased therein the corruption.

ayahs.arabic: فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ
ayahs.transliteration: Fasabba 'alaihim Rabbuka sawta 'azaab
ayahs.translation: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ
ayahs.transliteration: Inna Rabbaka labil mirsaad
ayahs.translation: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.

55.arabicText: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ ۝١٥ وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَٰنَنِ ۝١٦ كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ ۝١٧ وَلَا تَحَٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ ۝١٨ وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًۭا لَّمًّۭا ۝١٩ وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّۭا جَمًّۭا ۝٢٠ كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّۭا دَكًّۭا ۝٢١ وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّۭا صَفًّۭا ۝٢٢ وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ ۝٢٣ يَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى ۝٢٤ فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌۭ ۝٢٥ وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌۭ ۝٢٦ يَٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ ۝٢٧ ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةًۭ مَّرْضِيَّةًۭ ۝٢٨ فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَٰدِى ۝٢٩ وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى ۝٣٠
55.transliteration: Fa ammal insaanu izaa mab talaahu Rabbuhoo fa akramahoo wa na' 'amahoo fa yaqoolu Rabbeee akraman (15) Wa ammaaa izaa mabtalaahu faqadara 'alaihi rizqahoo fa yaqoolu Rabbeee ahaanan (16) Kalla bal laa tukrimooo nal yateem (17) Wa laa tahaaaddoona 'alaata'aamil miskeen (18) Wa taakuloonat turaasa aklal lammaa (19) Wa tuhibboonal maala hubban jammaa (20) Kallaaa izaaa dukkatil ardu dakkan dakka (21) Wa jaaa'a Rabbuka wal malaku saffan saffaa (22) Wa jeee'a yawma'izim bi jahannnam; Yawma 'iziny yatazakkarul insaanu wa annaa lahuz zikraa (23) Yaqoolu yaa laitanee qaddamtu lihayaatee (24) Fa Yawma izil laa yu'azzibu 'azaabahooo ahad (25) Wa laa yoosiqu wasaaqa hooo ahad (26) Yaaa ayyatuhan nafsul mutma 'innah (27) Irji'eee ilaa Rabbiki raadiyatam mardiyyah (28) Fadkhulee fee 'ibaadee (29) Wadkhulee jannatee (30)
55.translationEn: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me." [15] But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me." [16] No! But you do not honor the orphan [17] And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor. [18] And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether, [19] And you love wealth with immense love. [20] No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed - [21] And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank, [22] And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance? [23] He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life." [24] So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment, [25] And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers]. [26] [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul, [27] Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him], [28] And enter among My [righteous] servants [29] And enter My Paradise." [30]

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa ammal insaanu izaa mab talaahu Rabbuhoo fa akramahoo wa na' 'amahoo fa yaqoolu Rabbeee akraman
ayahs.translation: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَٰنَنِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ammaaa izaa mabtalaahu faqadara 'alaihi rizqahoo fa yaqoolu Rabbeee ahaanan
ayahs.translation: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
ayahs.transliteration: Kalla bal laa tukrimooo nal yateem
ayahs.translation: No! But you do not honor the orphan

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا تَحَٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa laa tahaaaddoona 'alaata'aamil miskeen
ayahs.translation: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.

ayahs.arabic: وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًۭا لَّمًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa taakuloonat turaasa aklal lammaa
ayahs.translation: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,

ayahs.arabic: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّۭا جَمًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa tuhibboonal maala hubban jammaa
ayahs.translation: And you love wealth with immense love.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّۭا دَكًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Kallaaa izaaa dukkatil ardu dakkan dakka
ayahs.translation: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed -

ayahs.arabic: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّۭا صَفًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa jaaa'a Rabbuka wal malaku saffan saffaa
ayahs.translation: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,

ayahs.arabic: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa jeee'a yawma'izim bi jahannnam; Yawma 'iziny yatazakkarul insaanu wa annaa lahuz zikraa
ayahs.translation: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance?

ayahs.arabic: يَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى
ayahs.transliteration: Yaqoolu yaa laitanee qaddamtu lihayaatee
ayahs.translation: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life."

ayahs.arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa Yawma izil laa yu'azzibu 'azaabahooo ahad
ayahs.translation: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa laa yoosiqu wasaaqa hooo ahad
ayahs.translation: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
ayahs.transliteration: Yaaa ayyatuhan nafsul mutma 'innah
ayahs.translation: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul,

ayahs.arabic: ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةًۭ مَّرْضِيَّةًۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Irji'eee ilaa Rabbiki raadiyatam mardiyyah
ayahs.translation: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],

ayahs.arabic: فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَٰدِى
ayahs.transliteration: Fadkhulee fee 'ibaadee
ayahs.translation: And enter among My [righteous] servants

ayahs.arabic: وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى
ayahs.transliteration: Wadkhulee jannatee
ayahs.translation: And enter My Paradise."

56.arabicText: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى ۝١ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ ۝٢ وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ ۝٣ وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ ۝٤ فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ ۝٥ سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ ۝٦ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ ۝٧ وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ ۝٨ فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ ۝٩ سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ ۝١٠ وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى ۝١١ ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ ۝١٢ ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ ۝١٣ قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ ۝١٤ وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ ۝١٥ بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۝١٦ وَٱلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ ۝١٧ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۝١٨ صُحُفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ ۝١٩
56.transliteration: Sabbihisma Rabbikal A'laa (1) Allazee khalaqa fasawwaa (2) Wallazee qaddara fahadaa (3) Wallazeee akhrajal mar'aa (4) Faja'alahoo ghusaaa'an ahwaa (5) Sanuqri'uka falaa tansaaa (6) Illaa maa shaaa'al laah; innahoo ya'lamul jahra wa maa yakhfaa (7) Wa nu-yassiruka lilyusraa (8) Fazakkir in nafa'atizzikraa (9) Sa yazzakkaru maiyakhshaa (10) Wa yatajannabuhal ashqaa (11) Allazee yaslan Naaral kubraa (12) Summa laa yamootu feehaa wa laa yahyaa (13) Qad aflaha man tazakkaa (14) Wa zakaras ma Rabbihee fasallaa (15) Bal tu'siroonal hayaatad dunyaa (16) Wal Aakhiratu khairunw wa abqaa (17) Inna haazaa lafis suhu fil oolaa (18) Suhufi Ibraaheema wa Moosaa (19)
56.translationEn: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High, [1] Who created and proportioned [2] And who destined and [then] guided [3] And who brings out the pasture [4] And [then] makes it black stubble. [5] We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget, [6] Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden. [7] And We will ease you toward ease. [8] So remind, if the reminder should benefit; [9] He who fears [Allah] will be reminded. [10] But the wretched one will avoid it - [11] [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire, [12] Neither dying therein nor living. [13] He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself [14] And mentions the name of his Lord and prays. [15] But you prefer the worldly life, [16] While the Hereafter is better and more enduring. [17] Indeed, this is in the former scriptures, [18] The scriptures of Abraham and Moses. [19]

ayahs.arabic: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى
ayahs.transliteration: Sabbihisma Rabbikal A'laa
ayahs.translation: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Allazee khalaqa fasawwaa
ayahs.translation: Who created and proportioned

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wallazee qaddara fahadaa
ayahs.translation: And who destined and [then] guided

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wallazeee akhrajal mar'aa
ayahs.translation: And who brings out the pasture

ayahs.arabic: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Faja'alahoo ghusaaa'an ahwaa
ayahs.translation: And [then] makes it black stubble.

ayahs.arabic: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Sanuqri'uka falaa tansaaa
ayahs.translation: We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Illaa maa shaaa'al laah; innahoo ya'lamul jahra wa maa yakhfaa
ayahs.translation: Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.

ayahs.arabic: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa nu-yassiruka lilyusraa
ayahs.translation: And We will ease you toward ease.

ayahs.arabic: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Fazakkir in nafa'atizzikraa
ayahs.translation: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;

ayahs.arabic: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Sa yazzakkaru maiyakhshaa
ayahs.translation: He who fears [Allah] will be reminded.

ayahs.arabic: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى
ayahs.transliteration: Wa yatajannabuhal ashqaa
ayahs.translation: But the wretched one will avoid it -

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Allazee yaslan Naaral kubraa
ayahs.translation: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Summa laa yamootu feehaa wa laa yahyaa
ayahs.translation: Neither dying therein nor living.

ayahs.arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Qad aflaha man tazakkaa
ayahs.translation: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself

ayahs.arabic: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa zakaras ma Rabbihee fasallaa
ayahs.translation: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.

ayahs.arabic: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
ayahs.transliteration: Bal tu'siroonal hayaatad dunyaa
ayahs.translation: But you prefer the worldly life,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Wal Aakhiratu khairunw wa abqaa
ayahs.translation: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Inna haazaa lafis suhu fil oolaa
ayahs.translation: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,

ayahs.arabic: صُحُفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Suhufi Ibraaheema wa Moosaa
ayahs.translation: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.

57.arabicText: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ ۝١ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ ۝٢ وَشَاهِدٍۢ وَمَشْهُودٍۢ ۝٣ قُتِلَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ ۝٤ ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ ۝٥ إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌۭ ۝٦ وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌۭ ۝٧ وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ ۝٨ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ ۝٩ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ ۝١٠ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ ۝١١
57.transliteration: Wassamaaa'i zaatil burooj (1) Wal yawmil maw'ood (2) Wa shaahidinw wa mashhood (3) Qutila as haabul ukhdood (4) Annaari zaatil waqood (5) Iz hum 'alaihaa qu'ood (6) Wa hum 'alaa maa yaf'aloona bilmu 'mineena shuhood (7) Wa maa naqamoo minhum illaaa aiyu'minoo billaahil 'azeezil Hameed (8) Allazee lahoo mulkus samaawaati wal ard; wallaahu 'alaa kulli shai 'in Shaheed (9) Innal lazeena fatanul mu'mineena wal mu'minaati summa lam yatooboo falahum 'azaabu Jahannama wa lahum 'azaabul hareeq (10) Innal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati lahum Jannaatun tajree min tahtihal anhaar; zaalikal fawzul kabeer (11)
57.translationEn: By the sky containing great stars [1] And [by] the promised Day [2] And [by] the witness and what is witnessed, [3] Cursed were the companions of the trench [4] [Containing] the fire full of fuel, [5] When they were sitting near it [6] And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses. [7] And they resented them not except because they believed in Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, [8] To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, over all things, is Witness. [9] Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire. [10] Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment. [11]

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wassamaaa'i zaatil burooj
ayahs.translation: By the sky containing great stars

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wal yawmil maw'ood
ayahs.translation: And [by] the promised Day

ayahs.arabic: وَشَاهِدٍۢ وَمَشْهُودٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa shaahidinw wa mashhood
ayahs.translation: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,

ayahs.arabic: قُتِلَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ
ayahs.transliteration: Qutila as haabul ukhdood
ayahs.translation: Cursed were the companions of the trench

ayahs.arabic: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
ayahs.transliteration: Annaari zaatil waqood
ayahs.translation: [Containing] the fire full of fuel,

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Iz hum 'alaihaa qu'ood
ayahs.translation: When they were sitting near it

ayahs.arabic: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa hum 'alaa maa yaf'aloona bilmu 'mineena shuhood
ayahs.translation: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa naqamoo minhum illaaa aiyu'minoo billaahil 'azeezil Hameed
ayahs.translation: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ
ayahs.transliteration: Allazee lahoo mulkus samaawaati wal ard; wallaahu 'alaa kulli shai 'in Shaheed
ayahs.translation: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, over all things, is Witness.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
ayahs.transliteration: Innal lazeena fatanul mu'mineena wal mu'minaati summa lam yatooboo falahum 'azaabu Jahannama wa lahum 'azaabul hareeq
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
ayahs.transliteration: Innal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati lahum Jannaatun tajree min tahtihal anhaar; zaalikal fawzul kabeer
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.

58.arabicText: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ ۝١٢ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ ۝١٣ وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ ۝١٤ ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ ۝١٥ فَعَّالٌۭ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ ۝١٦ هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ ۝١٧ فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ ۝١٨ بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍۢ ۝١٩ وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ ۝٢٠ بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌۭ مَّجِيدٌۭ ۝٢١ فِى لَوْحٍۢ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ ۝٢٢
58.transliteration: Inna batsha Rabbika lashadeed (12) Innahoo Huwa yubdi'u wa yu'eed (13) Wa Huwal Ghafoorul Wadood (14) Zul 'Arshil Majeed (15) Fa' 'aalul limaa yureed (16) Hal ataaka hadeesul junood (17) Fir'awna wa Samood (18) Balil lazeena kafaroo fee takzeeb (19) Wallaahu minw waraaa'ihim muheet (20) Bal huwa Quraanum Majeed (21) Fee Lawhim Mahfooz (22)
58.translationEn: Indeed, the vengeance of your Lord is severe. [12] Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats. [13] And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate, [14] Honorable Owner of the Throne, [15] Effecter of what He intends. [16] Has there reached you the story of the soldiers - [17] [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamud? [18] But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial, [19] While Allah encompasses them from behind. [20] But this is an honored Qur'an [21] [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate. [22]

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
ayahs.transliteration: Inna batsha Rabbika lashadeed
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the vengeance of your Lord is severe.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
ayahs.transliteration: Innahoo Huwa yubdi'u wa yu'eed
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.

ayahs.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa Huwal Ghafoorul Wadood
ayahs.translation: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,

ayahs.arabic: ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ
ayahs.transliteration: Zul 'Arshil Majeed
ayahs.translation: Honorable Owner of the Throne,

ayahs.arabic: فَعَّالٌۭ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa' 'aalul limaa yureed
ayahs.translation: Effecter of what He intends.

ayahs.arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ
ayahs.transliteration: Hal ataaka hadeesul junood
ayahs.translation: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -

ayahs.arabic: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
ayahs.transliteration: Fir'awna wa Samood
ayahs.translation: [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamud?

ayahs.arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Balil lazeena kafaroo fee takzeeb
ayahs.translation: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Wallaahu minw waraaa'ihim muheet
ayahs.translation: While Allah encompasses them from behind.

ayahs.arabic: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌۭ مَّجِيدٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Bal huwa Quraanum Majeed
ayahs.translation: But this is an honored Qur'an

ayahs.arabic: فِى لَوْحٍۢ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Fee Lawhim Mahfooz
ayahs.translation: [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate.

59.arabicText: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ ۝١ وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ ۝٢ ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ ۝٣ إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌۭ ۝٤ فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ ۝٥ خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍۢ دَافِقٍۢ ۝٦ يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ ۝٧ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌۭ ۝٨
59.transliteration: Wassamaaa'i wattaariq (1) Wa maaa adraaka mattaariq (2) Annajmus saaqib (3) In kullu nafsil lammaa 'alaihaa haafiz (4) Fal yanzuril insaanu mimma khuliq (5) Khuliqa mim maaa'in daafiq (6) Yakhruju mim bainissulbi wat taraaa'ib (7) Innahoo 'alaa raj'ihee laqaadir (8)
59.translationEn: By the sky and the night comer - [1] And what can make you know what is the night comer? [2] It is the piercing star - [3] There is no soul but that it has over it a protector. [4] So let man observe from what he was created. [5] He was created from a fluid, ejected, [6] Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs. [7] Indeed, Allah, to return him [to life], is Able. [8]

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wassamaaa'i wattaariq
ayahs.translation: By the sky and the night comer -

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maaa adraaka mattaariq
ayahs.translation: And what can make you know what is the night comer?

ayahs.arabic: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
ayahs.transliteration: Annajmus saaqib
ayahs.translation: It is the piercing star -

ayahs.arabic: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: In kullu nafsil lammaa 'alaihaa haafiz
ayahs.translation: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.

ayahs.arabic: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
ayahs.transliteration: Fal yanzuril insaanu mimma khuliq
ayahs.translation: So let man observe from what he was created.

ayahs.arabic: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍۢ دَافِقٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Khuliqa mim maaa'in daafiq
ayahs.translation: He was created from a fluid, ejected,

ayahs.arabic: يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
ayahs.transliteration: Yakhruju mim bainissulbi wat taraaa'ib
ayahs.translation: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Innahoo 'alaa raj'ihee laqaadir
ayahs.translation: Indeed, Allah, to return him [to life], is Able.

60.arabicText: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ ۝٩ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍۢ وَلَا نَاصِرٍۢ ۝١٠ وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ ۝١١ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ ۝١٢ إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌۭ فَصْلٌۭ ۝١٣ وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ ۝١٤ إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا ۝١٥ وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًۭا ۝١٦ فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا ۝١٧
60.transliteration: Yawma tublas saraaa'ir (9) Famaa lahoo min quwwatinw wa laa naasir (10) Wassamaaa'i zaatir raj' (11) Wal ardi zaatis sad' (12) Innahoo laqawlun fasl (13) Wa maa huwa bil hazl (14) Innahum yakeedoona kaidaa (15) Wa akeedu kaidaa (16) Famahhilil kaafireena amhilhum ruwaidaa (17)
60.translationEn: The Day when secrets will be put on trial, [9] Then man will have no power or any helper. [10] By the sky which returns [rain] [11] And [by] the earth which cracks open, [12] Indeed, the Qur'an is a decisive statement, [13] And it is not amusement. [14] Indeed, they are planning a plan, [15] But I am planning a plan. [16] So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile. [17]

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma tublas saraaa'ir
ayahs.translation: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍۢ وَلَا نَاصِرٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Famaa lahoo min quwwatinw wa laa naasir
ayahs.translation: Then man will have no power or any helper.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wassamaaa'i zaatir raj'
ayahs.translation: By the sky which returns [rain]

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wal ardi zaatis sad'
ayahs.translation: And [by] the earth which cracks open,

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌۭ فَصْلٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Innahoo laqawlun fasl
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the Qur'an is a decisive statement,

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa huwa bil hazl
ayahs.translation: And it is not amusement.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Innahum yakeedoona kaidaa
ayahs.translation: Indeed, they are planning a plan,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa akeedu kaidaa
ayahs.translation: But I am planning a plan.

ayahs.arabic: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا
ayahs.transliteration: Famahhilil kaafireena amhilhum ruwaidaa
ayahs.translation: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.

61.arabicText: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ ۝١ وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ ۝٢ وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ ۝٣ وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ ۝٤ وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ ۝٥ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًۭا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ ۝٦ فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ ۝٧ فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًۭا يَسِيرًۭا ۝٨ وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًۭا ۝٩ وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ ۝١٠ فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًۭا ۝١١ وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا ۝١٢
61.transliteration: Izas samaaa'un shaqqat (1) Wa azinat li Rabbihaa wa huqqat (2) Wa izal ardu muddat (3) Wa alqat maa feehaa wa takhallat (4) Wa azinat li Rabbihaa wa huqqat (5) Yaaa ayyuhal insaanu innaka kaadihun ilaa Rabbika kad han famulaaqeeh (6) Fa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo biyameenih (7) Fasawfa yuhaasabu hi saabai yaseeraa (8) Wa yanqalibu ilaaa ahlihee masrooraa (9) Wa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo waraaa'a zahrih (10) Fasawfa yad'oo subooraa (11) Wa yaslaa sa'eeraa (12)
61.translationEn: When the sky has split [open] [1] And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] [2] And when the earth has been extended [3] And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it] [4] And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] - [5] O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it. [6] Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand, [7] He will be judged with an easy account [8] And return to his people in happiness. [9] But as for he who is given his record behind his back, [10] He will cry out for destruction [11] And [enter to] burn in a Blaze. [12]

ayahs.arabic: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Izas samaaa'un shaqqat
ayahs.translation: When the sky has split [open]

ayahs.arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa azinat li Rabbihaa wa huqqat
ayahs.translation: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izal ardu muddat
ayahs.translation: And when the earth has been extended

ayahs.arabic: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa alqat maa feehaa wa takhallat
ayahs.translation: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]

ayahs.arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa azinat li Rabbihaa wa huqqat
ayahs.translation: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] -

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًۭا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
ayahs.transliteration: Yaaa ayyuhal insaanu innaka kaadihun ilaa Rabbika kad han famulaaqeeh
ayahs.translation: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo biyameenih
ayahs.translation: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,

ayahs.arabic: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًۭا يَسِيرًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Fasawfa yuhaasabu hi saabai yaseeraa
ayahs.translation: He will be judged with an easy account

ayahs.arabic: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa yanqalibu ilaaa ahlihee masrooraa
ayahs.translation: And return to his people in happiness.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo waraaa'a zahrih
ayahs.translation: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,

ayahs.arabic: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Fasawfa yad'oo subooraa
ayahs.translation: He will cry out for destruction

ayahs.arabic: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa yaslaa sa'eeraa
ayahs.translation: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.

62.arabicText: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا ۝١٣ إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ ۝١٤ بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًۭا ۝١٥ فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ ۝١٦ وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ ۝١٧ وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ ۝١٨ لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍۢ ۝١٩ فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ ۝٢٠ وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩ ۝٢١ بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ ۝٢٢ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ ۝٢٣ فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ ۝٢٤ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ ۝٢٥
62.transliteration: Innahoo kaana feee ahlihee masrooraa (13) Innahoo zanna al lai yahoor (14) Balaaa inna Rabbahoo kaana bihee baseeraa (15) Falaaa uqsimu bishshafaq (16) Wallaili wa maa wasaq (17) Walqamari izat tasaq (18) Latarkabunna tabaqan 'an tabaq (19) Famaa lahum laa yu'minoon (20) Wa izaa quri'a 'alaihimul Quraanu laa yasjudoon (21) Balil lazeena kafaroo yukazziboon (22) Wallaahu a'lamu bimaa yoo'oon (23) Fabashshirhum bi'azaabin aleem (24) Illal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati lahum ajrun ghairu mamnoon (25)
62.translationEn: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness; [13] Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allah]. [14] But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever of him, Seeing. [15] So I swear by the twilight glow [16] And [by] the night and what it envelops [17] And [by] the moon when it becomes full [18] [That] you will surely experience state after state. [19] So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe, [20] And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allah]? [21] But those who have disbelieved deny, [22] And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves. [23] So give them tidings of a painful punishment, [24] Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted. [25]

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
ayahs.transliteration: Innahoo kaana feee ahlihee masrooraa
ayahs.translation: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
ayahs.transliteration: Innahoo zanna al lai yahoor
ayahs.translation: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allah].

ayahs.arabic: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Balaaa inna Rabbahoo kaana bihee baseeraa
ayahs.translation: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever of him, Seeing.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
ayahs.transliteration: Falaaa uqsimu bishshafaq
ayahs.translation: So I swear by the twilight glow

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wallaili wa maa wasaq
ayahs.translation: And [by] the night and what it envelops

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
ayahs.transliteration: Walqamari izat tasaq
ayahs.translation: And [by] the moon when it becomes full

ayahs.arabic: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Latarkabunna tabaqan 'an tabaq
ayahs.translation: [That] you will surely experience state after state.

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Famaa lahum laa yu'minoon
ayahs.translation: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izaa quri'a 'alaihimul Quraanu laa yasjudoon
ayahs.translation: And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allah]?

ayahs.arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Balil lazeena kafaroo yukazziboon
ayahs.translation: But those who have disbelieved deny,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wallaahu a'lamu bimaa yoo'oon
ayahs.translation: And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.

ayahs.arabic: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabashshirhum bi'azaabin aleem
ayahs.translation: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Illal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati lahum ajrun ghairu mamnoon
ayahs.translation: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.

63.arabicText: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ ۝١ وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ ۝٢ ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ ۝٣ إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌۭ ۝٤ فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ ۝٥ خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍۢ دَافِقٍۢ ۝٦ يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ ۝٧ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌۭ ۝٨ يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ ۝٩ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍۢ وَلَا نَاصِرٍۢ ۝١٠ وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ ۝١١ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ ۝١٢ إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌۭ فَصْلٌۭ ۝١٣ وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ ۝١٤ إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا ۝١٥ وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًۭا ۝١٦ فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا ۝١٧
63.transliteration: Wassamaaa'i wattaariq (1) Wa maaa adraaka mattaariq (2) Annajmus saaqib (3) In kullu nafsil lammaa 'alaihaa haafiz (4) Fal yanzuril insaanu mimma khuliq (5) Khuliqa mim maaa'in daafiq (6) Yakhruju mim bainissulbi wat taraaa'ib (7) Innahoo 'alaa raj'ihee laqaadir (8) Yawma tublas saraaa'ir (9) Famaa lahoo min quwwatinw wa laa naasir (10) Wassamaaa'i zaatir raj' (11) Wal ardi zaatis sad' (12) Innahoo laqawlun fasl (13) Wa maa huwa bil hazl (14) Innahum yakeedoona kaidaa (15) Wa akeedu kaidaa (16) Famahhilil kaafireena amhilhum ruwaidaa (17)
63.translationEn: By the sky and the night comer - [1] And what can make you know what is the night comer? [2] It is the piercing star - [3] There is no soul but that it has over it a protector. [4] So let man observe from what he was created. [5] He was created from a fluid, ejected, [6] Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs. [7] Indeed, Allah, to return him [to life], is Able. [8] The Day when secrets will be put on trial, [9] Then man will have no power or any helper. [10] By the sky which returns [rain] [11] And [by] the earth which cracks open, [12] Indeed, the Qur'an is a decisive statement, [13] And it is not amusement. [14] Indeed, they are planning a plan, [15] But I am planning a plan. [16] So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile. [17]

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wassamaaa'i wattaariq
ayahs.translation: By the sky and the night comer -

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maaa adraaka mattaariq
ayahs.translation: And what can make you know what is the night comer?

ayahs.arabic: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
ayahs.transliteration: Annajmus saaqib
ayahs.translation: It is the piercing star -

ayahs.arabic: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: In kullu nafsil lammaa 'alaihaa haafiz
ayahs.translation: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.

ayahs.arabic: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
ayahs.transliteration: Fal yanzuril insaanu mimma khuliq
ayahs.translation: So let man observe from what he was created.

ayahs.arabic: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍۢ دَافِقٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Khuliqa mim maaa'in daafiq
ayahs.translation: He was created from a fluid, ejected,

ayahs.arabic: يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
ayahs.transliteration: Yakhruju mim bainissulbi wat taraaa'ib
ayahs.translation: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Innahoo 'alaa raj'ihee laqaadir
ayahs.translation: Indeed, Allah, to return him [to life], is Able.

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma tublas saraaa'ir
ayahs.translation: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍۢ وَلَا نَاصِرٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Famaa lahoo min quwwatinw wa laa naasir
ayahs.translation: Then man will have no power or any helper.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wassamaaa'i zaatir raj'
ayahs.translation: By the sky which returns [rain]

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wal ardi zaatis sad'
ayahs.translation: And [by] the earth which cracks open,

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌۭ فَصْلٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Innahoo laqawlun fasl
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the Qur'an is a decisive statement,

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa huwa bil hazl
ayahs.translation: And it is not amusement.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Innahum yakeedoona kaidaa
ayahs.translation: Indeed, they are planning a plan,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa akeedu kaidaa
ayahs.translation: But I am planning a plan.

ayahs.arabic: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا
ayahs.transliteration: Famahhilil kaafireena amhilhum ruwaidaa
ayahs.translation: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.

64.arabicText: وَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ ۝١ ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ ۝٢ وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ ۝٣ أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ ۝٤ لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ ۝٥ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ ۝٦ كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍۢ ۝٧ وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌۭ ۝٨ كِتَٰبٌۭ مَّرْقُومٌۭ ۝٩ وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ۝١٠ ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ ۝١١ وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ ۝١٢ إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ۝١٣ كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ ۝١٤ كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ ۝١٥ ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ ۝١٦ ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ ۝١٧
64.transliteration: Wailul lil mutaffifeen (1) Allazeena izak taaloo 'alan naasi yastawfoon (2) Wa izaa kaaloohum aw wazanoohum yukhsiroon (3) Alaa yazunnu ulaaa'ika annahum mab'oosoon (4) Li Yawmin 'Azeem (5) Yawma yaqoomun naasu li Rabbil 'aalameen (6) Kallaaa inna kitaabal fujjaari lafee Sijjeen (7) Wa maa adraaka maa Sijjeen (8) Kitaabum marqoom (9) Wailuny yawma'izil lil mukazzibeen (10) Allazeena yukazziboona bi yawmid deen (11) Wa maa yukazzibu biheee illaa kullu mu'tadin aseem (12) Izaa tutlaa'alaihi aayaatunaa qaala asaateerul awwaleen (13) Kallaa bal raana 'alaa quloobihim maa kaanoo yaksiboon (14) Kallaaa innahum 'ar Rabbihim yawma'izil lamah jooboon (15) Summa innahum lasaa lul jaheem (16) Summa yuqaalu haazal lazee kuntum bihee tukazziboon (17)
64.translationEn: Woe to those who give less [than due], [1] Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full. [2] But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss. [3] Do they not think that they will be resurrected [4] For a tremendous Day - [5] The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds? [6] No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen. [7] And what can make you know what is sijjeen? [8] It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed. [9] Woe, that Day, to the deniers, [10] Who deny the Day of Recompense. [11] And none deny it except every sinful transgressor. [12] When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples." [13] No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning. [14] No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned. [15] Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire. [16] Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny." [17]

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wailul lil mutaffifeen
ayahs.translation: Woe to those who give less [than due],

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Allazeena izak taaloo 'alan naasi yastawfoon
ayahs.translation: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izaa kaaloohum aw wazanoohum yukhsiroon
ayahs.translation: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Alaa yazunnu ulaaa'ika annahum mab'oosoon
ayahs.translation: Do they not think that they will be resurrected

ayahs.arabic: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Li Yawmin 'Azeem
ayahs.translation: For a tremendous Day -

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma yaqoomun naasu li Rabbil 'aalameen
ayahs.translation: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Kallaaa inna kitaabal fujjaari lafee Sijjeen
ayahs.translation: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa adraaka maa Sijjeen
ayahs.translation: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?

ayahs.arabic: كِتَٰبٌۭ مَّرْقُومٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Kitaabum marqoom
ayahs.translation: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wailuny yawma'izil lil mukazzibeen
ayahs.translation: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Allazeena yukazziboona bi yawmid deen
ayahs.translation: Who deny the Day of Recompense.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa yukazzibu biheee illaa kullu mu'tadin aseem
ayahs.translation: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.

ayahs.arabic: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Izaa tutlaa'alaihi aayaatunaa qaala asaateerul awwaleen
ayahs.translation: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Kallaa bal raana 'alaa quloobihim maa kaanoo yaksiboon
ayahs.translation: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Kallaaa innahum 'ar Rabbihim yawma'izil lamah jooboon
ayahs.translation: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.transliteration: Summa innahum lasaa lul jaheem
ayahs.translation: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Summa yuqaalu haazal lazee kuntum bihee tukazziboon
ayahs.translation: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."

65.arabicText: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ ۝١٨ وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ ۝١٩ كِتَٰبٌۭ مَّرْقُومٌۭ ۝٢٠ يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ ۝٢١ إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ ۝٢٢ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ ۝٢٣ تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ ۝٢٤ يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍۢ مَّخْتُومٍ ۝٢٥ خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌۭ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ ۝٢٦ وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ ۝٢٧ عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ ۝٢٨ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ ۝٢٩ وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ ۝٣٠ وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ ۝٣١ وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ ۝٣٢ وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَٰفِظِينَ ۝٣٣ فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ ۝٣٤ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ ۝٣٥ هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ ۝٣٦
65.transliteration: Kallaaa inna kitaabal abraari lafee'Illiyyeen (18) Wa maaa adraaka maa 'Illiyyoon (19) Kitaabum marqoom (20) Yashhadu hul muqarra boon (21) Innal abraara lafee Na'eem (22) 'Alal araaa'iki yanzuroon (23) Ta'rifu fee wujoohihim nadratan na'eem (24) Yusqawna mir raheeqim makhtoom (25) Khitaamuhoo misk; wa fee zaalika falyatanaafasil Mutanaafisoon (26) Wa mizaajuhoo min Tasneem (27) 'Ainaiy yashrabu bihal muqarraboon (28) Innal lazeena ajramoo kaanoo minal lazeena aamanoo yadhakoon (29) Wa izaa marroo bihim yataghaamazoon (30) Wa izan qalabooo ilaaa ahlihimun qalaboo fakiheen (31) Wa izaa ra awhum qaalooo inna haaa'ulaaa'i ladaaal loon (32) Wa maaa ursiloo 'alaihim haafizeen (33) Fal yawmal lazeena aamanoo minal kuffaari yadhakoon (34) 'Alal araaa'iki yanzuroon (35) Hal suwwibal kuffaaru maa kaanoo yaf'aloon (36)
65.translationEn: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'illiyyun. [18] And what can make you know what is 'illiyyun? [19] It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed [20] Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allah]. [21] Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure [22] On adorned couches, observing. [23] You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure. [24] They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed. [25] The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete. [26] And its mixture is of Tasneem, [27] A spring from which those near [to Allah] drink. [28] Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed. [29] And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances. [30] And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting. [31] And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost." [32] But they had not been sent as guardians over them. [33] So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers, [34] On adorned couches, observing. [35] Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do? [36]

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Kallaaa inna kitaabal abraari lafee'Illiyyeen
ayahs.translation: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'illiyyun.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maaa adraaka maa 'Illiyyoon
ayahs.translation: And what can make you know what is 'illiyyun?

ayahs.arabic: كِتَٰبٌۭ مَّرْقُومٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Kitaabum marqoom
ayahs.translation: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed

ayahs.arabic: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Yashhadu hul muqarra boon
ayahs.translation: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allah].

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
ayahs.transliteration: Innal abraara lafee Na'eem
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure

ayahs.arabic: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: 'Alal araaa'iki yanzuroon
ayahs.translation: On adorned couches, observing.

ayahs.arabic: تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayahs.transliteration: Ta'rifu fee wujoohihim nadratan na'eem
ayahs.translation: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.

ayahs.arabic: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍۢ مَّخْتُومٍ
ayahs.transliteration: Yusqawna mir raheeqim makhtoom
ayahs.translation: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.

ayahs.arabic: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌۭ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Khitaamuhoo misk; wa fee zaalika falyatanaafasil Mutanaafisoon
ayahs.translation: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.

ayahs.arabic: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa mizaajuhoo min Tasneem
ayahs.translation: And its mixture is of Tasneem,

ayahs.arabic: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: 'Ainaiy yashrabu bihal muqarraboon
ayahs.translation: A spring from which those near [to Allah] drink.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Innal lazeena ajramoo kaanoo minal lazeena aamanoo yadhakoon
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izaa marroo bihim yataghaamazoon
ayahs.translation: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izan qalabooo ilaaa ahlihimun qalaboo fakiheen
ayahs.translation: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izaa ra awhum qaalooo inna haaa'ulaaa'i ladaaal loon
ayahs.translation: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَٰفِظِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maaa ursiloo 'alaihim haafizeen
ayahs.translation: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Fal yawmal lazeena aamanoo minal kuffaari yadhakoon
ayahs.translation: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,

ayahs.arabic: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: 'Alal araaa'iki yanzuroon
ayahs.translation: On adorned couches, observing.

ayahs.arabic: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Hal suwwibal kuffaaru maa kaanoo yaf'aloon
ayahs.translation: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?

66.arabicText: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ ۝١ وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ ۝٢ وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ ۝٣ وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ ۝٤ عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ ۝٥ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ ۝٦ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ ۝٧ فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍۢ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ ۝٨ كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ ۝٩ وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَٰفِظِينَ ۝١٠
66.transliteration: Izas samaaa'un fatarat (1) Wa izal kawaakibun tasarat (2) Wa izal bihaaru fujjirat (3) Wa izal qubooru bu'sirat (4) 'Alimat nafsum maa qaddamat wa akhkharat (5) Yaaa ayyuhal insaaanu maa gharraka bi Rabbikal kareem (6) Allazee khalaqaka fasaw waaka fa'adalak (7) Feee ayye sooratim maa shaaa'a rakkabak (8) Kalla bal tukazziboona bid deen (9) Wa inna 'alaikum lahaa fizeen (10)
66.translationEn: When the sky breaks apart [1] And when the stars fall, scattering, [2] And when the seas are erupted [3] And when the [contents of] graves are scattered, [4] A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back. [5] O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous, [6] Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you? [7] In whatever form He willed has He assembled you. [8] No! But you deny the Recompense. [9] And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers, [10]

ayahs.arabic: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Izas samaaa'un fatarat
ayahs.translation: When the sky breaks apart

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izal kawaakibun tasarat
ayahs.translation: And when the stars fall, scattering,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izal bihaaru fujjirat
ayahs.translation: And when the seas are erupted

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izal qubooru bu'sirat
ayahs.translation: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered,

ayahs.arabic: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
ayahs.transliteration: 'Alimat nafsum maa qaddamat wa akhkharat
ayahs.translation: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
ayahs.transliteration: Yaaa ayyuhal insaaanu maa gharraka bi Rabbikal kareem
ayahs.translation: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
ayahs.transliteration: Allazee khalaqaka fasaw waaka fa'adalak
ayahs.translation: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?

ayahs.arabic: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍۢ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
ayahs.transliteration: Feee ayye sooratim maa shaaa'a rakkabak
ayahs.translation: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Kalla bal tukazziboona bid deen
ayahs.translation: No! But you deny the Recompense.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَٰفِظِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa inna 'alaikum lahaa fizeen
ayahs.translation: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,

67.arabicText: كِرَامًۭا كَٰتِبِينَ ۝١١ يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ ۝١٢ إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍۢ ۝١٣ وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍۢ ۝١٤ يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ ۝١٥ وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ ۝١٦ وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ ۝١٧ ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ ۝١٨ يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌۭ لِّنَفْسٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلَّهِ ۝١٩
67.transliteration: Kiraaman kaatibeen (11) Ya'lamoona ma taf'aloon (12) Innal abraara lafee na'eem (13) Wa innal fujjaara lafee jaheem (14) Yaslawnahaa Yawmad Deen (15) Wa maa hum 'anhaa bighaaa 'ibeen (16) Wa maaa adraaka maa Yawmud Deen (17) Summa maaa adraaka maa Yawmud Deen (18) Yawma laa tamliku nafsul linafsin shai'anw walamru yawma'izil lillaah (19)
67.translationEn: Noble and recording; [11] They know whatever you do. [12] Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure, [13] And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire. [14] They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense, [15] And never therefrom will they be absent. [16] And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense? [17] Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense? [18] It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah. [19]

ayahs.arabic: كِرَامًۭا كَٰتِبِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Kiraaman kaatibeen
ayahs.translation: Noble and recording;

ayahs.arabic: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Ya'lamoona ma taf'aloon
ayahs.translation: They know whatever you do.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Innal abraara lafee na'eem
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa innal fujjaara lafee jaheem
ayahs.translation: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.

ayahs.arabic: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Yaslawnahaa Yawmad Deen
ayahs.translation: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa hum 'anhaa bighaaa 'ibeen
ayahs.translation: And never therefrom will they be absent.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maaa adraaka maa Yawmud Deen
ayahs.translation: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Summa maaa adraaka maa Yawmud Deen
ayahs.translation: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌۭ لِّنَفْسٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلَّهِ
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma laa tamliku nafsul linafsin shai'anw walamru yawma'izil lillaah
ayahs.translation: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah.

68.arabicText: إِذَا ٱلشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ ۝١ وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتْ ۝٢ وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ ۝٣ وَإِذَا ٱلْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ ۝٤ وَإِذَا ٱلْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ ۝٥ وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ ۝٦ وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ ۝٧ وَإِذَا ٱلْمَوْءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتْ ۝٨ بِأَىِّ ذَنۢبٍۢ قُتِلَتْ ۝٩ وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ ۝١٠ وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتْ ۝١١ وَإِذَا ٱلْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ ۝١٢ وَإِذَا ٱلْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ ۝١٣ عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّآ أَحْضَرَتْ ۝١٤
68.transliteration: Izash shamsu kuwwirat (1) Wa izan nujoomun kadarat (2) Wa izal jibaalu suyyirat (3) Wa izal 'ishaaru 'uttilat (4) Wa izal wuhooshu hushirat (5) Wa izal bihaaru sujjirat (6) Wa izan nufoosu zuwwijat (7) Wa izal maw'oodatu su'ilat (8) Bi ayyi zambin qutilat (9) Wa izas suhufu nushirat (10) Wa izas samaaa'u kushitat (11) Wa izal jaheemu su'-'irat (12) Wa izal jannatu uzlifat (13) 'Alimat nafsum maaa ahdarat (14)
68.translationEn: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness] [1] And when the stars fall, dispersing, [2] And when the mountains are removed [3] And when full-term she-camels are neglected [4] And when the wild beasts are gathered [5] And when the seas are filled with flame [6] And when the souls are paired [7] And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked [8] For what sin she was killed [9] And when the pages are made public [10] And when the sky is stripped away [11] And when Hellfire is set ablaze [12] And when Paradise is brought near, [13] A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it]. [14]

ayahs.arabic: إِذَا ٱلشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Izash shamsu kuwwirat
ayahs.translation: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izan nujoomun kadarat
ayahs.translation: And when the stars fall, dispersing,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izal jibaalu suyyirat
ayahs.translation: And when the mountains are removed

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izal 'ishaaru 'uttilat
ayahs.translation: And when full-term she-camels are neglected

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izal wuhooshu hushirat
ayahs.translation: And when the wild beasts are gathered

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izal bihaaru sujjirat
ayahs.translation: And when the seas are filled with flame

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izan nufoosu zuwwijat
ayahs.translation: And when the souls are paired

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْمَوْءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izal maw'oodatu su'ilat
ayahs.translation: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked

ayahs.arabic: بِأَىِّ ذَنۢبٍۢ قُتِلَتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Bi ayyi zambin qutilat
ayahs.translation: For what sin she was killed

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izas suhufu nushirat
ayahs.translation: And when the pages are made public

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izas samaaa'u kushitat
ayahs.translation: And when the sky is stripped away

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izal jaheemu su'-'irat
ayahs.translation: And when Hellfire is set ablaze

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izal jannatu uzlifat
ayahs.translation: And when Paradise is brought near,

ayahs.arabic: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّآ أَحْضَرَتْ
ayahs.transliteration: 'Alimat nafsum maaa ahdarat
ayahs.translation: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].

69.arabicText: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلْخُنَّسِ ۝١٥ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْكُنَّسِ ۝١٦ وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ ۝١٧ وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ ۝١٨ إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ ۝١٩ ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍۢ ۝٢٠ مُّطَاعٍۢ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍۢ ۝٢١ وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍۢ ۝٢٢ وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ ۝٢٣ وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍۢ ۝٢٤ وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ رَّجِيمٍۢ ۝٢٥ فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ ۝٢٦ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ ۝٢٧ لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ ۝٢٨ وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ ۝٢٩
69.transliteration: Falaaa uqsimu bil khunnas (15) Al jawaaril kunnas (16) Wallaili izaa 'as'as (17) Wassubhi izaa tanaffas (18) Innahoo laqawlu rasoolin kareem (19) Zee quwwatin 'inda zil 'arshi makeen (20) Mutaa'in samma ameen (21) Wa maa saahibukum bimajnoon (22) Wa laqad ra aahu bilufuqil mubeen (23) Wa maa huwa 'alal ghaibi bidaneen (24) Wa maa huwa biqawli shaitaanir rajeem (25) Fa ayna tazhaboon (26) In huwa illaa zikrul lil'aalameen (27) Liman shaaa'a minkum ai yastaqeem (28) Wa maa tashaaa'oona illaaa ai yashaaa 'al laahu Rabbul 'Aalameen (29)
69.translationEn: So I swear by the retreating stars - [15] Those that run [their courses] and disappear - [16] And by the night as it closes in [17] And by the dawn when it breathes [18] [That] indeed, the Qur'an is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger [19] [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position], [20] Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy. [21] And your companion is not [at all] mad. [22] And he has already seen Gabriel in the clear horizon. [23] And Muhammad is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen. [24] And the Qur'an is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens]. [25] So where are you going? [26] It is not except a reminder to the worlds [27] For whoever wills among you to take a right course. [28] And you do not will except that Allah wills - Lord of the worlds. [29]

ayahs.arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلْخُنَّسِ
ayahs.transliteration: Falaaa uqsimu bil khunnas
ayahs.translation: So I swear by the retreating stars -

ayahs.arabic: ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْكُنَّسِ
ayahs.transliteration: Al jawaaril kunnas
ayahs.translation: Those that run [their courses] and disappear -

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wallaili izaa 'as'as
ayahs.translation: And by the night as it closes in

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wassubhi izaa tanaffas
ayahs.translation: And by the dawn when it breathes

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Innahoo laqawlu rasoolin kareem
ayahs.translation: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger

ayahs.arabic: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Zee quwwatin 'inda zil 'arshi makeen
ayahs.translation: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],

ayahs.arabic: مُّطَاعٍۢ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Mutaa'in samma ameen
ayahs.translation: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa saahibukum bimajnoon
ayahs.translation: And your companion is not [at all] mad.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa laqad ra aahu bilufuqil mubeen
ayahs.translation: And he has already seen Gabriel in the clear horizon.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa huwa 'alal ghaibi bidaneen
ayahs.translation: And Muhammad is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ رَّجِيمٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa huwa biqawli shaitaanir rajeem
ayahs.translation: And the Qur'an is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].

ayahs.arabic: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa ayna tazhaboon
ayahs.translation: So where are you going?

ayahs.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: In huwa illaa zikrul lil'aalameen
ayahs.translation: It is not except a reminder to the worlds

ayahs.arabic: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
ayahs.transliteration: Liman shaaa'a minkum ai yastaqeem
ayahs.translation: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa tashaaa'oona illaaa ai yashaaa 'al laahu Rabbul 'Aalameen
ayahs.translation: And you do not will except that Allah wills - Lord of the worlds.

70.arabicText: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ ۝١ وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ ۝٢ وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ ۝٣ وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ ۝٤ عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ ۝٥ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ ۝٦ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ ۝٧ فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍۢ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ ۝٨ كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ ۝٩ وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَٰفِظِينَ ۝١٠ كِرَامًۭا كَٰتِبِينَ ۝١١ يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ ۝١٢ إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍۢ ۝١٣ وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍۢ ۝١٤ يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ ۝١٥ وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ ۝١٦ وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ ۝١٧ ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ ۝١٨ يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌۭ لِّنَفْسٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلَّهِ ۝١٩
