70.transliteration: Izas samaaa'un fatarat (1) Wa izal kawaakibun tasarat (2) Wa izal bihaaru fujjirat (3) Wa izal qubooru bu'sirat (4) 'Alimat nafsum maa qaddamat wa akhkharat (5) Yaaa ayyuhal insaaanu maa gharraka bi Rabbikal kareem (6) Allazee khalaqaka fasaw waaka fa'adalak (7) Feee ayye sooratim maa shaaa'a rakkabak (8) Kalla bal tukazziboona bid deen (9) Wa inna 'alaikum lahaa fizeen (10) Kiraaman kaatibeen (11) Ya'lamoona ma taf'aloon (12) Innal abraara lafee na'eem (13) Wa innal fujjaara lafee jaheem (14) Yaslawnahaa Yawmad Deen (15) Wa maa hum 'anhaa bighaaa 'ibeen (16) Wa maaa adraaka maa Yawmud Deen (17) Summa maaa adraaka maa Yawmud Deen (18) Yawma laa tamliku nafsul linafsin shai'anw walamru yawma'izil lillaah (19)
70.translationEn: When the sky breaks apart [1] And when the stars fall, scattering, [2] And when the seas are erupted [3] And when the [contents of] graves are scattered, [4] A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back. [5] O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous, [6] Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you? [7] In whatever form He willed has He assembled you. [8] No! But you deny the Recompense. [9] And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers, [10] Noble and recording; [11] They know whatever you do. [12] Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure, [13] And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire. [14] They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense, [15] And never therefrom will they be absent. [16] And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense? [17] Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense? [18] It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah. [19]

ayahs.arabic: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Izas samaaa'un fatarat
ayahs.translation: When the sky breaks apart

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izal kawaakibun tasarat
ayahs.translation: And when the stars fall, scattering,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izal bihaaru fujjirat
ayahs.translation: And when the seas are erupted

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izal qubooru bu'sirat
ayahs.translation: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered,

ayahs.arabic: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
ayahs.transliteration: 'Alimat nafsum maa qaddamat wa akhkharat
ayahs.translation: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
ayahs.transliteration: Yaaa ayyuhal insaaanu maa gharraka bi Rabbikal kareem
ayahs.translation: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
ayahs.transliteration: Allazee khalaqaka fasaw waaka fa'adalak
ayahs.translation: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?

ayahs.arabic: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍۢ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
ayahs.transliteration: Feee ayye sooratim maa shaaa'a rakkabak
ayahs.translation: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Kalla bal tukazziboona bid deen
ayahs.translation: No! But you deny the Recompense.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَٰفِظِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa inna 'alaikum lahaa fizeen
ayahs.translation: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,

ayahs.arabic: كِرَامًۭا كَٰتِبِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Kiraaman kaatibeen
ayahs.translation: Noble and recording;

ayahs.arabic: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Ya'lamoona ma taf'aloon
ayahs.translation: They know whatever you do.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Innal abraara lafee na'eem
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa innal fujjaara lafee jaheem
ayahs.translation: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.

ayahs.arabic: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Yaslawnahaa Yawmad Deen
ayahs.translation: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa hum 'anhaa bighaaa 'ibeen
ayahs.translation: And never therefrom will they be absent.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maaa adraaka maa Yawmud Deen
ayahs.translation: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Summa maaa adraaka maa Yawmud Deen
ayahs.translation: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌۭ لِّنَفْسٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلَّهِ
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma laa tamliku nafsul linafsin shai'anw walamru yawma'izil lillaah
ayahs.translation: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah.

71.arabicText: عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ ۝١ عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ ۝٢ ٱلَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ ۝٣ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ ۝٤ ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ ۝٥ أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِهَٰدًۭا ۝٦ وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَوْتَادًۭا ۝٧ وَخَلَقْنَٰكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا ۝٨ وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًۭا ۝٩ وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًۭا ۝١٠ وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشًۭا ۝١١ وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًۭا شِدَادًۭا ۝١٢ وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًۭا وَهَّاجًۭا ۝١٣ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمُعْصِرَٰتِ مَآءًۭ ثَجَّاجًۭا ۝١٤ لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبًّۭا وَنَبَاتًۭا ۝١٥ وَجَنَّٰتٍ أَلْفَافًا ۝١٦ إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتًۭا ۝١٧ يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًۭا ۝١٨ وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَٰبًۭا ۝١٩ وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا ۝٢٠
71.transliteration: 'Amma Yatasaa-aloon (1) 'Anin-nabaa-il 'azeem (2) Allazi hum feehi mukh talifoon (3) Kallaa sa y'alamoon (4) Thumma kallaa sa y'alamoon (5) Alam naj'alil arda mihaa da (6) Wal jibaala au taada (7) Wa khalaq naakum azwaaja (8) Waja'alnan naumakum subata (9) Waja'alnal laila libasa (10) Waja'alnan nahara ma 'aasha (11) Wa banaina fauqakum sab 'an shi daada (12) Waja'alna siraajaw wah haaja (13) Wa anzalna minal m'usiraati maa-an saj-jaaja (14) Linukh rija bihee habbaw wana baata (15) Wa jan naatin alfafa (16) Inna yaumal-fasli kana miqaata (17) Yauma yun fakhu fis-soori fataa toona afwaaja (18) Wa futiha tis samaa-u fakaanat abwaaba (19) Wa suyyi raatil jibaalu fa kaanat saraaba (20)
71.translationEn: About what are they asking one another? [1] About the great news - [2] That over which they are in disagreement. [3] No! They are going to know. [4] Then, no! They are going to know. [5] Have We not made the earth a resting place? [6] And the mountains as stakes? [7] And We created you in pairs [8] And made your sleep [a means for] rest [9] And made the night as clothing [10] And made the day for livelihood [11] And constructed above you seven strong [heavens] [12] And made [therein] a burning lamp [13] And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water [14] That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation [15] And gardens of entwined growth. [16] Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time - [17] The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes [18] And the heaven is opened and will become gateways [19] And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage. [20]

ayahs.arabic: عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: 'Amma Yatasaa-aloon
ayahs.translation: About what are they asking one another?

ayahs.arabic: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
ayahs.transliteration: 'Anin-nabaa-il 'azeem
ayahs.translation: About the great news -

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Allazi hum feehi mukh talifoon
ayahs.translation: That over which they are in disagreement.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Kallaa sa y'alamoon
ayahs.translation: No! They are going to know.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Thumma kallaa sa y'alamoon
ayahs.translation: Then, no! They are going to know.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِهَٰدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Alam naj'alil arda mihaa da
ayahs.translation: Have We not made the earth a resting place?

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَوْتَادًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wal jibaala au taada
ayahs.translation: And the mountains as stakes?

ayahs.arabic: وَخَلَقْنَٰكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa khalaq naakum azwaaja
ayahs.translation: And We created you in pairs

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Waja'alnan naumakum subata
ayahs.translation: And made your sleep [a means for] rest

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Waja'alnal laila libasa
ayahs.translation: And made the night as clothing

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Waja'alnan nahara ma 'aasha
ayahs.translation: And made the day for livelihood

ayahs.arabic: وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًۭا شِدَادًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa banaina fauqakum sab 'an shi daada
ayahs.translation: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًۭا وَهَّاجًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Waja'alna siraajaw wah haaja
ayahs.translation: And made [therein] a burning lamp

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمُعْصِرَٰتِ مَآءًۭ ثَجَّاجًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa anzalna minal m'usiraati maa-an saj-jaaja
ayahs.translation: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water

ayahs.arabic: لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبًّۭا وَنَبَاتًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Linukh rija bihee habbaw wana baata
ayahs.translation: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation

ayahs.arabic: وَجَنَّٰتٍ أَلْفَافًا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa jan naatin alfafa
ayahs.translation: And gardens of entwined growth.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Inna yaumal-fasli kana miqaata
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Yauma yun fakhu fis-soori fataa toona afwaaja
ayahs.translation: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes

ayahs.arabic: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَٰبًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa futiha tis samaa-u fakaanat abwaaba
ayahs.translation: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways

ayahs.arabic: وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa suyyi raatil jibaalu fa kaanat saraaba
ayahs.translation: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.

72.arabicText: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًۭا ۝٢١ لِّلطَّٰغِينَ مَـَٔابًۭا ۝٢٢ لَّٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحْقَابًۭا ۝٢٣ لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًۭا وَلَا شَرَابًا ۝٢٤ إِلَّا حَمِيمًۭا وَغَسَّاقًۭا ۝٢٥ جَزَآءًۭ وِفَاقًا ۝٢٦ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًۭا ۝٢٧ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كِذَّابًۭا ۝٢٨ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ كِتَٰبًۭا ۝٢٩ فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا ۝٣٠ إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا ۝٣١ حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَٰبًۭا ۝٣٢ وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًۭا ۝٣٣ وَكَأْسًۭا دِهَاقًۭا ۝٣٤ لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًۭا ۝٣٥ جَزَآءًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًۭا ۝٣٦ رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًۭا ۝٣٧ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّۭا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًۭا ۝٣٨ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا ۝٣٩ إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَٰكُمْ عَذَابًۭا قَرِيبًۭا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا ۝٤٠
72.transliteration: Inna jahan nama kaanat mirsaada (21) Lit taa gheena ma aaba (22) Laa bitheena feehaa ahqaaba (23) Laa ya zooqoona feeha bar daw walaa sharaaba (24) Illa hamee maw-wa ghas saaqa (25) Jazaa-aw wi faaqa (26) Innahum kaanu laa yarjoona hisaaba (27) Wa kazzabu bi aayaa tina kizzaba (28) Wa kulla shai-in ahsai naahu kitaa ba (29) Fa zooqoo falan-nazee dakum ill-laa azaaba (30) Inna lil mutta qeena mafaaza (31) Hadaa-iqa wa a'anaa ba (32) Wa kaawa 'iba at raaba (33) Wa ka'san di haaqa (34) Laa yasma'oona fiha lagh waw walaa kizzaba (35) Jazaa-am mir-rabbika ataa-an hisaaba (36) Rabbis samaa waati wal ardi wa maa baina humar rahmaani laa yam likoona minhu khi taaba (37) Yauma yaqoo mur roohu wal malaa-ikatu saf-fal laa yata kalla moona illa man azina lahur rahmaanu wa qaala sawaaba (38) Zaalikal yaumul haqqu faman shaa-at ta khaaza ill-laa rabbihi ma-aaba (39) In naa anzar naakum azaaban qareebaiy-yauma yan zurul marr-u maa qaddamat yadaahu wa ya qoolul-kaafiru yaa lai tanee kuntu turaaba (40)
72.translationEn: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait [21] For the transgressors, a place of return, [22] In which they will remain for ages [unending]. [23] They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink [24] Except scalding water and [foul] purulence - [25] An appropriate recompense. [26] Indeed, they were not expecting an account [27] And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial. [28] But all things We have enumerated in writing. [29] "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment." [30] Indeed, for the righteous is attainment - [31] Gardens and grapevines [32] And full-breasted [companions] of equal age [33] And a full cup. [34] No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood - [35] [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account, [36] [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech. [37] The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct. [38] That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return. [39] Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!" [40]

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Inna jahan nama kaanat mirsaada
ayahs.translation: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait

ayahs.arabic: لِّلطَّٰغِينَ مَـَٔابًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Lit taa gheena ma aaba
ayahs.translation: For the transgressors, a place of return,

ayahs.arabic: لَّٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحْقَابًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Laa bitheena feehaa ahqaaba
ayahs.translation: In which they will remain for ages [unending].

ayahs.arabic: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًۭا وَلَا شَرَابًا
ayahs.transliteration: Laa ya zooqoona feeha bar daw walaa sharaaba
ayahs.translation: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا حَمِيمًۭا وَغَسَّاقًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Illa hamee maw-wa ghas saaqa
ayahs.translation: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -

ayahs.arabic: جَزَآءًۭ وِفَاقًا
ayahs.transliteration: Jazaa-aw wi faaqa
ayahs.translation: An appropriate recompense.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Innahum kaanu laa yarjoona hisaaba
ayahs.translation: Indeed, they were not expecting an account

ayahs.arabic: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كِذَّابًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa kazzabu bi aayaa tina kizzaba
ayahs.translation: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.

ayahs.arabic: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ كِتَٰبًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa kulla shai-in ahsai naahu kitaa ba
ayahs.translation: But all things We have enumerated in writing.

ayahs.arabic: فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
ayahs.transliteration: Fa zooqoo falan-nazee dakum ill-laa azaaba
ayahs.translation: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
ayahs.transliteration: Inna lil mutta qeena mafaaza
ayahs.translation: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -

ayahs.arabic: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَٰبًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Hadaa-iqa wa a'anaa ba
ayahs.translation: Gardens and grapevines

ayahs.arabic: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa kaawa 'iba at raaba
ayahs.translation: And full-breasted [companions] of equal age

ayahs.arabic: وَكَأْسًۭا دِهَاقًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ka'san di haaqa
ayahs.translation: And a full cup.

ayahs.arabic: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Laa yasma'oona fiha lagh waw walaa kizzaba
ayahs.translation: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -

ayahs.arabic: جَزَآءًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Jazaa-am mir-rabbika ataa-an hisaaba
ayahs.translation: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,

ayahs.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Rabbis samaa waati wal ardi wa maa baina humar rahmaani laa yam likoona minhu khi taaba
ayahs.translation: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّۭا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Yauma yaqoo mur roohu wal malaa-ikatu saf-fal laa yata kalla moona illa man azina lahur rahmaanu wa qaala sawaaba
ayahs.translation: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.

ayahs.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
ayahs.transliteration: Zaalikal yaumul haqqu faman shaa-at ta khaaza ill-laa rabbihi ma-aaba
ayahs.translation: That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَٰكُمْ عَذَابًۭا قَرِيبًۭا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
ayahs.transliteration: In naa anzar naakum azaaban qareebaiy-yauma yan zurul marr-u maa qaddamat yadaahu wa ya qoolul-kaafiru yaa lai tanee kuntu turaaba
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"

73.arabicText: وَٱلنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرْقًۭا ۝١ وَٱلنَّٰشِطَٰتِ نَشْطًۭا ۝٢ وَٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ سَبْحًۭا ۝٣ فَٱلسَّٰبِقَٰتِ سَبْقًۭا ۝٤ فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًۭا ۝٥ يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ ۝٦ تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ ۝٧ قُلُوبٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَاجِفَةٌ ۝٨ أَبْصَٰرُهَا خَٰشِعَةٌۭ ۝٩ يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ ۝١٠ أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمًۭا نَّخِرَةًۭ ۝١١ قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًۭا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌۭ ۝١٢ فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ ۝١٣ فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ ۝١٤ هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ ۝١٥ إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى ۝١٦ ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ ۝١٧ فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ ۝١٨ وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ ۝١٩ فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْءَايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ ۝٢٠ فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ ۝٢١ ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ ۝٢٢ فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ ۝٢٣ فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ ۝٢٤ فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ ۝٢٥ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ ۝٢٦
73.transliteration: Wan naazi 'aati gharqa (1) Wan naa shi taati nashta (2) Wass saabi-haati sabha (3) Fass saabi qaati sabqa (4) Fal mu dab-bi raati amra (5) Yawma tarjufur raajifa (6) Tatba'u har raadifa (7) Quloobuny-yau maaiziw-waaji-fa (8) Absaa ruhaa khashi'ah (9) Ya qoo loona a-inna lamar doo doona fil haafirah (10) Aizaa kunna 'izaa man-nakhirah (11) Qaalu tilka izan karratun khaasirah. (12) Fa inna ma hiya zajratuw-waahida (13) Faizaa hum biss saahirah (14) Hal ataaka hadeethu Musaa (15) Iz nadaahu rabbuhu bil waadil-muqad dasi tuwa (16) Izhab ilaa fir'auna innahu taghaa. (17) Faqul hal laka ilaa-an tazakka. (18) Wa ahdi yaka ila rabbika fatakh sha (19) Fa araahul-aayatal kubra. (20) Fa kazzaba wa asaa. (21) Thumma adbara yas'aa. (22) Fa hashara fanada. (23) Faqala ana rabbu kumul-a'laa. (24) Fa-akha zahul laahu nakalal aakhirati wal-oola. (25) Inna fee zaalika la'ibratal limaiy-yaksha (26)
73.translationEn: By those [angels] who extract with violence [1] And [by] those who remove with ease [2] And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming [3] And those who race each other in a race [4] And those who arrange [each] matter, [5] On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation], [6] There will follow it the subsequent [one]. [7] Hearts, that Day, will tremble, [8] Their eyes humbled. [9] They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]? [10] Even if we should be decayed bones? [11] They say, "That, then, would be a losing return." [12] Indeed, it will be but one shout, [13] And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface. [14] Has there reached you the story of Moses? - [15] When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa, [16] "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed. [17] And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself [18] And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'" [19] And he showed him the greatest sign, [20] But Pharaoh denied and disobeyed. [21] Then he turned his back, striving. [22] And he gathered [his people] and called out [23] And said, "I am your most exalted lord." [24] So Allah seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression]. [25] Indeed in that is a warning for whoever would fear [Allah]. [26]

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرْقًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wan naazi 'aati gharqa
ayahs.translation: By those [angels] who extract with violence

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلنَّٰشِطَٰتِ نَشْطًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wan naa shi taati nashta
ayahs.translation: And [by] those who remove with ease

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ سَبْحًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wass saabi-haati sabha
ayahs.translation: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلسَّٰبِقَٰتِ سَبْقًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Fass saabi qaati sabqa
ayahs.translation: And those who race each other in a race

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Fal mu dab-bi raati amra
ayahs.translation: And those who arrange [each] matter,

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma tarjufur raajifa
ayahs.translation: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],

ayahs.arabic: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
ayahs.transliteration: Tatba'u har raadifa
ayahs.translation: There will follow it the subsequent [one].

ayahs.arabic: قُلُوبٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَاجِفَةٌ
ayahs.transliteration: Quloobuny-yau maaiziw-waaji-fa
ayahs.translation: Hearts, that Day, will tremble,

ayahs.arabic: أَبْصَٰرُهَا خَٰشِعَةٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Absaa ruhaa khashi'ah
ayahs.translation: Their eyes humbled.

ayahs.arabic: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ
ayahs.transliteration: Ya qoo loona a-inna lamar doo doona fil haafirah
ayahs.translation: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?

ayahs.arabic: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمًۭا نَّخِرَةًۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Aizaa kunna 'izaa man-nakhirah
ayahs.translation: Even if we should be decayed bones?

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًۭا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Qaalu tilka izan karratun khaasirah.
ayahs.translation: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa inna ma hiya zajratuw-waahida
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it will be but one shout,

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
ayahs.transliteration: Faizaa hum biss saahirah
ayahs.translation: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.

ayahs.arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Hal ataaka hadeethu Musaa
ayahs.translation: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
ayahs.transliteration: Iz nadaahu rabbuhu bil waadil-muqad dasi tuwa
ayahs.translation: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa,

ayahs.arabic: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Izhab ilaa fir'auna innahu taghaa.
ayahs.translation: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.

ayahs.arabic: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Faqul hal laka ilaa-an tazakka.
ayahs.translation: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself

ayahs.arabic: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ahdi yaka ila rabbika fatakh sha
ayahs.translation: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"

ayahs.arabic: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْءَايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa araahul-aayatal kubra.
ayahs.translation: And he showed him the greatest sign,

ayahs.arabic: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa kazzaba wa asaa.
ayahs.translation: But Pharaoh denied and disobeyed.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Thumma adbara yas'aa.
ayahs.translation: Then he turned his back, striving.

ayahs.arabic: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa hashara fanada.
ayahs.translation: And he gathered [his people] and called out

ayahs.arabic: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Faqala ana rabbu kumul-a'laa.
ayahs.translation: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."

ayahs.arabic: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa-akha zahul laahu nakalal aakhirati wal-oola.
ayahs.translation: So Allah seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression].

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Inna fee zaalika la'ibratal limaiy-yaksha
ayahs.translation: Indeed in that is a warning for whoever would fear [Allah].

74.arabicText: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا ۝٢٧ رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا ۝٢٨ وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا ۝٢٩ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ ۝٣٠ أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا ۝٣١ وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا ۝٣٢ مَتَٰعًۭا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ ۝٣٣ فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ ۝٣٤ يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ ۝٣٥ وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ ۝٣٦ فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ ۝٣٧ وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۝٣٨ فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ ۝٣٩ وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ ۝٤٠ فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ ۝٤١ يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا ۝٤٢ فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ ۝٤٣ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ ۝٤٤ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا ۝٤٥ كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا ۝٤٦
74.transliteration: A-antum a shaddu khalqan amis samaa-u banaaha. (27) Raf'a sam kaha fasaw waaha (28) Wa aghtasha lailaha wa akhraja duhaaha. (29) Wal arda b'ada zaalika dahaaha. (30) Akhraja minha maa-aha wa mar 'aaha. (31) Wal jibala arsaaha. (32) Mataa'al lakum wali an 'aamikum. (33) Fa-izaa jaaa'atit taaam matul kubraa. (34) Yauma Yata zakkarul insaanu ma sa'aa. (35) Wa burrizatil-jaheemu limany-yaraa. (36) Fa ammaa man taghaa. (37) Wa aasaral hayaatad dunyaa (38) Fa innal jaheema hiyal maawaa. (39) Wa ammaa man khaafa maqaama Rabbihee wa nahan nafsa 'anil hawaa (40) Fa innal jannata hiyal maawaa (41) Yas'aloonaka 'anis saa'ati ayyaana mursaahaa (42) Feema anta min zikraahaa (43) Ilaa Rabbika muntahaa haa (44) Innamaaa anta munziru maiy yakshaahaa (45) Ka annahum Yawma yarawnahaa lam yalbasooo illaa 'ashiyyatan aw duhaahaa (46)
74.translationEn: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it. [27] He raised its ceiling and proportioned it. [28] And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness. [29] And after that He spread the earth. [30] He extracted from it its water and its pasture, [31] And the mountains He set firmly [32] As provision for you and your grazing livestock. [33] But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity - [34] The Day when man will remember that for which he strove, [35] And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see - [36] So as for he who transgressed [37] And preferred the life of the world, [38] Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge. [39] But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination, [40] Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge. [41] They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival? [42] In what [position] are you that you should mention it? [43] To your Lord is its finality. [44] You are only a warner for those who fear it. [45] It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof. [46]

ayahs.arabic: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: A-antum a shaddu khalqan amis samaa-u banaaha.
ayahs.translation: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it.

ayahs.arabic: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Raf'a sam kaha fasaw waaha
ayahs.translation: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa aghtasha lailaha wa akhraja duhaaha.
ayahs.translation: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
ayahs.transliteration: Wal arda b'ada zaalika dahaaha.
ayahs.translation: And after that He spread the earth.

ayahs.arabic: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Akhraja minha maa-aha wa mar 'aaha.
ayahs.translation: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Wal jibala arsaaha.
ayahs.translation: And the mountains He set firmly

ayahs.arabic: مَتَٰعًۭا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ
ayahs.transliteration: Mataa'al lakum wali an 'aamikum.
ayahs.translation: As provision for you and your grazing livestock.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa-izaa jaaa'atit taaam matul kubraa.
ayahs.translation: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity -

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Yauma Yata zakkarul insaanu ma sa'aa.
ayahs.translation: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,

ayahs.arabic: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa burrizatil-jaheemu limany-yaraa.
ayahs.translation: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa ammaa man taghaa.
ayahs.translation: So as for he who transgressed

ayahs.arabic: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa aasaral hayaatad dunyaa
ayahs.translation: And preferred the life of the world,

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa innal jaheema hiyal maawaa.
ayahs.translation: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ammaa man khaafa maqaama Rabbihee wa nahan nafsa 'anil hawaa
ayahs.translation: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa innal jannata hiyal maawaa
ayahs.translation: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.

ayahs.arabic: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Yas'aloonaka 'anis saa'ati ayyaana mursaahaa
ayahs.translation: They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?

ayahs.arabic: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ
ayahs.transliteration: Feema anta min zikraahaa
ayahs.translation: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?

ayahs.arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
ayahs.transliteration: Ilaa Rabbika muntahaa haa
ayahs.translation: To your Lord is its finality.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Innamaaa anta munziru maiy yakshaahaa
ayahs.translation: You are only a warner for those who fear it.

ayahs.arabic: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
ayahs.transliteration: Ka annahum Yawma yarawnahaa lam yalbasooo illaa 'ashiyyatan aw duhaahaa
ayahs.translation: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.

75.arabicText: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ ۝١ أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ ۝٢ وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ ۝٣ أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ ۝٤ أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ ۝٥ فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ ۝٦ وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ ۝٧ وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ ۝٨ وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ ۝٩ فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ ۝١٠ كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۝١١ فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ ۝١٢ فِى صُحُفٍۢ مُّكَرَّمَةٍۢ ۝١٣ مَّرْفُوعَةٍۢ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۭ ۝١٤ بِأَيْدِى سَفَرَةٍۢ ۝١٥ كِرَامٍۭ بَرَرَةٍۢ ۝١٦ قُتِلَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَآ أَكْفَرَهُۥ ۝١٧ مِنْ أَىِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ ۝١٨ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ ۝١٩ ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ ۝٢٠ ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقْبَرَهُۥ ۝٢١ ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ ۝٢٢
75.transliteration: 'Abasa wa tawallaa. (1) An jaa-ahul 'a-maa (2) Wa maa yudreeka la'allahu yaz zakkaa. (3) Au yaz zak karu fatanfa 'ahuz zikraa. (4) Amma manis taghnaa (5) Fa-anta lahu tasaddaa (6) Wa ma 'alaika allaa yaz zakka. (7) Wa amma man jaa-aka yas'a (8) Wahuwa yakhshaa, (9) Fa-anta 'anhu talah haa. (10) Kalla innaha tazkirah (11) Faman shaa a zakarah (12) Fi suhufim mukar rama, (13) Marfoo'atim mutah hara, (14) Bi'aidee safara (15) Kiraamim bararah. (16) Qutilal-insanu maa akfarah. (17) Min aiyyi shai-in Khalaq (18) Min nutfah; khalaqahu faqad-darah. (19) Thummas sabeela yas-sarah (20) Thumma amatahu fa-aqbarah (21) Thumma iza shaa-a ansharah (22)
75.translationEn: The Prophet frowned and turned away [1] Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting]. [2] But what would make you perceive, [O Muhammad], that perhaps he might be purified [3] Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him? [4] As for he who thinks himself without need, [5] To him you give attention. [6] And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified. [7] But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge] [8] While he fears [Allah], [9] From him you are distracted. [10] No! Indeed, these verses are a reminder; [11] So whoever wills may remember it. [12] [It is recorded] in honored sheets, [13] Exalted and purified, [14] [Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels, [15] Noble and dutiful. [16] Cursed is man; how disbelieving is he. [17] From what substance did He create him? [18] From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him; [19] Then He eased the way for him; [20] Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him. [21] Then when He wills, He will resurrect him. [22]

ayahs.arabic: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: 'Abasa wa tawallaa.
ayahs.translation: The Prophet frowned and turned away

ayahs.arabic: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: An jaa-ahul 'a-maa
ayahs.translation: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa yudreeka la'allahu yaz zakkaa.
ayahs.translation: But what would make you perceive, [O Muhammad], that perhaps he might be purified

ayahs.arabic: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Au yaz zak karu fatanfa 'ahuz zikraa.
ayahs.translation: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?

ayahs.arabic: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Amma manis taghnaa
ayahs.translation: As for he who thinks himself without need,

ayahs.arabic: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa-anta lahu tasaddaa
ayahs.translation: To him you give attention.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ma 'alaika allaa yaz zakka.
ayahs.translation: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa amma man jaa-aka yas'a
ayahs.translation: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]

ayahs.arabic: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wahuwa yakhshaa,
ayahs.translation: While he fears [Allah],

ayahs.arabic: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa-anta 'anhu talah haa.
ayahs.translation: From him you are distracted.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Kalla innaha tazkirah
ayahs.translation: No! Indeed, these verses are a reminder;

ayahs.arabic: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
ayahs.transliteration: Faman shaa a zakarah
ayahs.translation: So whoever wills may remember it.

ayahs.arabic: فِى صُحُفٍۢ مُّكَرَّمَةٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Fi suhufim mukar rama,
ayahs.translation: [It is recorded] in honored sheets,

ayahs.arabic: مَّرْفُوعَةٍۢ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Marfoo'atim mutah hara,
ayahs.translation: Exalted and purified,

ayahs.arabic: بِأَيْدِى سَفَرَةٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Bi'aidee safara
ayahs.translation: [Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels,

ayahs.arabic: كِرَامٍۭ بَرَرَةٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Kiraamim bararah.
ayahs.translation: Noble and dutiful.

ayahs.arabic: قُتِلَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَآ أَكْفَرَهُۥ
ayahs.transliteration: Qutilal-insanu maa akfarah.
ayahs.translation: Cursed is man; how disbelieving is he.

ayahs.arabic: مِنْ أَىِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ
ayahs.transliteration: Min aiyyi shai-in Khalaq
ayahs.translation: From what substance did He create him?

ayahs.arabic: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ
ayahs.transliteration: Min nutfah; khalaqahu faqad-darah.
ayahs.translation: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ
ayahs.transliteration: Thummas sabeela yas-sarah
ayahs.translation: Then He eased the way for him;

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقْبَرَهُۥ
ayahs.transliteration: Thumma amatahu fa-aqbarah
ayahs.translation: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ
ayahs.transliteration: Thumma iza shaa-a ansharah
ayahs.translation: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.

76.arabicText: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ ۝٢٣ فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ ۝٢٤ أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا ٱلْمَآءَ صَبًّۭا ۝٢٥ ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ شَقًّۭا ۝٢٦ فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّۭا ۝٢٧ وَعِنَبًۭا وَقَضْبًۭا ۝٢٨ وَزَيْتُونًۭا وَنَخْلًۭا ۝٢٩ وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلْبًۭا ۝٣٠ وَفَٰكِهَةًۭ وَأَبًّۭا ۝٣١ مَّتَٰعًۭا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ ۝٣٢ فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ ۝٣٣ يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ ۝٣٤ وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ ۝٣٥ وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ ۝٣٦ لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ شَأْنٌۭ يُغْنِيهِ ۝٣٧ وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ مُّسْفِرَةٌۭ ۝٣٨ ضَاحِكَةٌۭ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌۭ ۝٣٩ وَوُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌۭ ۝٤٠ تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ ۝٤١ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَفَرَةُ ٱلْفَجَرَةُ ۝٤٢
76.transliteration: Kalla lamma yaqdi maa amarah. (23) Falyanzuril insanu ilaa ta-amih (24) Anna sabab nalmaa-a sabba. (25) Thumma sha qaqnal-arda shaqqa. (26) Fa ambatna feeha habba (27) Wa 'inabaw-wa qadba (28) Wa zaitoonaw wanakh la' (29) Wa hadaa-iqa ghulba (30) Wa faki hataw-wa abba. (31) Mata'al-lakum wa li-an'amikum. (32) Faiza jaa-atis saakhah. (33) Yauma yafir-rul mar-u min akheeh (34) Wa ummihee wa abeeh (35) Wa sahi batihee wa baneeh. (36) Likul limri-im-minuhm yaumaa-izin shaa nuy-yughneeh (37) Wujoo huny-yauma-izim-musfira; (38) Dahi katum mustab shirah (39) Wa wujoohuy yauma-izin 'alaiha ghabar a (40) Tarhaquha qatarah. (41) Ulaa-ika humul-kafa ratul-fajarah. (42)
76.translationEn: No! Man has not yet accomplished what He commanded him. [23] Then let mankind look at his food - [24] How We poured down water in torrents, [25] Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts], [26] And caused to grow within it grain [27] And grapes and herbage [28] And olive and palm trees [29] And gardens of dense shrubbery [30] And fruit and grass - [31] [As] enjoyment for you and your grazing livestock. [32] But when there comes the Deafening Blast [33] On the Day a man will flee from his brother [34] And his mother and his father [35] And his wife and his children, [36] For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him. [37] [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright - [38] Laughing, rejoicing at good news. [39] And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust. [40] Blackness will cover them. [41] Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones. [42]

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ
ayahs.transliteration: Kalla lamma yaqdi maa amarah.
ayahs.translation: No! Man has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.

ayahs.arabic: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Falyanzuril insanu ilaa ta-amih
ayahs.translation: Then let mankind look at his food -

ayahs.arabic: أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا ٱلْمَآءَ صَبًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Anna sabab nalmaa-a sabba.
ayahs.translation: How We poured down water in torrents,

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ شَقًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Thumma sha qaqnal-arda shaqqa.
ayahs.translation: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],

ayahs.arabic: فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Fa ambatna feeha habba
ayahs.translation: And caused to grow within it grain

ayahs.arabic: وَعِنَبًۭا وَقَضْبًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa 'inabaw-wa qadba
ayahs.translation: And grapes and herbage

ayahs.arabic: وَزَيْتُونًۭا وَنَخْلًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa zaitoonaw wanakh la'
ayahs.translation: And olive and palm trees

ayahs.arabic: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلْبًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa hadaa-iqa ghulba
ayahs.translation: And gardens of dense shrubbery

ayahs.arabic: وَفَٰكِهَةًۭ وَأَبًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa faki hataw-wa abba.
ayahs.translation: And fruit and grass -

ayahs.arabic: مَّتَٰعًۭا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ
ayahs.transliteration: Mata'al-lakum wa li-an'amikum.
ayahs.translation: [As] enjoyment for you and your grazing livestock.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ
ayahs.transliteration: Faiza jaa-atis saakhah.
ayahs.translation: But when there comes the Deafening Blast

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ
ayahs.transliteration: Yauma yafir-rul mar-u min akheeh
ayahs.translation: On the Day a man will flee from his brother

ayahs.arabic: وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ummihee wa abeeh
ayahs.translation: And his mother and his father

ayahs.arabic: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa sahi batihee wa baneeh.
ayahs.translation: And his wife and his children,

ayahs.arabic: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ شَأْنٌۭ يُغْنِيهِ
ayahs.transliteration: Likul limri-im-minuhm yaumaa-izin shaa nuy-yughneeh
ayahs.translation: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.

ayahs.arabic: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ مُّسْفِرَةٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Wujoo huny-yauma-izim-musfira;
ayahs.translation: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright -

ayahs.arabic: ضَاحِكَةٌۭ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Dahi katum mustab shirah
ayahs.translation: Laughing, rejoicing at good news.

ayahs.arabic: وَوُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa wujoohuy yauma-izin 'alaiha ghabar a
ayahs.translation: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.

ayahs.arabic: تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ
ayahs.transliteration: Tarhaquha qatarah.
ayahs.translation: Blackness will cover them.

ayahs.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَفَرَةُ ٱلْفَجَرَةُ
ayahs.transliteration: Ulaa-ika humul-kafa ratul-fajarah.
ayahs.translation: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.

77.arabicText: عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ ۝١ عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ ۝٢ ٱلَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ ۝٣ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ ۝٤ ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ ۝٥ أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِهَٰدًۭا ۝٦ وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَوْتَادًۭا ۝٧ وَخَلَقْنَٰكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا ۝٨ وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًۭا ۝٩ وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًۭا ۝١٠ وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشًۭا ۝١١ وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًۭا شِدَادًۭا ۝١٢ وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًۭا وَهَّاجًۭا ۝١٣ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمُعْصِرَٰتِ مَآءًۭ ثَجَّاجًۭا ۝١٤ لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبًّۭا وَنَبَاتًۭا ۝١٥ وَجَنَّٰتٍ أَلْفَافًا ۝١٦ إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتًۭا ۝١٧ يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًۭا ۝١٨ وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَٰبًۭا ۝١٩ وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا ۝٢٠ إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًۭا ۝٢١ لِّلطَّٰغِينَ مَـَٔابًۭا ۝٢٢ لَّٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحْقَابًۭا ۝٢٣ لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًۭا وَلَا شَرَابًا ۝٢٤ إِلَّا حَمِيمًۭا وَغَسَّاقًۭا ۝٢٥ جَزَآءًۭ وِفَاقًا ۝٢٦ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًۭا ۝٢٧ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كِذَّابًۭا ۝٢٨ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ كِتَٰبًۭا ۝٢٩ فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا ۝٣٠ إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا ۝٣١ حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَٰبًۭا ۝٣٢ وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًۭا ۝٣٣ وَكَأْسًۭا دِهَاقًۭا ۝٣٤ لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًۭا ۝٣٥ جَزَآءًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًۭا ۝٣٦ رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًۭا ۝٣٧ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّۭا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًۭا ۝٣٨ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا ۝٣٩ إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَٰكُمْ عَذَابًۭا قَرِيبًۭا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا ۝٤٠
77.transliteration: 'Amma Yatasaa-aloon (1) 'Anin-nabaa-il 'azeem (2) Allazi hum feehi mukh talifoon (3) Kallaa sa y'alamoon (4) Thumma kallaa sa y'alamoon (5) Alam naj'alil arda mihaa da (6) Wal jibaala au taada (7) Wa khalaq naakum azwaaja (8) Waja'alnan naumakum subata (9) Waja'alnal laila libasa (10) Waja'alnan nahara ma 'aasha (11) Wa banaina fauqakum sab 'an shi daada (12) Waja'alna siraajaw wah haaja (13) Wa anzalna minal m'usiraati maa-an saj-jaaja (14) Linukh rija bihee habbaw wana baata (15) Wa jan naatin alfafa (16) Inna yaumal-fasli kana miqaata (17) Yauma yun fakhu fis-soori fataa toona afwaaja (18) Wa futiha tis samaa-u fakaanat abwaaba (19) Wa suyyi raatil jibaalu fa kaanat saraaba (20) Inna jahan nama kaanat mirsaada (21) Lit taa gheena ma aaba (22) Laa bitheena feehaa ahqaaba (23) Laa ya zooqoona feeha bar daw walaa sharaaba (24) Illa hamee maw-wa ghas saaqa (25) Jazaa-aw wi faaqa (26) Innahum kaanu laa yarjoona hisaaba (27) Wa kazzabu bi aayaa tina kizzaba (28) Wa kulla shai-in ahsai naahu kitaa ba (29) Fa zooqoo falan-nazee dakum ill-laa azaaba (30) Inna lil mutta qeena mafaaza (31) Hadaa-iqa wa a'anaa ba (32) Wa kaawa 'iba at raaba (33) Wa ka'san di haaqa (34) Laa yasma'oona fiha lagh waw walaa kizzaba (35) Jazaa-am mir-rabbika ataa-an hisaaba (36) Rabbis samaa waati wal ardi wa maa baina humar rahmaani laa yam likoona minhu khi taaba (37) Yauma yaqoo mur roohu wal malaa-ikatu saf-fal laa yata kalla moona illa man azina lahur rahmaanu wa qaala sawaaba (38) Zaalikal yaumul haqqu faman shaa-at ta khaaza ill-laa rabbihi ma-aaba (39) In naa anzar naakum azaaban qareebaiy-yauma yan zurul marr-u maa qaddamat yadaahu wa ya qoolul-kaafiru yaa lai tanee kuntu turaaba (40)
77.translationEn: About what are they asking one another? [1] About the great news - [2] That over which they are in disagreement. [3] No! They are going to know. [4] Then, no! They are going to know. [5] Have We not made the earth a resting place? [6] And the mountains as stakes? [7] And We created you in pairs [8] And made your sleep [a means for] rest [9] And made the night as clothing [10] And made the day for livelihood [11] And constructed above you seven strong [heavens] [12] And made [therein] a burning lamp [13] And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water [14] That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation [15] And gardens of entwined growth. [16] Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time - [17] The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes [18] And the heaven is opened and will become gateways [19] And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage. [20] Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait [21] For the transgressors, a place of return, [22] In which they will remain for ages [unending]. [23] They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink [24] Except scalding water and [foul] purulence - [25] An appropriate recompense. [26] Indeed, they were not expecting an account [27] And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial. [28] But all things We have enumerated in writing. [29] "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment." [30] Indeed, for the righteous is attainment - [31] Gardens and grapevines [32] And full-breasted [companions] of equal age [33] And a full cup. [34] No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood - [35] [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account, [36] [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech. [37] The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct. [38] That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return. [39] Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!" [40]

ayahs.arabic: عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: 'Amma Yatasaa-aloon
ayahs.translation: About what are they asking one another?

ayahs.arabic: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
ayahs.transliteration: 'Anin-nabaa-il 'azeem
ayahs.translation: About the great news -

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Allazi hum feehi mukh talifoon
ayahs.translation: That over which they are in disagreement.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Kallaa sa y'alamoon
ayahs.translation: No! They are going to know.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Thumma kallaa sa y'alamoon
ayahs.translation: Then, no! They are going to know.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِهَٰدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Alam naj'alil arda mihaa da
ayahs.translation: Have We not made the earth a resting place?

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَوْتَادًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wal jibaala au taada
ayahs.translation: And the mountains as stakes?

ayahs.arabic: وَخَلَقْنَٰكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa khalaq naakum azwaaja
ayahs.translation: And We created you in pairs

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Waja'alnan naumakum subata
ayahs.translation: And made your sleep [a means for] rest

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Waja'alnal laila libasa
ayahs.translation: And made the night as clothing

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Waja'alnan nahara ma 'aasha
ayahs.translation: And made the day for livelihood

ayahs.arabic: وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًۭا شِدَادًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa banaina fauqakum sab 'an shi daada
ayahs.translation: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًۭا وَهَّاجًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Waja'alna siraajaw wah haaja
ayahs.translation: And made [therein] a burning lamp

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمُعْصِرَٰتِ مَآءًۭ ثَجَّاجًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa anzalna minal m'usiraati maa-an saj-jaaja
ayahs.translation: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water

ayahs.arabic: لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبًّۭا وَنَبَاتًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Linukh rija bihee habbaw wana baata
ayahs.translation: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation

ayahs.arabic: وَجَنَّٰتٍ أَلْفَافًا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa jan naatin alfafa
ayahs.translation: And gardens of entwined growth.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Inna yaumal-fasli kana miqaata
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Yauma yun fakhu fis-soori fataa toona afwaaja
ayahs.translation: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes

ayahs.arabic: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَٰبًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa futiha tis samaa-u fakaanat abwaaba
ayahs.translation: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways

ayahs.arabic: وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa suyyi raatil jibaalu fa kaanat saraaba
ayahs.translation: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Inna jahan nama kaanat mirsaada
ayahs.translation: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait

ayahs.arabic: لِّلطَّٰغِينَ مَـَٔابًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Lit taa gheena ma aaba
ayahs.translation: For the transgressors, a place of return,

ayahs.arabic: لَّٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحْقَابًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Laa bitheena feehaa ahqaaba
ayahs.translation: In which they will remain for ages [unending].

ayahs.arabic: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًۭا وَلَا شَرَابًا
ayahs.transliteration: Laa ya zooqoona feeha bar daw walaa sharaaba
ayahs.translation: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا حَمِيمًۭا وَغَسَّاقًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Illa hamee maw-wa ghas saaqa
ayahs.translation: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -

ayahs.arabic: جَزَآءًۭ وِفَاقًا
ayahs.transliteration: Jazaa-aw wi faaqa
ayahs.translation: An appropriate recompense.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Innahum kaanu laa yarjoona hisaaba
ayahs.translation: Indeed, they were not expecting an account

ayahs.arabic: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كِذَّابًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa kazzabu bi aayaa tina kizzaba
ayahs.translation: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.

ayahs.arabic: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ كِتَٰبًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa kulla shai-in ahsai naahu kitaa ba
ayahs.translation: But all things We have enumerated in writing.

ayahs.arabic: فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
ayahs.transliteration: Fa zooqoo falan-nazee dakum ill-laa azaaba
ayahs.translation: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
ayahs.transliteration: Inna lil mutta qeena mafaaza
ayahs.translation: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -

ayahs.arabic: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَٰبًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Hadaa-iqa wa a'anaa ba
ayahs.translation: Gardens and grapevines

ayahs.arabic: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa kaawa 'iba at raaba
ayahs.translation: And full-breasted [companions] of equal age

ayahs.arabic: وَكَأْسًۭا دِهَاقًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ka'san di haaqa
ayahs.translation: And a full cup.

ayahs.arabic: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Laa yasma'oona fiha lagh waw walaa kizzaba
ayahs.translation: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -

ayahs.arabic: جَزَآءًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Jazaa-am mir-rabbika ataa-an hisaaba
ayahs.translation: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,

ayahs.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Rabbis samaa waati wal ardi wa maa baina humar rahmaani laa yam likoona minhu khi taaba
ayahs.translation: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّۭا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Yauma yaqoo mur roohu wal malaa-ikatu saf-fal laa yata kalla moona illa man azina lahur rahmaanu wa qaala sawaaba
ayahs.translation: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.

ayahs.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
ayahs.transliteration: Zaalikal yaumul haqqu faman shaa-at ta khaaza ill-laa rabbihi ma-aaba
ayahs.translation: That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَٰكُمْ عَذَابًۭا قَرِيبًۭا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
ayahs.transliteration: In naa anzar naakum azaaban qareebaiy-yauma yan zurul marr-u maa qaddamat yadaahu wa ya qoolul-kaafiru yaa lai tanee kuntu turaaba
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"

78.arabicText: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ ۝١ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًۭا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ ۝٢ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ طِبَاقًۭا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتٍۢ ۖ فَٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍۢ ۝٣ ثُمَّ ٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًۭا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌۭ ۝٤ وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَٰهَا رُجُومًۭا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ ۝٥
78.transliteration: Tabaarakal lazee biyadihil mulku wa huwa 'alaa kulli shai-in qadeer (1) Allazee khalaqal mawta walhayaata liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu 'amalaa; wa huwal 'azeezul ghafoor (2) Allazee khalaqa sab'a samaawaatin tibaaqam maa taraa fee khalqir rahmaani min tafaawutin farji'il basara hal taraa min futoor (3) Summar ji'il basara karrataini yanqalib ilaikal basaru khaasi'anw wa huwa haseer (4) Wa laqad zaiyannas samaaa'ad dunyaa bimasaa beeha wa ja'alnaahaa rujoomal lish shayaateeni wa a'tadnaa lahum 'azaabas sa'eer (5)
78.translationEn: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent - [1] [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving - [2] [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks? [3] Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued. [4] And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with stars and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze. [5]

ayahs.arabic: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ
ayahs.transliteration: Tabaarakal lazee biyadihil mulku wa huwa 'alaa kulli shai-in qadeer
ayahs.translation: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًۭا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ
ayahs.transliteration: Allazee khalaqal mawta walhayaata liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu 'amalaa; wa huwal 'azeezul ghafoor
ayahs.translation: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ طِبَاقًۭا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتٍۢ ۖ فَٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Allazee khalaqa sab'a samaawaatin tibaaqam maa taraa fee khalqir rahmaani min tafaawutin farji'il basara hal taraa min futoor
ayahs.translation: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًۭا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Summar ji'il basara karrataini yanqalib ilaikal basaru khaasi'anw wa huwa haseer
ayahs.translation: Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَٰهَا رُجُومًۭا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa laqad zaiyannas samaaa'ad dunyaa bimasaa beeha wa ja'alnaahaa rujoomal lish shayaateeni wa a'tadnaa lahum 'azaabas sa'eer
ayahs.translation: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with stars and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.

79.arabicText: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ ۝٦ إِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ فِيهَا سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا شَهِيقًۭا وَهِىَ تَفُورُ ۝٧ تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلْقِىَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌۭ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ ۝٨ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٌۭ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ كَبِيرٍۢ ۝٩ وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ ۝١٠
79.transliteration: Wa lillazeena kafaroo bi rabbihim 'azaabu jahannama wa bi'sal maseer (6) Izaaa ulqoo feehaa sami'oo lahaa shaheeqanw wa hiya tafoor (7) Takaadu tamayyazu minal ghaizi kullamaaa uliqya feehaa fawjun sa alahum khazanatuhaaa alam yaatikum nazeer (8) Qaaloo balaa qad jaaa'anaa nazeerun fakazzabnaa wa qulnaa maa nazzalal laahu min shai in in antum illaa fee dalaalin kabeer (9) Wa qaaloo law kunnaa nasma'u awna'qilu maa kunnaa feee as haabis sa'eer (10)
79.translationEn: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination. [6] When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up. [7] It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?" [8] They will say," Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allah has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'" [9] And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze." [10]

ayahs.arabic: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa lillazeena kafaroo bi rabbihim 'azaabu jahannama wa bi'sal maseer
ayahs.translation: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.

ayahs.arabic: إِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ فِيهَا سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا شَهِيقًۭا وَهِىَ تَفُورُ
ayahs.transliteration: Izaaa ulqoo feehaa sami'oo lahaa shaheeqanw wa hiya tafoor
ayahs.translation: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up.

ayahs.arabic: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلْقِىَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌۭ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Takaadu tamayyazu minal ghaizi kullamaaa uliqya feehaa fawjun sa alahum khazanatuhaaa alam yaatikum nazeer
ayahs.translation: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٌۭ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ كَبِيرٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo balaa qad jaaa'anaa nazeerun fakazzabnaa wa qulnaa maa nazzalal laahu min shai in in antum illaa fee dalaalin kabeer
ayahs.translation: They will say," Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allah has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'"

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa qaaloo law kunnaa nasma'u awna'qilu maa kunnaa feee as haabis sa'eer
ayahs.translation: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."

80.arabicText: فَٱعْتَرَفُوا۟ بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًۭا لِّأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ ۝١١ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ ۝١٢ وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ ۝١٣ أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ ۝١٤ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًۭا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِى مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ ۝١٥
80.transliteration: Fa'tarafoo bizambihim fasuhqal li as haabis sa'eer (11) Innal lazeena yakhshawna rabbahum bilghaibi lahum maghfiratunw wa ajrun kabeer (12) Wa asirroo qawlakum awijharoo bihee innahoo 'aleemum bizaatis sudoor (13) Alaa ya'lamu man khalaq wa huwal lateeful khabeer (14) Huwal lazee ja'ala lakumul arda zaloolan famshoo fee manaakibihaa wa kuloo mir rizqihee wa ilaihin nushoor (15)
80.translationEn: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze. [11] Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward. [12] And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts. [13] Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted? [14] It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection. [15]

ayahs.arabic: فَٱعْتَرَفُوا۟ بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًۭا لِّأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa'tarafoo bizambihim fasuhqal li as haabis sa'eer
ayahs.translation: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Innal lazeena yakhshawna rabbahum bilghaibi lahum maghfiratunw wa ajrun kabeer
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa asirroo qawlakum awijharoo bihee innahoo 'aleemum bizaatis sudoor
ayahs.translation: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
ayahs.transliteration: Alaa ya'lamu man khalaq wa huwal lateeful khabeer
ayahs.translation: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted?

ayahs.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًۭا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِى مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ
ayahs.transliteration: Huwal lazee ja'ala lakumul arda zaloolan famshoo fee manaakibihaa wa kuloo mir rizqihee wa ilaihin nushoor
ayahs.translation: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.

81.arabicText: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ ۝١٦ أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًۭا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ ۝١٧ وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ ۝١٨ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَٰٓفَّٰتٍۢ وَيَقْبِضْنَ ۚ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۭ بَصِيرٌ ۝١٩ أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ جُندٌۭ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِى غُرُورٍ ۝٢٠
81.transliteration: 'A-amintum man fissamaaa'i aiyakhsifa bi kumul arda fa izaa hiya tamoor (16) Am amintum man fissamaaa'i ai yursila 'alaikum haasiban fasata'lamoona kaifa nazeer (17) Wa laqad kazzabal lazeena min qablihim fakaifa kaana nakeer (18) Awalam yaraw ilat tairi fawqahum saaaffaatinw wa yaqbidn; maa yumsikuhunna illaar rahmaan; innahoo bikulli shai im baseer (19) Amman haazal lazee huwa jundul lakum yansurukum min doonir rahmaan; inilkaafiroona illaa fee ghuroor (20)
81.translationEn: Do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway? [16] Or do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning. [17] And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach. [18] Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing. [19] Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion. [20]

ayahs.arabic: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ
ayahs.transliteration: 'A-amintum man fissamaaa'i aiyakhsifa bi kumul arda fa izaa hiya tamoor
ayahs.translation: Do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًۭا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ
ayahs.transliteration: Am amintum man fissamaaa'i ai yursila 'alaikum haasiban fasata'lamoona kaifa nazeer
ayahs.translation: Or do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa laqad kazzabal lazeena min qablihim fakaifa kaana nakeer
ayahs.translation: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.

ayahs.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَٰٓفَّٰتٍۢ وَيَقْبِضْنَ ۚ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۭ بَصِيرٌ
ayahs.transliteration: Awalam yaraw ilat tairi fawqahum saaaffaatinw wa yaqbidn; maa yumsikuhunna illaar rahmaan; innahoo bikulli shai im baseer
ayahs.translation: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.

ayahs.arabic: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ جُندٌۭ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِى غُرُورٍ
ayahs.transliteration: Amman haazal lazee huwa jundul lakum yansurukum min doonir rahmaan; inilkaafiroona illaa fee ghuroor
ayahs.translation: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.

82.arabicText: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّجُّوا۟ فِى عُتُوٍّۢ وَنُفُورٍ ۝٢١ أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ ۝٢٢ قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ ۝٢٣ قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ ۝٢٤ وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ ۝٢٥
82.transliteration: Amman haazal lazee yarzuqukum in amsaka rizqah; bal lajjoo fee 'utuwwinw wa nufoor (21) Afamai yamshee mukibban 'alaa wajhihee ahdaaa ammany yamshee sawiyyan 'alaa siratim mustaqeem (22) Qul huwal lazee ansha akum wa ja'ala lakumus sam'a wal absaara wal af'idata qaleelam maa tashkuroon (23) Qul huwal lazee zara akum fil ardi wa ilaihi tuhsharoon (24) Wa yaqooloona mataa haazal wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen (25)
82.translationEn: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion. [21] Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path? [22] Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful." [23] Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered." [24] And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?" [25]

ayahs.arabic: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّجُّوا۟ فِى عُتُوٍّۢ وَنُفُورٍ
ayahs.transliteration: Amman haazal lazee yarzuqukum in amsaka rizqah; bal lajjoo fee 'utuwwinw wa nufoor
ayahs.translation: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.

ayahs.arabic: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Afamai yamshee mukibban 'alaa wajhihee ahdaaa ammany yamshee sawiyyan 'alaa siratim mustaqeem
ayahs.translation: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Qul huwal lazee ansha akum wa ja'ala lakumus sam'a wal absaara wal af'idata qaleelam maa tashkuroon
ayahs.translation: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful."

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Qul huwal lazee zara akum fil ardi wa ilaihi tuhsharoon
ayahs.translation: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."

ayahs.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa yaqooloona mataa haazal wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
ayahs.translation: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

83.arabicText: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ ۝٢٦ فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةًۭ سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ ۝٢٧ قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍۢ ۝٢٨ قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ ۝٢٩ قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًۭا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍۢ مَّعِينٍۭ ۝٣٠
83.transliteration: Qul innamal 'ilmu 'indallaahi wa innamaaa ana nazeerum mubeen (26) Falaammaa ra-awhu zulfatan seee'at wujoohul lazeena kafaroo wa qeela haazal lazee kuntum bihee tadda'oon (27) Qul ara'aytum in ahlaka niyal laahu wa mam ma'iya aw rahimanaa famai-yujeerul kaafireena min 'azaabin aleem (28) Qul huwar rahmaanu aamannaa bihee wa 'alaihi tawakkalnaa fasata'lamoona man huwa fee dalaalim mubeen (29) Qul ara'aytum in asbaha maaa'ukum ghawran famai yaateekum bimaaa'im ma'een (30)
83.translationEn: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner." [26] But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call." [27] Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered: whether Allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?" [28] Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error." [29] Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?" [30]

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Qul innamal 'ilmu 'indallaahi wa innamaaa ana nazeerum mubeen
ayahs.translation: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner."

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةًۭ سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Falaammaa ra-awhu zulfatan seee'at wujoohul lazeena kafaroo wa qeela haazal lazee kuntum bihee tadda'oon
ayahs.translation: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Qul ara'aytum in ahlaka niyal laahu wa mam ma'iya aw rahimanaa famai-yujeerul kaafireena min 'azaabin aleem
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered: whether Allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Qul huwar rahmaanu aamannaa bihee wa 'alaihi tawakkalnaa fasata'lamoona man huwa fee dalaalim mubeen
ayahs.translation: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًۭا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍۢ مَّعِينٍۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Qul ara'aytum in asbaha maaa'ukum ghawran famai yaateekum bimaaa'im ma'een
ayahs.translation: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"

84.arabicText: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ ۝١ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًۭا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ ۝٢ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ طِبَاقًۭا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتٍۢ ۖ فَٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍۢ ۝٣ ثُمَّ ٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًۭا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌۭ ۝٤ وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَٰهَا رُجُومًۭا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ ۝٥ وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ ۝٦ إِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ فِيهَا سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا شَهِيقًۭا وَهِىَ تَفُورُ ۝٧ تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلْقِىَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌۭ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ ۝٨ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٌۭ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ كَبِيرٍۢ ۝٩ وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ ۝١٠ فَٱعْتَرَفُوا۟ بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًۭا لِّأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ ۝١١ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ ۝١٢ وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ ۝١٣ أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ ۝١٤ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًۭا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِى مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ ۝١٥ ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ ۝١٦ أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًۭا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ ۝١٧ وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ ۝١٨ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَٰٓفَّٰتٍۢ وَيَقْبِضْنَ ۚ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۭ بَصِيرٌ ۝١٩ أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ جُندٌۭ
