Rather, you are a transgressing people." [19] And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers. [20]

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo Rabbunaa ya'lamu innaaa ilaikum lamursaloon
ayahs.translation: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you,

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا عَلَيْنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa 'alainaaa illal balaaghul mubeen
ayahs.translation: And we are not responsible except for clear notification."

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا۟ لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo innaa tataiyarnaa bikum la'il-lam tantahoo lanar jumannakum wa la-yamassan nakum minnaa 'azaabun aleem
ayahs.translation: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ طَٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمْ ۚ أَئِن ذُكِّرْتُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌۭ مُّسْرِفُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo taaa'irukum ma'akum; a'in zukkirtum; bal antum qawmum musrifoon
ayahs.translation: They said, "Your omen is with yourselves. Is it because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people."

ayahs.arabic: وَجَآءَ مِنْ أَقْصَا ٱلْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌۭ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa jaaa'a min aqsal madeenati rajuluny yas'aa qaala yaa qawmit tabi'ul mursaleen
ayahs.translation: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers.

124.arabicText: ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَن لَّا يَسْـَٔلُكُمْ أَجْرًۭا وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ ۝٢١ وَمَا لِىَ لَآ أَعْبُدُ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ ۝٢٢ ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدْنِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ بِضُرٍّۢ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّى شَفَٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ ۝٢٣ إِنِّىٓ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ ۝٢٤ إِنِّىٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَٱسْمَعُونِ ۝٢٥
124.transliteration: Ittabi'oo mal-laa yas'alukum ajranw-wa hum muhtadoon (21) Wa maa liya laaa a'budul lazee fataranee wa ilaihi turja'oon (22) 'A-attakhizu min dooniheee aalihatan iny-yuridnir Rahmaanu bidurril-laa tughni 'annee shafaa 'atuhum shai 'anw-wa laa yunqizoon (23) Inneee izal-lafee dalaa-lim-mubeen (24) Inneee aamantu bi Rabbikum fasma'oon (25)
124.translationEn: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided. [21] And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned? [22] Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me? [23] Indeed, I would then be in manifest error. [24] Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me." [25]

ayahs.arabic: ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَن لَّا يَسْـَٔلُكُمْ أَجْرًۭا وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Ittabi'oo mal-laa yas'alukum ajranw-wa hum muhtadoon
ayahs.translation: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا لِىَ لَآ أَعْبُدُ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa liya laaa a'budul lazee fataranee wa ilaihi turja'oon
ayahs.translation: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned?

ayahs.arabic: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدْنِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ بِضُرٍّۢ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّى شَفَٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ
ayahs.transliteration: 'A-attakhizu min dooniheee aalihatan iny-yuridnir Rahmaanu bidurril-laa tughni 'annee shafaa 'atuhum shai 'anw-wa laa yunqizoon
ayahs.translation: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me?

ayahs.arabic: إِنِّىٓ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.transliteration: Inneee izal-lafee dalaa-lim-mubeen
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.

ayahs.arabic: إِنِّىٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَٱسْمَعُونِ
ayahs.transliteration: Inneee aamantu bi Rabbikum fasma'oon
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me."

125.arabicText: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ ۝٢٦ بِمَا غَفَرَ لِى رَبِّى وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ ۝٢٧ ۞ وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ مِن جُندٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ ۝٢٨ إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ خَٰمِدُونَ ۝٢٩
125.transliteration: Qeelad khulil Jannnah; qaala yaa laita qawmee ya'lamoon (26) Bimaa ghafara lee Rabbee wa ja'alanee minal mukrameen (27) Wa maaa anzalnaa 'alaa qawmihee mim ba'dihee min jundim minas-samaaa'i wa maa kunnaa munzileen (28) In kaanat illaa saihatanw waahidatan fa-izaa hum khaamidoon (29)
125.translationEn: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know [26] Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored." [27] And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so. [28] It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished. [29]

ayahs.arabic: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Qeelad khulil Jannnah; qaala yaa laita qawmee ya'lamoon
ayahs.translation: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know

ayahs.arabic: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِى رَبِّى وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Bimaa ghafara lee Rabbee wa ja'alanee minal mukrameen
ayahs.translation: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored."

ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ مِن جُندٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maaa anzalnaa 'alaa qawmihee mim ba'dihee min jundim minas-samaaa'i wa maa kunnaa munzileen
ayahs.translation: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so.

ayahs.arabic: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ خَٰمِدُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: In kaanat illaa saihatanw waahidatan fa-izaa hum khaamidoon
ayahs.translation: It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished.

126.arabicText: يَٰحَسْرَةً عَلَى ٱلْعِبَادِ ۚ مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ ۝٣٠ أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ ۝٣١ وَإِن كُلٌّۭ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ ۝٣٢
126.transliteration: Yaa hasratan 'alal 'ibaad; maa yaateehim mir Rasoolin illaa kaanoo bihee yastahzi 'oon (30) Alam yaraw kam ahlak naa qablahum minal qurooni annahum ilaihim laa yarji'oon (31) Wa in kullul lammaa jamee'ul-ladainaa muhdaroon (32)
126.translationEn: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him. [30] Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them will not return? [31] And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us. [32]

ayahs.arabic: يَٰحَسْرَةً عَلَى ٱلْعِبَادِ ۚ مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Yaa hasratan 'alal 'ibaad; maa yaateehim mir Rasoolin illaa kaanoo bihee yastahzi 'oon
ayahs.translation: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Alam yaraw kam ahlak naa qablahum minal qurooni annahum ilaihim laa yarji'oon
ayahs.translation: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them will not return?

ayahs.arabic: وَإِن كُلٌّۭ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa in kullul lammaa jamee'ul-ladainaa muhdaroon
ayahs.translation: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.

127.arabicText: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَٰهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّۭا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ ۝٣٣ وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّٰتٍۢ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَأَعْنَٰبٍۢ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْعُيُونِ ۝٣٤ لِيَأْكُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ ۝٣٥ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ۝٣٦ وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ ۝٣٧ وَٱلشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى لِمُسْتَقَرٍّۢ لَّهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ ۝٣٨ وَٱلْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلْعُرْجُونِ ٱلْقَدِيمِ ۝٣٩ لَا ٱلشَّمْسُ يَنۢبَغِى لَهَآ أَن تُدْرِكَ ٱلْقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيْلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ وَكُلٌّۭ فِى فَلَكٍۢ يَسْبَحُونَ ۝٤٠
127.transliteration: Wa Aayatul lahumul ardul maitatu ahyainaahaa wa akhrajnaa minhaa habban faminhu yaakuloon (33) Wa ja'alnaa feehaa jannaatim min nakheelinw wa a'naabinw wa fajjarnaa feeha minal 'uyoon (34) Liyaakuloo min samarihee wa maa 'amilat-hu aideehim; afalaa yashkuroon (35) Subhaanal lazee khalaqal azwaaja kullahaa mimmaa tumbitul ardu wa min anfusihim wa mimmaa laa ya'lamoon (36) Wa Aayatul lahumul lailu naslakhu minhun nahaara fa-izaa hum muzlimoon (37) Wash-shamsu tajree limustaqarril lahaa; zaalika taqdeerul 'Azeezil Aleem (38) Walqamara qaddarnaahu manaazila hattaa 'aada kal'ur joonil qadeem (39) Lash shamsu yambaghee lahaaa an tudrikal qamara wa lal lailu saabiqun nahaar; wa kullun fee falaki yasbahoon (40)
127.translationEn: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat. [33] And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs - [34] That they may eat of His fruit. And their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful? [35] Exalted is He who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know. [36] And a sign for them is the night. We remove from it [the light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness. [37] And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing. [38] And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk. [39] It is not allowable for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming. [40]

ayahs.arabic: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَٰهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّۭا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa Aayatul lahumul ardul maitatu ahyainaahaa wa akhrajnaa minhaa habban faminhu yaakuloon
ayahs.translation: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّٰتٍۢ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَأَعْنَٰبٍۢ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْعُيُونِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ja'alnaa feehaa jannaatim min nakheelinw wa a'naabinw wa fajjarnaa feeha minal 'uyoon
ayahs.translation: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -

ayahs.arabic: لِيَأْكُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Liyaakuloo min samarihee wa maa 'amilat-hu aideehim; afalaa yashkuroon
ayahs.translation: That they may eat of His fruit. And their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful?

ayahs.arabic: سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Subhaanal lazee khalaqal azwaaja kullahaa mimmaa tumbitul ardu wa min anfusihim wa mimmaa laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.translation: Exalted is He who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.

ayahs.arabic: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa Aayatul lahumul lailu naslakhu minhun nahaara fa-izaa hum muzlimoon
ayahs.translation: And a sign for them is the night. We remove from it [the light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى لِمُسْتَقَرٍّۢ لَّهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wash-shamsu tajree limustaqarril lahaa; zaalika taqdeerul 'Azeezil Aleem
ayahs.translation: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلْعُرْجُونِ ٱلْقَدِيمِ
ayahs.transliteration: Walqamara qaddarnaahu manaazila hattaa 'aada kal'ur joonil qadeem
ayahs.translation: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.

ayahs.arabic: لَا ٱلشَّمْسُ يَنۢبَغِى لَهَآ أَن تُدْرِكَ ٱلْقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيْلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ وَكُلٌّۭ فِى فَلَكٍۢ يَسْبَحُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Lash shamsu yambaghee lahaaa an tudrikal qamara wa lal lailu saabiqun nahaar; wa kullun fee falaki yasbahoon
ayahs.translation: It is not allowable for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.

128.arabicText: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ ۝٤١ وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ ۝٤٢ وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ ۝٤٣ إِلَّا رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ ۝٤٤ وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ ۝٤٥ وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍۢ مِّنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ ۝٤٦ وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُۥٓ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ ۝٤٧ وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ ۝٤٨
128.transliteration: Wa Aayatul lahum annaa hamalnaa zurriyatahum fil fulkil mashhoon (41) Wa khalaqnaa lahum mim-mislihee maa yarkaboon (42) Wa in nashaa nughriqhum falaa sareekha lahum wa laa hum yunqazoon (43) Illaa rahmatam minnaa wa mataa'an ilaa heen (44) Wa izaa qeela lahumuttaqoo maa baina aideekum wa maa khalfakum la'allakum turhamoon (45) Wa maa taateehim min aayatim min ayataati Rabbihim illaa kaanoo 'anhaa mu'rideen (46) Wa izaa qeela lahum anfiqoo mimmaa razaqakumul laahu qaalal lazeena kafaroo lillazeena aamanooo anut'imu mal-law yashaaa'ul laahu at'amahooo in antum illaa fee dalaalim mubeen (47) Wa yaqooloona mataa haazal wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen (48)
128.translationEn: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship. [41] And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride. [42] And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved [43] Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time. [44] But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy... " [45] And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away. [46] And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allah has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allah had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error." [47] And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?" [48]

ayahs.arabic: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa Aayatul lahum annaa hamalnaa zurriyatahum fil fulkil mashhoon
ayahs.translation: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship.

ayahs.arabic: وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa khalaqnaa lahum mim-mislihee maa yarkaboon
ayahs.translation: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa in nashaa nughriqhum falaa sareekha lahum wa laa hum yunqazoon
ayahs.translation: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Illaa rahmatam minnaa wa mataa'an ilaa heen
ayahs.translation: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izaa qeela lahumuttaqoo maa baina aideekum wa maa khalfakum la'allakum turhamoon
ayahs.translation: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy... "

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍۢ مِّنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa taateehim min aayatim min ayataati Rabbihim illaa kaanoo 'anhaa mu'rideen
ayahs.translation: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُۥٓ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izaa qeela lahum anfiqoo mimmaa razaqakumul laahu qaalal lazeena kafaroo lillazeena aamanooo anut'imu mal-law yashaaa'ul laahu at'amahooo in antum illaa fee dalaalim mubeen
ayahs.translation: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allah has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allah had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."

ayahs.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa yaqooloona mataa haazal wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
ayahs.translation: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

129.arabicText: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ ۝٤٩ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةًۭ وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ ۝٥٠ وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ ۝٥١ قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ ۝٥٢ إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ ۝٥٣ فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌۭ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ۝٥٤ إِنَّ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍۢ فَٰكِهُونَ ۝٥٥ هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ ۝٥٦
129.transliteration: Maa yanzuroona illaa saihatanw waahidatan taa khuzuhum wa hum yakhissimoon (49) Falaa yastatee'oona taw siyatanw-wa laaa ilaaa ahlihim yarji'oon (50) Wa nufikha fis-soori faizaa hum minal ajdaasi ilaa Rabbihim yansiloon (51) Qaaloo yaa wailanaa mam ba'asanaa mim marqadinaa; haaza maa wa'adar Rahmanu wa sadaqal mursaloon (52) In kaanat illaa saihatanw waahidatan fa-izaa hum jamee'ul ladainaa muhdaroon (53) Fal-Yawma laa tuzlamu nafsun shai'anw-wa laa tujzawna illaa maa kuntum ta'maloon (54) Inna Ashaabal jannatil Yawma fee shughulin faakihoon (55) Hum wa azwaajuhum fee zilaalin 'alal araaa'iki muttaki'oon (56)
129.translationEn: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing. [49] And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return. [50] And the Horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten. [51] They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth." [52] It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us. [53] So today no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do. [54] Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation - [55] They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches. [56]

ayahs.arabic: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Maa yanzuroona illaa saihatanw waahidatan taa khuzuhum wa hum yakhissimoon
ayahs.translation: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةًۭ وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Falaa yastatee'oona taw siyatanw-wa laaa ilaaa ahlihim yarji'oon
ayahs.translation: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.

ayahs.arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa nufikha fis-soori faizaa hum minal ajdaasi ilaa Rabbihim yansiloon
ayahs.translation: And the Horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo yaa wailanaa mam ba'asanaa mim marqadinaa; haaza maa wa'adar Rahmanu wa sadaqal mursaloon
ayahs.translation: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."

ayahs.arabic: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: In kaanat illaa saihatanw waahidatan fa-izaa hum jamee'ul ladainaa muhdaroon
ayahs.translation: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌۭ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Fal-Yawma laa tuzlamu nafsun shai'anw-wa laa tujzawna illaa maa kuntum ta'maloon
ayahs.translation: So today no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍۢ فَٰكِهُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Inna Ashaabal jannatil Yawma fee shughulin faakihoon
ayahs.translation: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -

ayahs.arabic: هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Hum wa azwaajuhum fee zilaalin 'alal araaa'iki muttaki'oon
ayahs.translation: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.

130.arabicText: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ ۝٥٧ سَلَٰمٌۭ قَوْلًۭا مِّن رَّبٍّۢ رَّحِيمٍۢ ۝٥٨ وَٱمْتَٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ ۝٥٩ ۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ ۝٦٠ وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ ۝٦١ وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّۭا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ ۝٦٢ هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ ۝٦٣ ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ ۝٦٤
130.transliteration: Lahum feehaa faakiha tunw-wa lahum maa yadda'oon (57) Salaamun qawlam mir Rabbir Raheem (58) Wamtaazul Yawma ayyuhal mujrimoon (59) Alam a'had ilaikum yaa Baneee Aadama al-laa ta'budush Shaitaana innahoo lakum 'aduwwum mubeen (60) Wa ani'budoonee; haazaa Siraatum Mustaqeem (61) Wa laqad adalla minkum jibillan kaseeraa; afalam takoonoo ta'qiloon (62) Haazihee Jahannamul latee kuntum too'adoon (63) Islawhal Yawma bimaa kuntum takfuroon (64)
130.translationEn: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish] [57] [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord. [58] [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals. [59] Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy - [60] And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path. [61] And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason? [62] This is the Hellfire which you were promised. [63] [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny." [64]

ayahs.arabic: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Lahum feehaa faakiha tunw-wa lahum maa yadda'oon
ayahs.translation: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]

ayahs.arabic: سَلَٰمٌۭ قَوْلًۭا مِّن رَّبٍّۢ رَّحِيمٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Salaamun qawlam mir Rabbir Raheem
ayahs.translation: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱمْتَٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wamtaazul Yawma ayyuhal mujrimoon
ayahs.translation: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Alam a'had ilaikum yaa Baneee Aadama al-laa ta'budush Shaitaana innahoo lakum 'aduwwum mubeen
ayahs.translation: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ani'budoonee; haazaa Siraatum Mustaqeem
ayahs.translation: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّۭا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa laqad adalla minkum jibillan kaseeraa; afalam takoonoo ta'qiloon
ayahs.translation: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?

ayahs.arabic: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Haazihee Jahannamul latee kuntum too'adoon
ayahs.translation: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.

ayahs.arabic: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Islawhal Yawma bimaa kuntum takfuroon
ayahs.translation: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny."

131.arabicText: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ ۝٦٥ وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ ۝٦٦ وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّۭا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ ۝٦٧ وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ ۝٦٨ وَمَا عَلَّمْنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ وَقُرْءَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ ۝٦٩ لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّۭا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ ۝٧٠ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَٰمًۭا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ ۝٧١
131.transliteration: Al-Yawma nakhtimu 'alaaa afwaahihim wa tukallimunaaa aideehim wa tashhadu arjuluhum bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon (65) Wa law nashaaa'u lata masna 'alaaa aiyunihim fasta baqus-siraata fa-annaa yubsiroon (66) Wa law nashaaa'u lamasakhnaahum 'alaa makaanatihim famas-tataa'oo mudiyyanw-wa laa yarji'oon (67) Wa man nu 'ammirhu nunakkishu fil-khalq; afalaa ya'qiloon (68) Wa maa 'allamnaahush shi'ra wa maa yambaghee lah; in huwa illaa zikrunw-wa Qur-aanum mubeen (69) Liyunzira man kaana haiyanw-wa yahiqqal qawlu 'alal-kaafireen (70) Awalam yaraw annaa khalaqnaa lahum mimmaa 'amilat aideenaaa an'aaman fahum lahaa maalikoon (71)
131.translationEn: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn. [65] And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see? [66] And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return. [67] And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand? [68] And We did not give Prophet Muhammad, knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur'an [69] To warn whoever is alive and justify the word against the disbelievers. [70] Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners? [71]

ayahs.arabic: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Al-Yawma nakhtimu 'alaaa afwaahihim wa tukallimunaaa aideehim wa tashhadu arjuluhum bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon
ayahs.translation: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa law nashaaa'u lata masna 'alaaa aiyunihim fasta baqus-siraata fa-annaa yubsiroon
ayahs.translation: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّۭا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa law nashaaa'u lamasakhnaahum 'alaa makaanatihim famas-tataa'oo mudiyyanw-wa laa yarji'oon
ayahs.translation: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa man nu 'ammirhu nunakkishu fil-khalq; afalaa ya'qiloon
ayahs.translation: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand?

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ وَقُرْءَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa 'allamnaahush shi'ra wa maa yambaghee lah; in huwa illaa zikrunw-wa Qur-aanum mubeen
ayahs.translation: And We did not give Prophet Muhammad, knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur'an

ayahs.arabic: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّۭا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Liyunzira man kaana haiyanw-wa yahiqqal qawlu 'alal-kaafireen
ayahs.translation: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word against the disbelievers.

ayahs.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَٰمًۭا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Awalam yaraw annaa khalaqnaa lahum mimmaa 'amilat aideenaaa an'aaman fahum lahaa maalikoon
ayahs.translation: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?

132.arabicText: وَذَلَّلْنَٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ ۝٧٢ وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ ۝٧٣ وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةًۭ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ ۝٧٤ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّحْضَرُونَ ۝٧٥ فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ ۝٧٦ أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ ۝٧٧
132.transliteration: Wa zallalnaahaa lahum faminhaa rakoobuhum wa minhaa yaakuloon (72) Wa lahum feehaa manaa fi'u wa mashaarib; afalaa yashkuroon (73) Wattakhazoo min doonil laahi aalihatal la'allahum yunsaroon (74) Laa yastatee'oona nasrahum wa hum lahum jundum muhdaroon (75) Falaa yahzunka qawluhum; innaa na'lamu maa yusirroona wa maa yu'linoon (76) Awalam yaral insaanu annaa khalaqnaahu min nutfatin fa-izaa huwa khaseemum mubeen (77)
132.translationEn: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat. [72] And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful? [73] But they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped. [74] They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance. [75] So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare. [76] Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary? [77]

ayahs.arabic: وَذَلَّلْنَٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa zallalnaahaa lahum faminhaa rakoobuhum wa minhaa yaakuloon
ayahs.translation: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa lahum feehaa manaa fi'u wa mashaarib; afalaa yashkuroon
ayahs.translation: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?

ayahs.arabic: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةًۭ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wattakhazoo min doonil laahi aalihatal la'allahum yunsaroon
ayahs.translation: But they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.

ayahs.arabic: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّحْضَرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Laa yastatee'oona nasrahum wa hum lahum jundum muhdaroon
ayahs.translation: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Falaa yahzunka qawluhum; innaa na'lamu maa yusirroona wa maa yu'linoon
ayahs.translation: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.

ayahs.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Awalam yaral insaanu annaa khalaqnaahu min nutfatin fa-izaa huwa khaseemum mubeen
ayahs.translation: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary?

133.arabicText: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًۭا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌۭ ۝٧٨ قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۢ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ ۝٧٩ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًۭا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ ۝٨٠ أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ۝٨١ إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ ۝٨٢ فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ ۝٨٣
133.transliteration: Wa daraba lanaa maslanw-wa nasiya khalqahoo qaala mai-yuhyil'izaama wa hiya rameem (78) Qul yuh yeehal lazeee ansha ahaaa awwala marrah; wa Huwa bikulli khalqin 'Aleem (79) Allazee ja'ala lakum minash shajaril akhdari naaran fa-izaaa antum minhu tooqidoon (80) Awa laisal lazee khalaqas samaawaati wal arda biqaadirin 'alaaa ai-yakhluqa mislahum; balaa wa Huwal Khallaaqul 'Aleem (81) Innamaa amruhooo izaaa araada shai'an ai-yaqoola lahoo kun fa-yakoon (82) Fa Subhaanal lazee biyadihee malakootu kulli shai-inw-wa ilaihi turja'oon (83)
133.translationEn: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?" [78] Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing." [79] [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite. [80] Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator. [81] His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is. [82] So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned. [83]

ayahs.arabic: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًۭا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa daraba lanaa maslanw-wa nasiya khalqahoo qaala mai-yuhyil'izaama wa hiya rameem
ayahs.translation: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۢ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
ayahs.transliteration: Qul yuh yeehal lazeee ansha ahaaa awwala marrah; wa Huwa bikulli khalqin 'Aleem
ayahs.translation: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًۭا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Allazee ja'ala lakum minash shajaril akhdari naaran fa-izaaa antum minhu tooqidoon
ayahs.translation: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.

ayahs.arabic: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ayahs.transliteration: Awa laisal lazee khalaqas samaawaati wal arda biqaadirin 'alaaa ai-yakhluqa mislahum; balaa wa Huwal Khallaaqul 'Aleem
ayahs.translation: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
ayahs.transliteration: Innamaa amruhooo izaaa araada shai'an ai-yaqoola lahoo kun fa-yakoon
ayahs.translation: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.

ayahs.arabic: فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa Subhaanal lazee biyadihee malakootu kulli shai-inw-wa ilaihi turja'oon
ayahs.translation: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.

134.arabicText: ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ۝١ عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ ۝٢ خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ ۝٣ عَلَّمَهُ ٱلْبَيَانَ ۝٤ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍۢ ۝٥ وَٱلنَّجْمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ ۝٦ وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلْمِيزَانَ ۝٧ أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْمِيزَانِ ۝٨ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ ۝٩ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ ۝١٠ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَٱلنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ ٱلْأَكْمَامِ ۝١١ وَٱلْحَبُّ ذُو ٱلْعَصْفِ وَٱلرَّيْحَانُ ۝١٢ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝١٣
134.transliteration: Ar Rahmaan (1) 'Allamal Quran (2) Khalaqal insaan (3) 'Allamalhul bayaan (4) Ashshamsu walqamaru bihusbaan (5) Wannajmu washshajaru yasjudan (6) Wassamaaa'a rafa'ahaa wa wada'al Meezan (7) Allaa tatghaw fil meezaan (8) Wa aqeemul wazna bilqisti wa laa tukhsirul meezaan (9) Wal arda wada'ahaa lilanaame (10) Feehaa faakihatunw wan nakhlu zaatul akmaam (11) Walhabbu zul 'asfi war Raihaanu (12) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan (13)
134.translationEn: The Most Merciful [1] Taught the Qur'an, [2] Created man, [3] [And] taught him eloquence. [4] The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation, [5] And the stars and trees prostrate. [6] And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance [7] That you not transgress within the balance. [8] And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance. [9] And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures. [10] Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates] [11] And grain having husks and scented plants. [12] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? [13]

ayahs.arabic: ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ
ayahs.transliteration: Ar Rahmaan
ayahs.translation: The Most Merciful

ayahs.arabic: عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ
ayahs.transliteration: 'Allamal Quran
ayahs.translation: Taught the Qur'an,

ayahs.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ
ayahs.transliteration: Khalaqal insaan
ayahs.translation: Created man,

ayahs.arabic: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلْبَيَانَ
ayahs.transliteration: 'Allamalhul bayaan
ayahs.translation: [And] taught him eloquence.

ayahs.arabic: ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Ashshamsu walqamaru bihusbaan
ayahs.translation: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلنَّجْمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wannajmu washshajaru yasjudan
ayahs.translation: And the stars and trees prostrate.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wassamaaa'a rafa'ahaa wa wada'al Meezan
ayahs.translation: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance

ayahs.arabic: أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْمِيزَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Allaa tatghaw fil meezaan
ayahs.translation: That you not transgress within the balance.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa aqeemul wazna bilqisti wa laa tukhsirul meezaan
ayahs.translation: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wal arda wada'ahaa lilanaame
ayahs.translation: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.

ayahs.arabic: فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَٱلنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ ٱلْأَكْمَامِ
ayahs.transliteration: Feehaa faakihatunw wan nakhlu zaatul akmaam
ayahs.translation: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْحَبُّ ذُو ٱلْعَصْفِ وَٱلرَّيْحَانُ
ayahs.transliteration: Walhabbu zul 'asfi war Raihaanu
ayahs.translation: And grain having husks and scented plants.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

135.arabicText: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ كَٱلْفَخَّارِ ۝١٤ وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍۢ مِّن نَّارٍۢ ۝١٥ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝١٦ رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ ۝١٧ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝١٨ مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ ۝١٩ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌۭ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ ۝٢٠ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝٢١ يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا ٱللُّؤْلُؤُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ ۝٢٢ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝٢٣ وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَٰمِ ۝٢٤ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝٢٥
135.transliteration: Khalaqal insaana min salsaalin kalfakhkhaari (14) Wa khalaqal jaaan mim maarijim min naar (15) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan (16) Rabbul mashriqayni wa Rabbul maghribayni (17) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan (18) Marajal bahrayni yalta qiyaani (19) Bainahumaa barzakhul laa yabghiyaan (20) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan (21) Yakhruju minhumal lu 'lu u wal marjaanu (22) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan (23) Wa lahul jawaaril mun sha'aatu fil bahri kal a'laam (24) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan. (25)
135.translationEn: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery. [14] And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire. [15] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? [16] [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets. [17] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? [18] He released the two seas, meeting [side by side]; [19] Between them is a barrier [so] neither of them transgresses. [20] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? [21] From both of them emerge pearl and coral. [22] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? [23] And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains. [24] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? [25]

ayahs.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ كَٱلْفَخَّارِ
ayahs.transliteration: Khalaqal insaana min salsaalin kalfakhkhaari
ayahs.translation: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.

ayahs.arabic: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍۢ مِّن نَّارٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa khalaqal jaaan mim maarijim min naar
ayahs.translation: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahs.arabic: رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ
ayahs.transliteration: Rabbul mashriqayni wa Rabbul maghribayni
ayahs.translation: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahs.arabic: مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Marajal bahrayni yalta qiyaani
ayahs.translation: He released the two seas, meeting [side by side];

ayahs.arabic: بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌۭ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Bainahumaa barzakhul laa yabghiyaan
ayahs.translation: Between them is a barrier [so] neither of them transgresses.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahs.arabic: يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا ٱللُّؤْلُؤُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ
ayahs.transliteration: Yakhruju minhumal lu 'lu u wal marjaanu
ayahs.translation: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahs.arabic: وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَٰمِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa lahul jawaaril mun sha'aatu fil bahri kal a'laam
ayahs.translation: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

136.arabicText: كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍۢ ۝٢٦ وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ ۝٢٧ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝٢٨ يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍۢ ۝٢٩ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝٣٠ سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ ۝٣١ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝٣٢ يَٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ ۝٣٣ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝٣٤ يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌۭ مِّن نَّارٍۢ وَنُحَاسٌۭ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ ۝٣٥ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝٣٦
136.transliteration: Kullu man 'alaihaa faan (26) Wa yabqaa wajhu rabbika zul jalaali wal ikraam (27) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan. (28) Yas'aluhoo man fissamaawaati walard; kulla ywmin huwa fee shaan (29) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan. (30) Sanafrughu lakum ayyuhas saqalaan (31) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan. (32) Yaa ma'sharal jinni wal insi inis tata'tum an tanfuzoo min aqtaaris samaawaati wal ardi fanfuzoo; laa tanfuzoona illaa bisultaan (33) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan. (34) Yursalu 'alaikumaa shuwaazum min naarifiw-wa nuhaasun falaa tantasiraan (35) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan. (36)
136.translationEn: Everyone upon the earth will perish, [26] And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor. [27] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? [28] Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter. [29] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? [30] We will attend to you, O prominent beings. [31] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? [32] O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allah]. [33] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? [34] There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves. [35] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? [36]

ayahs.arabic: كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Kullu man 'alaihaa faan
ayahs.translation: Everyone upon the earth will perish,

ayahs.arabic: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa yabqaa wajhu rabbika zul jalaali wal ikraam
ayahs.translation: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahs.arabic: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Yas'aluhoo man fissamaawaati walard; kulla ywmin huwa fee shaan
ayahs.translation: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahs.arabic: سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Sanafrughu lakum ayyuhas saqalaan
ayahs.translation: We will attend to you, O prominent beings.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahs.arabic: يَٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Yaa ma'sharal jinni wal insi inis tata'tum an tanfuzoo min aqtaaris samaawaati wal ardi fanfuzoo; laa tanfuzoona illaa bisultaan
ayahs.translation: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allah].

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahs.arabic: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌۭ مِّن نَّارٍۢ وَنُحَاسٌۭ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Yursalu 'alaikumaa shuwaazum min naarifiw-wa nuhaasun falaa tantasiraan
ayahs.translation: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

137.arabicText: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةًۭ كَٱلدِّهَانِ ۝٣٧ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝٣٨ فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌۭ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ ۝٣٩ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝٤٠ يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ ۝٤١ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝٤٢ هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ ۝٤٣ يَطُوفُونَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ حَمِيمٍ ءَانٍۢ ۝٤٤ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝٤٥
137.transliteration: Fa-izan shaqqatis samaaa'u fakaanat wardatan kaddihaan (37) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan. (38) Fa-yawma'izil laa yus'alu 'an zambiheee insunw wa laa jaann (39) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan. (40) Yu'raful mujrimoona biseemaahum fa'yu'khazu binna waasi wal aqdaam (41) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan. (42) Haazihee jahannamul latee yukazzibu bihal mujrimoon (43) Yatoofoona bainahaa wa baina hameemim aan (44) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan. (45)
137.translationEn: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil - [37] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? - [38] Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn. [39] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? [40] The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet. [41] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? [42] This is Hell, which the criminals deny. [43] They will go around between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree]. [44] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? [45]

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةًۭ كَٱلدِّهَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa-izan shaqqatis samaaa'u fakaanat wardatan kaddihaan
ayahs.translation: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil -

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

ayahs.arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌۭ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa-yawma'izil laa yus'alu 'an zambiheee insunw wa laa jaann
ayahs.translation: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahs.arabic: يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ
ayahs.transliteration: Yu'raful mujrimoona biseemaahum fa'yu'khazu binna waasi wal aqdaam
ayahs.translation: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahs.arabic: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Haazihee jahannamul latee yukazzibu bihal mujrimoon
ayahs.translation: This is Hell, which the criminals deny.

ayahs.arabic: يَطُوفُونَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ حَمِيمٍ ءَانٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Yatoofoona bainahaa wa baina hameemim aan
ayahs.translation: They will go around between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree].

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

138.arabicText: وَلِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ جَنَّتَانِ ۝٤٦ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝٤٧ ذَوَاتَآ أَفْنَانٍۢ ۝٤٨ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝٤٩ فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ تَجْرِيَانِ ۝٥٠ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝٥١ فِيهِمَا مِن كُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍۢ زَوْجَانِ ۝٥٢ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝٥٣ مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ ۚ وَجَنَى ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍۢ ۝٥٤ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝٥٥
138.transliteration: Wa liman khaafa maqaama rabbihee jannataan (46) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan. (47) Zawaataaa afnaan (48) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan. (49) Feehimaa 'aynaani tajriyaan (50) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan. (51) Feehimaa min kulli faakihatin zawjaan (52) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan. (53) Muttaki'eena 'alaa furushim bataaa'inuhaa min istabraq; wajanal jannataini daan (54) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan. (55)
138.translationEn: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens - [46] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? - [47] Having [spreading] branches. [48] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? [49] In both of them are two springs, flowing. [50] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? [51] In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds. [52] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? [53] [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low. [54] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? [55]

ayahs.arabic: وَلِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ جَنَّتَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa liman khaafa maqaama rabbihee jannataan
ayahs.translation: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens -

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

ayahs.arabic: ذَوَاتَآ أَفْنَانٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Zawaataaa afnaan
ayahs.translation: Having [spreading] branches.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahs.arabic: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ تَجْرِيَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Feehimaa 'aynaani tajriyaan
ayahs.translation: In both of them are two springs, flowing.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahs.arabic: فِيهِمَا مِن كُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍۢ زَوْجَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Feehimaa min kulli faakihatin zawjaan
ayahs.translation: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahs.arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ ۚ وَجَنَى ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Muttaki'eena 'alaa furushim bataaa'inuhaa min istabraq; wajanal jannataini daan
ayahs.translation: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

139.arabicText: فِيهِنَّ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ ۝٥٦ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝٥٧ كَأَنَّهُنَّ ٱلْيَاقُوتُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ ۝٥٨ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝٥٩ هَلْ جَزَآءُ ٱلْإِحْسَٰنِ إِلَّا ٱلْإِحْسَٰنُ ۝٦٠ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝٦١ وَمِن دُونِهِمَا جَنَّتَانِ ۝٦٢ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝٦٣ مُدْهَآمَّتَانِ ۝٦٤ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝٦٥ فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ نَضَّاخَتَانِ ۝٦٦ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝٦٧
139.transliteration: Feehinna qaasiratut tarfi lam yatmishunna insun qablahum wa laa jaaann (56) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan. (57) ka annahunnal yaaqootu wal marjaan (58) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan. (59) Hal jazaaa'ul ihsaani illal ihsaan (60) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan. (61) Wa min doonihimaa jannataan (62) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan. (63) Mudhaaammataan (64) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan. (65) Feehimaa 'aynaani nad daakhataan (66) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan. (67)
139.translationEn: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinni - [56] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? - [57] As if they were rubies and coral. [58] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? [59] Is the reward for good [anything] but good? [60] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? [61] And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens - [62] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? - [63] Dark green [in color]. [64] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? [65] In both of them are two springs, spouting. [66] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? [67]

ayahs.arabic: فِيهِنَّ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Feehinna qaasiratut tarfi lam yatmishunna insun qablahum wa laa jaaann
ayahs.translation: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinni -

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

ayahs.arabic: كَأَنَّهُنَّ ٱلْيَاقُوتُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ
ayahs.transliteration: ka annahunnal yaaqootu wal marjaan
ayahs.translation: As if they were rubies and coral.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahs.arabic: هَلْ جَزَآءُ ٱلْإِحْسَٰنِ إِلَّا ٱلْإِحْسَٰنُ
ayahs.transliteration: Hal jazaaa'ul ihsaani illal ihsaan
ayahs.translation: Is the reward for good [anything] but good?

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahs.arabic: وَمِن دُونِهِمَا جَنَّتَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa min doonihimaa jannataan
ayahs.translation: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens -

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

ayahs.arabic: مُدْهَآمَّتَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Mudhaaammataan
ayahs.translation: Dark green [in color].

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahs.arabic: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ نَضَّاخَتَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Feehimaa 'aynaani nad daakhataan
ayahs.translation: In both of them are two springs, spouting.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

140.arabicText: فِيهِمَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَنَخْلٌۭ وَرُمَّانٌۭ ۝٦٨ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝٦٩ فِيهِنَّ خَيْرَٰتٌ حِسَانٌۭ ۝٧٠ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝٧١ حُورٌۭ مَّقْصُورَٰتٌۭ فِى ٱلْخِيَامِ ۝٧٢ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝٧٣ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ ۝٧٤ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝٧٥ مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍۢ وَعَبْقَرِىٍّ حِسَانٍۢ ۝٧٦ فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ ۝٧٧ تَبَٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ ۝٧٨
140.transliteration: Feehimaa faakihatunw wa nakhlunw wa rummaan (68) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan. (69) Feehinna khairaatun hisaan (70) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan. (71) Hoorum maqsooraatun fil khiyaam (72) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan. (73) Lam yatmis hunna insun qablahum wa laa jaaann (74) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan. (75) Muttaki'eena 'alaa rafratin khudrinw wa 'abqariyyin hisaan (76) Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan. (77) Tabaarakasmu Rabbika Zil-Jalaali wal-Ikraam (78)
140.translationEn: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates. [68] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? [69] In them are good and beautiful women - [70] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? - [71] Fair ones reserved in pavilions - [72] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? - [73] Untouched before them by man or jinni - [74] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? - [75] Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets. [76] So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? [77] Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor. [78]

ayahs.arabic: فِيهِمَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَنَخْلٌۭ وَرُمَّانٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Feehimaa faakihatunw wa nakhlunw wa rummaan
ayahs.translation: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahs.arabic: فِيهِنَّ خَيْرَٰتٌ حِسَانٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Feehinna khairaatun hisaan
ayahs.translation: In them are good and beautiful women -

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

ayahs.arabic: حُورٌۭ مَّقْصُورَٰتٌۭ فِى ٱلْخِيَامِ
ayahs.transliteration: Hoorum maqsooraatun fil khiyaam
ayahs.translation: Fair ones reserved in pavilions -

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

ayahs.arabic: لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Lam yatmis hunna insun qablahum wa laa jaaann
ayahs.translation: Untouched before them by man or jinni -

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

ayahs.arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍۢ وَعَبْقَرِىٍّ حِسَانٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Muttaki'eena 'alaa rafratin khudrinw wa 'abqariyyin hisaan
ayahs.translation: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
ayahs.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahs.arabic: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
ayahs.transliteration: Tabaarakasmu Rabbika Zil-Jalaali wal-Ikraam
ayahs.translation: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.

141.arabicText: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ ۝١ لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ ۝٢ خَافِضَةٌۭ رَّافِعَةٌ ۝٣ إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ رَجًّۭا ۝٤ وَبُسَّتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ بَسًّۭا ۝٥ فَكَانَتْ هَبَآءًۭ مُّنۢبَثًّۭا ۝٦ وَكُنتُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا ثَلَٰثَةًۭ ۝٧ فَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ ۝٨ وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ ۝٩ وَٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ ۝١٠ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ ۝١١ فِى جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ ۝١٢ ثُلَّةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ۝١٣ وَقَلِيلٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ ۝١٤
141.transliteration: Izaa waqa'atil waaqi'ah (1) Laisa liwaq'atihaa kaazibah (2) Khafidatur raafi'ah (3) Izaa rujjatil ardu rajjaa (4) Wa bussatil jibaalu bassaa (5) Fakaanat habaaa'am mumbassaa (6) Wa kuntum azwaajan salaasah (7) Fa as haabul maimanati maaa as haabul maimanah (8) Wa as haabul mash'amati maaa as haabul mash'amah (9) Wassaabiqoonas saabiqoon (10) Ulaaa'ikal muqarraboon (11) Fee Jannaatin Na'eem (12) Sullatum minal awwaleen (13) Wa qaleelum minal aa khireen (14)
141.translationEn: When the Occurrence occurs, [1] There is, at its occurrence, no denial. [2] It will bring down [some] and raise up [others]. [3] When the earth is shaken with convulsion [4] And the mountains are broken down, crumbling [5] And become dust dispersing. [6] And you become [of] three kinds: [7] Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right? [8] And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left? [9] And the forerunners, the forerunners - [10] Those are the ones brought near [to Allah] [11] In the Gardens of Pleasure, [12] A [large] company of the former peoples [13] And a few of the later peoples, [14]

ayahs.arabic: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
ayahs.transliteration: Izaa waqa'atil waaqi'ah
ayahs.translation: When the Occurrence occurs,

ayahs.arabic: لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ
ayahs.transliteration: Laisa liwaq'atihaa kaazibah
ayahs.translation: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.

ayahs.arabic: خَافِضَةٌۭ رَّافِعَةٌ
ayahs.transliteration: Khafidatur raafi'ah
ayahs.translation: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].

ayahs.arabic: إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ رَجًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Izaa rujjatil ardu rajjaa
ayahs.translation: When the earth is shaken with convulsion

ayahs.arabic: وَبُسَّتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ بَسًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa bussatil jibaalu bassaa
ayahs.translation: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling

ayahs.arabic: فَكَانَتْ هَبَآءًۭ مُّنۢبَثًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Fakaanat habaaa'am mumbassaa
ayahs.translation: And become dust dispersing.

ayahs.arabic: وَكُنتُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا ثَلَٰثَةًۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa kuntum azwaajan salaasah
ayahs.translation: And you become [of] three kinds:

ayahs.arabic: فَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa as haabul maimanati maaa as haabul maimanah
ayahs.translation: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?

ayahs.arabic: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa as haabul mash'amati maaa as haabul mash'amah
ayahs.translation: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wassaabiqoonas saabiqoon
ayahs.translation: And the forerunners, the forerunners -

ayahs.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Ulaaa'ikal muqarraboon
ayahs.translation: Those are the ones brought near [to Allah]

ayahs.arabic: فِى جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayahs.transliteration: Fee Jannaatin Na'eem
ayahs.translation: In the Gardens of Pleasure,

ayahs.arabic: ثُلَّةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Sullatum minal awwaleen
ayahs.translation: A [large] company of the former peoples

ayahs.arabic: وَقَلِيلٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa qaleelum minal aa khireen
ayahs.translation: And a few of the later peoples,

142.arabicText: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مَّوْضُونَةٍۢ ۝١٥ مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَيْهَا مُتَقَٰبِلِينَ ۝١٦ يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ ۝١٧ بِأَكْوَابٍۢ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأْسٍۢ مِّن مَّعِينٍۢ ۝١٨ لَّا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنْهَا وَلَا يُنزِفُونَ ۝١٩ وَفَٰكِهَةٍۢ مِّمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ ۝٢٠ وَلَحْمِ طَيْرٍۢ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ ۝٢١ وَحُورٌ عِينٌۭ ۝٢٢ كَأَمْثَٰلِ ٱللُّؤْلُؤِ ٱلْمَكْنُونِ ۝٢٣ جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ ۝٢٤ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا ۝٢٥ إِلَّا قِيلًۭا سَلَٰمًۭا سَلَٰمًۭا ۝٢٦
142.transliteration: 'Alaa sururim mawdoonah (15) Muttaki'eena 'alaihaa mutaqabileen (16) Yatoofu 'alaihim wildaa num mukkhalladoon (17) Bi akwaabinw wa abaareeq, wa kaasim mim ma'een (18) Laa yusadda'oona 'anhaa wa laa yunzifoon (19) Wa faakihatim mimmaa yatakhaiyaroon (20) Wa lahmi tairim mimmaa yashtahoon (21) Wa hoorun'een (22) Ka amsaalil lu'lu'il maknoon (23) Jazaaa'am bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon (24) Laa yasma'oona feehaa laghwanw wa laa taaseemaa (25) Illaa qeelan salaaman salaamaa (26)
142.translationEn: On thrones woven [with ornament], [15] Reclining on them, facing each other. [16] There will circulate among them young boys made eternal [17] With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring - [18] No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated - [19] And fruit of what they select [20] And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire. [21] And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes, [22] The likenesses of pearls well-protected, [23] As reward for what they used to do. [24] They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin - [25] Only a saying: "Peace, peace." [26]

ayahs.arabic: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مَّوْضُونَةٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: 'Alaa sururim mawdoonah
ayahs.translation: On thrones woven [with ornament],

ayahs.arabic: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَيْهَا مُتَقَٰبِلِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Muttaki'eena 'alaihaa mutaqabileen
ayahs.translation: Reclining on them, facing each other.

ayahs.arabic: يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Yatoofu 'alaihim wildaa num mukkhalladoon
ayahs.translation: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal

ayahs.arabic: بِأَكْوَابٍۢ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأْسٍۢ مِّن مَّعِينٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Bi akwaabinw wa abaareeq, wa kaasim mim ma'een
ayahs.translation: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring -

ayahs.arabic: لَّا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنْهَا وَلَا يُنزِفُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Laa yusadda'oona 'anhaa wa laa yunzifoon
ayahs.translation: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -

ayahs.arabic: وَفَٰكِهَةٍۢ مِّمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa faakihatim mimmaa yatakhaiyaroon
ayahs.translation: And fruit of what they select

ayahs.arabic: وَلَحْمِ طَيْرٍۢ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa lahmi tairim mimmaa yashtahoon
ayahs.translation: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.

ayahs.arabic: وَحُورٌ عِينٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa hoorun'een
ayahs.translation: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes,

ayahs.arabic: كَأَمْثَٰلِ ٱللُّؤْلُؤِ ٱلْمَكْنُونِ
ayahs.transliteration: Ka amsaalil lu'lu'il maknoon
ayahs.translation: The likenesses of pearls well-protected,

ayahs.arabic: جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Jazaaa'am bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon
ayahs.translation: As reward for what they used to do.

ayahs.arabic: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا
ayahs.transliteration: Laa yasma'oona feehaa laghwanw wa laa taaseemaa
ayahs.translation: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا قِيلًۭا سَلَٰمًۭا سَلَٰمًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Illaa qeelan salaaman salaamaa
ayahs.translation: Only a saying: "Peace, peace."

143.arabicText: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْيَمِينِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْيَمِينِ ۝٢٧ فِى سِدْرٍۢ مَّخْضُودٍۢ ۝٢٨ وَطَلْحٍۢ مَّنضُودٍۢ ۝٢٩ وَظِلٍّۢ مَّمْدُودٍۢ ۝٣٠ وَمَآءٍۢ مَّسْكُوبٍۢ ۝٣١ وَفَٰكِهَةٍۢ كَثِيرَةٍۢ ۝٣٢ لَّا مَقْطُوعَةٍۢ وَلَا مَمْنُوعَةٍۢ ۝٣٣ وَفُرُشٍۢ مَّرْفُوعَةٍ ۝٣٤ إِنَّآ أَنشَأْنَٰهُنَّ إِنشَآءًۭ ۝٣٥ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُنَّ أَبْكَارًا ۝٣٦ عُرُبًا أَتْرَابًۭا ۝٣٧ لِّأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ ۝٣٨ ثُلَّةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ۝٣٩ وَثُلَّةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ ۝٤٠
143.transliteration: Wa as haabul yameeni maaa as haabul Yameen (27) Fee sidrim makhdood (28) Wa talhim mandood (29) Wa zillim mamdood (30) Wa maaa'im maskoob (31) Wa faakihatin kaseerah (32) Laa maqtoo'atinw wa laa mamnoo'ah (33) Wa furushim marfoo'ah (34) Innaaa anshaanaahunna inshaaa'aa (35) Faja'alnaahunna abkaaraa (36) 'Uruban atraabaa (37) Li as haabil yameen (38) Sullatum minal awwa leen (39) Wa sullatum minal aakhireen (40)
143.translationEn: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right? [27] [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed [28] And [banana] trees layered [with fruit] [29] And shade extended [30] And water poured out [31] And fruit, abundant [and varied], [32] Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden, [33] And [upon] beds raised high. [34] Indeed, We have produced the women of Paradise in a [new] creation [35] And made them virgins, [36] Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age, [37] For the companions of the right [who are] [38] A company of the former peoples [39] And a company of the later peoples. [40]

ayahs.arabic: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْيَمِينِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْيَمِينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa as haabul yameeni maaa as haabul Yameen
ayahs.translation: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?

ayahs.arabic: فِى سِدْرٍۢ مَّخْضُودٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Fee sidrim makhdood
ayahs.translation: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed

ayahs.arabic: وَطَلْحٍۢ مَّنضُودٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa talhim mandood
ayahs.translation: And [banana] trees layered [with fruit]

ayahs.arabic: وَظِلٍّۢ مَّمْدُودٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa zillim mamdood
ayahs.translation: And shade extended

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآءٍۢ مَّسْكُوبٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maaa'im maskoob
ayahs.translation: And water poured out

ayahs.arabic: وَفَٰكِهَةٍۢ كَثِيرَةٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa faakihatin kaseerah
ayahs.translation: And fruit, abundant [and varied],

ayahs.arabic: لَّا مَقْطُوعَةٍۢ وَلَا مَمْنُوعَةٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Laa maqtoo'atinw wa laa mamnoo'ah
ayahs.translation: Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden,

ayahs.arabic: وَفُرُشٍۢ مَّرْفُوعَةٍ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa furushim marfoo'ah
ayahs.translation: And [upon] beds raised high.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنشَأْنَٰهُنَّ إِنشَآءًۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Innaaa anshaanaahunna inshaaa'aa
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We have produced the women of Paradise in a [new] creation

ayahs.arabic: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُنَّ أَبْكَارًا
ayahs.transliteration: Faja'alnaahunna abkaaraa
ayahs.translation: And made them virgins,

ayahs.arabic: عُرُبًا أَتْرَابًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: 'Uruban atraabaa
ayahs.translation: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age,

ayahs.arabic: لِّأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
ayahs.transliteration: Li as haabil yameen
ayahs.translation: For the companions of the right [who are]

ayahs.arabic: ثُلَّةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Sullatum minal awwa leen
ayahs.translation: A company of the former peoples

ayahs.arabic: وَثُلَّةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa sullatum minal aakhireen
ayahs.translation: And a company of the later peoples.

144.arabicText: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ ۝٤١ فِى سَمُومٍۢ وَحَمِيمٍۢ ۝٤٢ وَظِلٍّۢ مِّن يَحْمُومٍۢ ۝٤٣ لَّا بَارِدٍۢ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ ۝٤٤ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ ۝٤٥ وَكَانُوا۟ يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى ٱلْحِنثِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ ۝٤٦ وَكَانُوا۟ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ ۝٤٧ أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ ۝٤٨ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ وَٱلْءَاخِرِينَ ۝٤٩ لَمَجْمُوعُونَ إِلَىٰ مِيقَٰتِ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ ۝٥٠ ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبُونَ ۝٥١ لَءَاكِلُونَ مِن شَجَرٍۢ مِّن زَقُّومٍۢ ۝٥٢ فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ ۝٥٣ فَشَٰرِبُونَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْحَمِيمِ ۝٥٤ فَشَٰرِبُونَ شُرْبَ ٱلْهِيمِ ۝٥٥ هَٰذَا نُزُلُهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ ۝٥٦
144.transliteration: Wa as haabush shimaali maaa as haabush shimaal (41) Fee samoominw wa hameem (42) Wa zillim miny yahmoom (43) Laa baaridinw wa laa kareem (44) Innaahum kaanoo qabla zaalika mutrafeen (45) Wa kaanoo yusirroona 'alal hinsil 'azeem (46) Wa kaanoo yaqooloona a'izaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaabanw wa izaaman'ainnaa lamab'oosoon (47) Awa aabaaa'unal awwaloon (48) Qul innal awwaleena wal aakhireen (49) Lamajmoo'oona ilaa meeqaati yawmim ma'loon (50) summa innakum ayyuhad daaalloonal mukazziboon (51) La aakiloona min shaja rim min zaqqoom (52) Famaali'oona minhal butoon (53) Fashaariboona 'alaihi minal hameem (54) Fashaariboona shurbal heem (55) Haazaa nuzuluhum yawmad deen (56)
144.translationEn: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left? [41] [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water [42] And a shade of black smoke, [43] Neither cool nor beneficial. [44] Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence, [45] And they used to persist in the great violation, [46] And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected? [47] And our forefathers [as well]?" [48] Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, the former and the later peoples [49] Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day." [50] Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers, [51] Will be eating from trees of zaqqum [52] And filling with it your bellies [53] And drinking on top of it from scalding water [54] And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels. [55] That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense. [56]
