ayahs.translation: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten."

ayahs.arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحْزَنِى قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Fanaadaahaa min tahtihaan allaa tahzanee qad ja'ala Rabbuki tahtaki sariyyaa
ayahs.translation: But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.

187.arabicText: وَهُزِّىٓ إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ تُسَٰقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًۭا جَنِيًّۭا ۝٢٥ فَكُلِى وَٱشْرَبِى وَقَرِّى عَيْنًۭا ۖ فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ ٱلْبَشَرِ أَحَدًۭا فَقُولِىٓ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ صَوْمًۭا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنسِيًّۭا ۝٢٦ فَأَتَتْ بِهِۦ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُۥ ۖ قَالُوا۟ يَٰمَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْـًۭٔا فَرِيًّۭا ۝٢٧ يَٰٓأُخْتَ هَٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ ٱمْرَأَ سَوْءٍۢ وَمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّۭا ۝٢٨ فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ ۖ قَالُوا۟ كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّۭا ۝٢٩ قَالَ إِنِّى عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ ءَاتَىٰنِىَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِى نَبِيًّۭا ۝٣٠
187.transliteration: Wa huzzeee ilaiki bijiz 'in nakhlati tusaaqit 'alaiki rutaban janiyyaa (25) Fakulee washrabee wa qarree 'ainaa; fa immaa tarayinnna minal bashari ahadan faqooleee innee nazartu lir Rahmaani sawman falan ukallimal yawma insiyyaa (26) Fa atat bihee qawmahaa tahmiluhoo qaaloo yaa Maryamoo laqad ji'ti shai'an fariyyaa (27) Yaaa ukkhta Haaroona maa kaana abokim ra-a saw'inw wa maa kaanat ummuki baghiyyaa (28) Fa ashaarat ilaih; qaaloo kaifa nukallimu man kaana fil mahdi sabiyyaa (29) Qaala innee 'abdullaahi aataaniyal Kitaaba wa ja'alanee Nabiyyaa (30)
187.translationEn: And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates. [25] So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.' " [26] Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented. [27] O sister of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste." [28] So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?" [29] [Jesus] said, "Indeed, I am the servant of Allah. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet. [30]

ayahs.arabic: وَهُزِّىٓ إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ تُسَٰقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًۭا جَنِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa huzzeee ilaiki bijiz 'in nakhlati tusaaqit 'alaiki rutaban janiyyaa
ayahs.translation: And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.

ayahs.arabic: فَكُلِى وَٱشْرَبِى وَقَرِّى عَيْنًۭا ۖ فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ ٱلْبَشَرِ أَحَدًۭا فَقُولِىٓ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ صَوْمًۭا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنسِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Fakulee washrabee wa qarree 'ainaa; fa immaa tarayinnna minal bashari ahadan faqooleee innee nazartu lir Rahmaani sawman falan ukallimal yawma insiyyaa
ayahs.translation: So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.' "

ayahs.arabic: فَأَتَتْ بِهِۦ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُۥ ۖ قَالُوا۟ يَٰمَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْـًۭٔا فَرِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Fa atat bihee qawmahaa tahmiluhoo qaaloo yaa Maryamoo laqad ji'ti shai'an fariyyaa
ayahs.translation: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأُخْتَ هَٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ ٱمْرَأَ سَوْءٍۢ وَمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Yaaa ukkhta Haaroona maa kaana abokim ra-a saw'inw wa maa kaanat ummuki baghiyyaa
ayahs.translation: O sister of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste."

ayahs.arabic: فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ ۖ قَالُوا۟ كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Fa ashaarat ilaih; qaaloo kaifa nukallimu man kaana fil mahdi sabiyyaa
ayahs.translation: So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ إِنِّى عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ ءَاتَىٰنِىَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِى نَبِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala innee 'abdullaahi aataaniyal Kitaaba wa ja'alanee Nabiyyaa
ayahs.translation: [Jesus] said, "Indeed, I am the servant of Allah. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.

188.arabicText: وَجَعَلَنِى مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوْصَٰنِى بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّۭا ۝٣١ وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِى وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِى جَبَّارًۭا شَقِيًّۭا ۝٣٢ وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّۭا ۝٣٣ ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ۚ قَوْلَ ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ ۝٣٤ مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٍۢ ۖ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥٓ ۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًۭا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ ۝٣٥
188.transliteration: Wa ja'alanee mubaarakan aina maa kuntu wa awsaanee bis Salaati waz Zakaati maa dumtu haiyaa (31) Wa barram biwaalidatee wa lam yaj'alnee jabbaaran shaqiyyaa (32) Wassalaamu 'alaiya yawma wulittu wa yawma amootu wa yawma ub'asu baiyaa (33) Zaalika 'Eesab-nu Marya; qawlal haqqil lazee feehi yamtaroon (34) Maa kaana lillaahi ai yattakhiza minw waladin Subhaanah; izaa qadaaa amran fa innamaa yaqoolu lahoo kun fa yakoon (35)
188.translationEn: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakah as long as I remain alive [31] And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant. [32] And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive." [33] That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute. [34] It is not [befitting] for Allah to take a son; exalted is He! When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is. [35]

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلَنِى مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوْصَٰنِى بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ja'alanee mubaarakan aina maa kuntu wa awsaanee bis Salaati waz Zakaati maa dumtu haiyaa
ayahs.translation: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakah as long as I remain alive

ayahs.arabic: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِى وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِى جَبَّارًۭا شَقِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa barram biwaalidatee wa lam yaj'alnee jabbaaran shaqiyyaa
ayahs.translation: And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wassalaamu 'alaiya yawma wulittu wa yawma amootu wa yawma ub'asu baiyaa
ayahs.translation: And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive."

ayahs.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ۚ قَوْلَ ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Zaalika 'Eesab-nu Marya; qawlal haqqil lazee feehi yamtaroon
ayahs.translation: That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.

ayahs.arabic: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٍۢ ۖ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥٓ ۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًۭا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
ayahs.transliteration: Maa kaana lillaahi ai yattakhiza minw waladin Subhaanah; izaa qadaaa amran fa innamaa yaqoolu lahoo kun fa yakoon
ayahs.translation: It is not [befitting] for Allah to take a son; exalted is He! When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.

189.arabicText: وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ ۝٣٦ فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ ۝٣٧ أَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَأْتُونَنَا ۖ لَٰكِنِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ ۝٣٨ وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ وَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ ۝٣٩ إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ ۝٤٠
189.transliteration: Wa innal laaha Rabbee wa Rabbukum fa'budooh; haazaa Siraatum Mustaqeem (36) Fakhtalafal ahzaabu mim bainihim fawailul lillazeena kafaroo mim mashhadi Yawmin 'azeem (37) Asmi' bihim wa absir Yawma yaatoonanaa laakiniz zaalimoonal yawma fee dalaalim mubeen (38) Wa anzirhum Yawmal hasrati iz qudiyal amr; wa hum fee ghaflatinw wa hum laa yu'minoon (39) Innaa NNahnu narisul arda wa man 'alaihaa wa ilainaa yurja'oon (40)
189.translationEn: [Jesus said], "And indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path." [36] Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day. [37] How [clearly] they will hear and see the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error. [38] And warn them, [O Muhammad], of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded; and [yet], they are in [a state of] heedlessness, and they do not believe. [39] Indeed, it is We who will inherit the earth and whoever is on it, and to Us they will be returned. [40]

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa innal laaha Rabbee wa Rabbukum fa'budooh; haazaa Siraatum Mustaqeem
ayahs.translation: [Jesus said], "And indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path."

ayahs.arabic: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
ayahs.transliteration: Fakhtalafal ahzaabu mim bainihim fawailul lillazeena kafaroo mim mashhadi Yawmin 'azeem
ayahs.translation: Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day.

ayahs.arabic: أَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَأْتُونَنَا ۖ لَٰكِنِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
ayahs.transliteration: Asmi' bihim wa absir Yawma yaatoonanaa laakiniz zaalimoonal yawma fee dalaalim mubeen
ayahs.translation: How [clearly] they will hear and see the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ وَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa anzirhum Yawmal hasrati iz qudiyal amr; wa hum fee ghaflatinw wa hum laa yu'minoon
ayahs.translation: And warn them, [O Muhammad], of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded; and [yet], they are in [a state of] heedlessness, and they do not believe.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa NNahnu narisul arda wa man 'alaihaa wa ilainaa yurja'oon
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it is We who will inherit the earth and whoever is on it, and to Us they will be returned.

190.arabicText: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًۭا نَّبِيًّا ۝٤١ إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنكَ شَيْـًۭٔا ۝٤٢ يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى قَدْ جَآءَنِى مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعْنِىٓ أَهْدِكَ صِرَٰطًۭا سَوِيًّۭا ۝٤٣ يَٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَصِيًّۭا ۝٤٤ يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَٰنِ وَلِيًّۭا ۝٤٥ قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنْ ءَالِهَتِى يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ ۖ وَٱهْجُرْنِى مَلِيًّۭا ۝٤٦ قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكَ ۖ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِى حَفِيًّۭا ۝٤٧ وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّى شَقِيًّۭا ۝٤٨
190.transliteration: Wazkur fil Kitaabi Ibraaheem; innahoo kaana siddeeqan Nabiyyaa (41) Iz qaala li abeehi yaaa abati lima ta'budu maa laa yasma'u wa laa yubsiru wa laa yughnee 'anka shai'aa (42) Yaaa abati innee qad jaaa'anee minal 'ilmi maa lam yaatika fattabi'neee ahdika siraatan Sawiyyaa (43) Yaaa abati laa ta'budish Shaitaana innash Shaitaana kaana lir Rahmaani 'asiyyaa (44) Yaaa abati innee akhaafu ai yamssaka 'azaabum minar Rahmaani fatakoona lish Shaitaani waliyyaa (45) Qaala araaghibun anta 'an aalihatee yaaa Ibraaheemu la 'il lam tantahi la arjumannaka wahjumee maliyyaa (46) Qaala salaamun 'alaika sa astaghfiru laka Rabbeee innahoo kaana bee hafiyyaa (47) Wa a'tazilukum wa maa tad'oona min doonil laahi wa ad'o Rabbee 'asaaa allaaa akoona bidu'aaa'i Rabbee shaqiyyaa (48)
190.translationEn: And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet. [41] [Mention] when he said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see and will not benefit you at all? [42] O my father, indeed there has come to me of knowledge that which has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to an even path. [43] O my father, do not worship Satan. Indeed Satan has ever been, to the Most Merciful, disobedient. [44] O my father, indeed I fear that there will touch you a punishment from the Most Merciful so you would be to Satan a companion [in Hellfire]." [45] [His father] said, "Have you no desire for my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time." [46] [Abraham] said, "Peace will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me. [47] And I will leave you and those you invoke other than Allah and will invoke my Lord. I expect that I will not be in invocation to my Lord unhappy." [48]

ayahs.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًۭا نَّبِيًّا
ayahs.transliteration: Wazkur fil Kitaabi Ibraaheem; innahoo kaana siddeeqan Nabiyyaa
ayahs.translation: And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنكَ شَيْـًۭٔا
ayahs.transliteration: Iz qaala li abeehi yaaa abati lima ta'budu maa laa yasma'u wa laa yubsiru wa laa yughnee 'anka shai'aa
ayahs.translation: [Mention] when he said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see and will not benefit you at all?

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى قَدْ جَآءَنِى مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعْنِىٓ أَهْدِكَ صِرَٰطًۭا سَوِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Yaaa abati innee qad jaaa'anee minal 'ilmi maa lam yaatika fattabi'neee ahdika siraatan Sawiyyaa
ayahs.translation: O my father, indeed there has come to me of knowledge that which has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to an even path.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَصِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Yaaa abati laa ta'budish Shaitaana innash Shaitaana kaana lir Rahmaani 'asiyyaa
ayahs.translation: O my father, do not worship Satan. Indeed Satan has ever been, to the Most Merciful, disobedient.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَٰنِ وَلِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Yaaa abati innee akhaafu ai yamssaka 'azaabum minar Rahmaani fatakoona lish Shaitaani waliyyaa
ayahs.translation: O my father, indeed I fear that there will touch you a punishment from the Most Merciful so you would be to Satan a companion [in Hellfire]."

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنْ ءَالِهَتِى يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ ۖ وَٱهْجُرْنِى مَلِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala araaghibun anta 'an aalihatee yaaa Ibraaheemu la 'il lam tantahi la arjumannaka wahjumee maliyyaa
ayahs.translation: [His father] said, "Have you no desire for my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time."

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكَ ۖ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِى حَفِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala salaamun 'alaika sa astaghfiru laka Rabbeee innahoo kaana bee hafiyyaa
ayahs.translation: [Abraham] said, "Peace will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّى شَقِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa a'tazilukum wa maa tad'oona min doonil laahi wa ad'o Rabbee 'asaaa allaaa akoona bidu'aaa'i Rabbee shaqiyyaa
ayahs.translation: And I will leave you and those you invoke other than Allah and will invoke my Lord. I expect that I will not be in invocation to my Lord unhappy."

191.arabicText: فَلَمَّا ٱعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَكُلًّۭا جَعَلْنَا نَبِيًّۭا ۝٤٩ وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّۭا ۝٥٠ وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخْلَصًۭا وَكَانَ رَسُولًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا ۝٥١ وَنَٰدَيْنَٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَٰهُ نَجِيًّۭا ۝٥٢ وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ مِن رَّحْمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ نَبِيًّۭا ۝٥٣ وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا ۝٥٤ وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرْضِيًّۭا ۝٥٥ وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِدْرِيسَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا ۝٥٦
191.transliteration: Falamma' tazalahum wa maa ya'budoona min doonil laahi wahabnaa lahoo is-haaqa wa ya'qoob, wa kullan ja'alnaa Nabiyyaa (49) Wa wahabnaa lahum mirrahmatinaa wa ja'alnaa lahum lisaana sidqin 'aliyyaa (50) Wazkur fil Kitaabi Moosaaa; innahoo kaana mukhlasanw wa kaana Rasoolan Nabiyyaa (51) Wa naadainaahu min jaanibit Tooril aimani wa qarrabnaahu najiyyaa (52) Wa wahabnaa lahoo mir rahmatinaaa akhaahu Haaroona Nabiyyaa (53) Wazkur fil Kitaabi ismaa'eel; innahoo kaana saadiqal wa'di wa kaana Rasoolan Nabiyyaa (54) Wa kaana yaamuru ahlahoo bis Salaati waz zakaati wa kaana 'inda Rabbihee mardiyyaa (55) Wazkur fil Kitaabi Idrees; innahoo kaana siddeeqan Nabiyyaa (56)
191.translationEn: So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each [of them] We made a prophet. [49] And We gave them of Our mercy, and we made for them a reputation of high honor. [50] And mention in the Book, Moses. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet. [51] And We called him from the side of the mount at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him]. [52] And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron as a prophet. [53] And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet. [54] And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakah and was to his Lord pleasing. [55] And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet. [56]

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا ٱعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَكُلًّۭا جَعَلْنَا نَبِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Falamma' tazalahum wa maa ya'budoona min doonil laahi wahabnaa lahoo is-haaqa wa ya'qoob, wa kullan ja'alnaa Nabiyyaa
ayahs.translation: So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each [of them] We made a prophet.

ayahs.arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa wahabnaa lahum mirrahmatinaa wa ja'alnaa lahum lisaana sidqin 'aliyyaa
ayahs.translation: And We gave them of Our mercy, and we made for them a reputation of high honor.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخْلَصًۭا وَكَانَ رَسُولًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wazkur fil Kitaabi Moosaaa; innahoo kaana mukhlasanw wa kaana Rasoolan Nabiyyaa
ayahs.translation: And mention in the Book, Moses. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet.

ayahs.arabic: وَنَٰدَيْنَٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَٰهُ نَجِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa naadainaahu min jaanibit Tooril aimani wa qarrabnaahu najiyyaa
ayahs.translation: And We called him from the side of the mount at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him].

ayahs.arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ مِن رَّحْمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ نَبِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa wahabnaa lahoo mir rahmatinaaa akhaahu Haaroona Nabiyyaa
ayahs.translation: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron as a prophet.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wazkur fil Kitaabi ismaa'eel; innahoo kaana saadiqal wa'di wa kaana Rasoolan Nabiyyaa
ayahs.translation: And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet.

ayahs.arabic: وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرْضِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa kaana yaamuru ahlahoo bis Salaati waz zakaati wa kaana 'inda Rabbihee mardiyyaa
ayahs.translation: And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakah and was to his Lord pleasing.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِدْرِيسَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wazkur fil Kitaabi Idrees; innahoo kaana siddeeqan Nabiyyaa
ayahs.translation: And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.

192.arabicText: وَرَفَعْنَٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا ۝٥٧ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍۢ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَٱجْتَبَيْنَآ ۚ إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًۭا وَبُكِيًّۭا ۩ ۝٥٨ ۞ فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا ۝٥٩ إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْـًۭٔا ۝٦٠ جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَأْتِيًّۭا ۝٦١ لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَٰمًۭا ۖ وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةًۭ وَعَشِيًّۭا ۝٦٢ تِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِى نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيًّۭا ۝٦٣ وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ ۖ لَهُۥ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّۭا ۝٦٤ رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَٱعْبُدْهُ وَٱصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَٰدَتِهِۦ ۚ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيًّۭا ۝٦٥
192.transliteration: Wa rafa'naahu makaanan 'aliyyaa (57) Ulaaa'ikal lazeena an'amal laahu 'alaihim minan Nabiyyeena min zurriyyati Aadama wa mimman hamalnaa ma'a Noohinw wa min zurriyyati Ibraaheema wa Israaa'eela wa mimman hadainaa wajta bainaaa; izaa tutlaa 'alaihim Aayaatur Rahmaani kharroo sujjadanw wa bukiyyaa (58) Fakhalafa mim ba'dihim khalfun adaa'us Salaata wattaba'ush shahawaati fasawfa yalqawna ghaiyaa (59) Illaa man taaba wa aamana wa 'amila saalihan fa ulaaa'ika yadkhuloonal jannata wa laa yuzlamoona shai'aa (60) Jannaati 'adninil latee wa'adar Rahmaanu ibaadahoo bilghaib; innahoo kaana wa'duhoo maatiyyaa (61) Laa yasma'oona feehaa laghwan illaa salaamaa; wa lahum rizquhum feehaa bukratanw wa 'ashiyyaa (62) Tilkal jannatul latee oorisu min 'ibaadinaa man kaana taqiyyaa (63) Wa maa natanazzalu illaa bi amri Rabbika lahoo maa baina aideenaa wa maa khalfanaa wa maa baina zaalik; wa maa kaana Rabbuka nasiyyaa (64) Rabbus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa fa'bud hu wastabir li'ibaadatih; hal ta'lamu lahoo samiyyaa (65)
192.translationEn: And We raised him to a high station. [57] Those were the ones upon whom Allah bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping. [58] But there came after them successors who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil - [59] Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all. [60] [Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been coming. [61] They will not hear therein any ill speech - only [greetings of] peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon. [62] That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allah. [63] [Gabriel said], "And we [angels] descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful - [64] Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him?" [65]

ayahs.arabic: وَرَفَعْنَٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa rafa'naahu makaanan 'aliyyaa
ayahs.translation: And We raised him to a high station.

ayahs.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍۢ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَٱجْتَبَيْنَآ ۚ إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًۭا وَبُكِيًّۭا ۩
ayahs.transliteration: Ulaaa'ikal lazeena an'amal laahu 'alaihim minan Nabiyyeena min zurriyyati Aadama wa mimman hamalnaa ma'a Noohinw wa min zurriyyati Ibraaheema wa Israaa'eela wa mimman hadainaa wajta bainaaa; izaa tutlaa 'alaihim Aayaatur Rahmaani kharroo sujjadanw wa bukiyyaa
ayahs.translation: Those were the ones upon whom Allah bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا
ayahs.transliteration: Fakhalafa mim ba'dihim khalfun adaa'us Salaata wattaba'ush shahawaati fasawfa yalqawna ghaiyaa
ayahs.translation: But there came after them successors who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil -

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْـًۭٔا
ayahs.transliteration: Illaa man taaba wa aamana wa 'amila saalihan fa ulaaa'ika yadkhuloonal jannata wa laa yuzlamoona shai'aa
ayahs.translation: Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all.

ayahs.arabic: جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَأْتِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Jannaati 'adninil latee wa'adar Rahmaanu ibaadahoo bilghaib; innahoo kaana wa'duhoo maatiyyaa
ayahs.translation: [Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been coming.

ayahs.arabic: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَٰمًۭا ۖ وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةًۭ وَعَشِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Laa yasma'oona feehaa laghwan illaa salaamaa; wa lahum rizquhum feehaa bukratanw wa 'ashiyyaa
ayahs.translation: They will not hear therein any ill speech - only [greetings of] peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon.

ayahs.arabic: تِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِى نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Tilkal jannatul latee oorisu min 'ibaadinaa man kaana taqiyyaa
ayahs.translation: That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allah.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ ۖ لَهُۥ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa natanazzalu illaa bi amri Rabbika lahoo maa baina aideenaa wa maa khalfanaa wa maa baina zaalik; wa maa kaana Rabbuka nasiyyaa
ayahs.translation: [Gabriel said], "And we [angels] descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful -

ayahs.arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَٱعْبُدْهُ وَٱصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَٰدَتِهِۦ ۚ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Rabbus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa fa'bud hu wastabir li'ibaadatih; hal ta'lamu lahoo samiyyaa
ayahs.translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him?"

193.arabicText: وَيَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيًّا ۝٦٦ أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْـًۭٔا ۝٦٧ فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّۭا ۝٦٨ ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عِتِيًّۭا ۝٦٩ ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيًّۭا ۝٧٠ وَإِن مِّنكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْمًۭا مَّقْضِيًّۭا ۝٧١ ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّۭا ۝٧٢ وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌۭ مَّقَامًۭا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّۭا ۝٧٣ وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَٰثًۭا وَرِءْيًۭا ۝٧٤
193.transliteration: Wa yaqoolul insaanu 'aizaa maa mittu lasawfa ukhraju haiyaa (66) awalaa yazkurul insaanu annaa khalaqnaahu min qablu wa lam yaku shai'aa (67) Fawa Rabbika lanahshu rannahum wash shayaateena summa lanuhdirannahum hawla jahannama jisiyyaa (68) Summa lananzi 'anna min kulli shee'atin aiyuhum ashaddu 'alar Rahmaani 'itiyyaa (69) Summa lanahnu a'lamu billazeena hum awlaa bihaa siliyyaa (70) Wa im minkum illaa waa riduhaa; kaana 'alaa Rabbika hatmam maqdiyyaa (71) Summa nunajjil lazeenat taqaw wa nazaruz zaalimeena feehaa jisiyyaa (72) Wa izaa tutlaa 'alaihim Aayaatunaa baiyinaatin qaalal lazeena kafaroo lillazeena aamanooo aiyul fareeqaini khairum maqaamanw wa ahsanu nadiyyaa (73) Wa kam ahlaknaa qablahum min qarnin hum ahsanu asaasanw wa ri'yaa (74)
193.translationEn: And the disbeliever says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive?" [66] Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing? [67] So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees. [68] Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence. [69] Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein. [70] And there is none of you except he will come to it. This is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed. [71] Then We will save those who feared Allah and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees. [72] And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of [our] two parties is best in position and best in association?" [73] And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance? [74]

ayahs.arabic: وَيَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيًّا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa yaqoolul insaanu 'aizaa maa mittu lasawfa ukhraju haiyaa
ayahs.translation: And the disbeliever says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive?"

ayahs.arabic: أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْـًۭٔا
ayahs.transliteration: awalaa yazkurul insaanu annaa khalaqnaahu min qablu wa lam yaku shai'aa
ayahs.translation: Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing?

ayahs.arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Fawa Rabbika lanahshu rannahum wash shayaateena summa lanuhdirannahum hawla jahannama jisiyyaa
ayahs.translation: So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عِتِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Summa lananzi 'anna min kulli shee'atin aiyuhum ashaddu 'alar Rahmaani 'itiyyaa
ayahs.translation: Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Summa lanahnu a'lamu billazeena hum awlaa bihaa siliyyaa
ayahs.translation: Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِن مِّنكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْمًۭا مَّقْضِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa im minkum illaa waa riduhaa; kaana 'alaa Rabbika hatmam maqdiyyaa
ayahs.translation: And there is none of you except he will come to it. This is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Summa nunajjil lazeenat taqaw wa nazaruz zaalimeena feehaa jisiyyaa
ayahs.translation: Then We will save those who feared Allah and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌۭ مَّقَامًۭا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izaa tutlaa 'alaihim Aayaatunaa baiyinaatin qaalal lazeena kafaroo lillazeena aamanooo aiyul fareeqaini khairum maqaamanw wa ahsanu nadiyyaa
ayahs.translation: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of [our] two parties is best in position and best in association?"

ayahs.arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَٰثًۭا وَرِءْيًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa kam ahlaknaa qablahum min qarnin hum ahsanu asaasanw wa ri'yaa
ayahs.translation: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance?

194.arabicText: قُلْ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلضَّلَٰلَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مَدًّا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّۭ مَّكَانًۭا وَأَضْعَفُ جُندًۭا ۝٧٥ وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهْتَدَوْا۟ هُدًۭى ۗ وَٱلْبَٰقِيَٰتُ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًۭا وَخَيْرٌۭ مَّرَدًّا ۝٧٦ أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالًۭا وَوَلَدًا ۝٧٧ أَطَّلَعَ ٱلْغَيْبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًۭا ۝٧٨ كَلَّا ۚ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ مَدًّۭا ۝٧٩ وَنَرِثُهُۥ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًۭا ۝٨٠ وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةًۭ لِّيَكُونُوا۟ لَهُمْ عِزًّۭا ۝٨١ كَلَّا ۚ سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا ۝٨٢
194.transliteration: Qul man kaana fidda laalati falyamdud lahur Rahmaanu maddaa; hattaaa izaa ra aw maa yoo'adoona immal 'azaaba wa immas Saa'ata fasa ya'lamoona man huwa sharrum makaananw wa ad'afu jundaa (75) Wa yazeedul laahul lazeenah tadaw hudaa; wal baaqiyaatus saalihaatu khairun 'inda Rabbika sawaabanw wa khairum maraddaa (76) Afara'aytal lazee kafara bi Aayaatinaa wa qaala la oota yanna maalanw wa waladaa (77) Attala'al ghaiba amitta khaza'indar Rahmaani 'ahdaa (78) Kallaa; sanaktubu maa yaqoolu wa namuddu lahoo minal 'azaabi maddaa (79) Wa narisuhoo maa yaqoolu wa yaateenaa fardaa (80) Wattakhazoo min doonil laahi aalihatal liyakoonoo lahum 'izzaa (81) Kallaa; sa yakfuroona bi'ibaadatihim wa yakoonoona 'alaihim diddaa (82)
194.translationEn: Say, "Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension [in wealth and time] until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment [in this world] or the Hour [of resurrection] - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers." [75] And Allah increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for recourse. [76] Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]?" [77] Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise? [78] No! We will record what he says and extend for him from the punishment extensively. [79] And We will inherit him [in] what he mentions, and he will come to Us alone. [80] And they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honor. [81] No! Those "gods" will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement]. [82]

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلضَّلَٰلَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مَدًّا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّۭ مَّكَانًۭا وَأَضْعَفُ جُندًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Qul man kaana fidda laalati falyamdud lahur Rahmaanu maddaa; hattaaa izaa ra aw maa yoo'adoona immal 'azaaba wa immas Saa'ata fasa ya'lamoona man huwa sharrum makaananw wa ad'afu jundaa
ayahs.translation: Say, "Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension [in wealth and time] until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment [in this world] or the Hour [of resurrection] - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers."

ayahs.arabic: وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهْتَدَوْا۟ هُدًۭى ۗ وَٱلْبَٰقِيَٰتُ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًۭا وَخَيْرٌۭ مَّرَدًّا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa yazeedul laahul lazeenah tadaw hudaa; wal baaqiyaatus saalihaatu khairun 'inda Rabbika sawaabanw wa khairum maraddaa
ayahs.translation: And Allah increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for recourse.

ayahs.arabic: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالًۭا وَوَلَدًا
ayahs.transliteration: Afara'aytal lazee kafara bi Aayaatinaa wa qaala la oota yanna maalanw wa waladaa
ayahs.translation: Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]?"

ayahs.arabic: أَطَّلَعَ ٱلْغَيْبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Attala'al ghaiba amitta khaza'indar Rahmaani 'ahdaa
ayahs.translation: Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise?

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا ۚ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ مَدًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Kallaa; sanaktubu maa yaqoolu wa namuddu lahoo minal 'azaabi maddaa
ayahs.translation: No! We will record what he says and extend for him from the punishment extensively.

ayahs.arabic: وَنَرِثُهُۥ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa narisuhoo maa yaqoolu wa yaateenaa fardaa
ayahs.translation: And We will inherit him [in] what he mentions, and he will come to Us alone.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةًۭ لِّيَكُونُوا۟ لَهُمْ عِزًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wattakhazoo min doonil laahi aalihatal liyakoonoo lahum 'izzaa
ayahs.translation: And they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honor.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا ۚ سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا
ayahs.transliteration: Kallaa; sa yakfuroona bi'ibaadatihim wa yakoonoona 'alaihim diddaa
ayahs.translation: No! Those "gods" will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement].

195.arabicText: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّۭا ۝٨٣ فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّۭا ۝٨٤ يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَفْدًۭا ۝٨٥ وَنَسُوقُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًۭا ۝٨٦ لَّا يَمْلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًۭا ۝٨٧ وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَلَدًۭا ۝٨٨ لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِدًّۭا ۝٨٩ تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلْجِبَالُ هَدًّا ۝٩٠
195.transliteration: Alam tara annaaa arsalnash Shayaateena 'alal kaafireena ta'uzzuhum azzaa (83) Falaa ta'jal alaihim innamaa na 'uddu lahum 'addaa (84) Yawma nahshurul muttaqeena ilar Rahmaani wafdaa (85) Wa nasooqul mujrimeena ilaa Jahannama wirdaa (86) Laa yamlikoonash shafaa'ta illaa manittakhaza 'indar Rahmaani 'ahdaa (87) Wa qaalut takhazar Rahmaanu waladaa (88) Laqad ji'tum shai'an iddaa (89) Takaadus samaawaatu yatafattarna minhu wa tanshaq qul ardu wa takhirrul jibaalu haddaa (90)
195.translationEn: Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them to [evil] with [constant] incitement? [83] So be not impatient over them. We only count out to them a [limited] number. [84] On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation [85] And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst [86] None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant. [87] And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken [for Himself] a son." [88] You have done an atrocious thing. [89] The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation [90]

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Alam tara annaaa arsalnash Shayaateena 'alal kaafireena ta'uzzuhum azzaa
ayahs.translation: Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them to [evil] with [constant] incitement?

ayahs.arabic: فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Falaa ta'jal alaihim innamaa na 'uddu lahum 'addaa
ayahs.translation: So be not impatient over them. We only count out to them a [limited] number.

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَفْدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma nahshurul muttaqeena ilar Rahmaani wafdaa
ayahs.translation: On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation

ayahs.arabic: وَنَسُوقُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa nasooqul mujrimeena ilaa Jahannama wirdaa
ayahs.translation: And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst

ayahs.arabic: لَّا يَمْلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Laa yamlikoonash shafaa'ta illaa manittakhaza 'indar Rahmaani 'ahdaa
ayahs.translation: None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant.

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَلَدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa qaalut takhazar Rahmaanu waladaa
ayahs.translation: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken [for Himself] a son."

ayahs.arabic: لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِدًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Laqad ji'tum shai'an iddaa
ayahs.translation: You have done an atrocious thing.

ayahs.arabic: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلْجِبَالُ هَدًّا
ayahs.transliteration: Takaadus samaawaatu yatafattarna minhu wa tanshaq qul ardu wa takhirrul jibaalu haddaa
ayahs.translation: The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation

196.arabicText: أَن دَعَوْا۟ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدًۭا ۝٩١ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا ۝٩٢ إِن كُلُّ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَبْدًۭا ۝٩٣ لَّقَدْ أَحْصَىٰهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّۭا ۝٩٤ وَكُلُّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فَرْدًا ۝٩٥ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وُدًّۭا ۝٩٦ فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوْمًۭا لُّدًّۭا ۝٩٧ وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًۢا ۝٩٨
196.transliteration: An da'aw lir Rahmaani waladaa (91) Wa maa yambaghee lir Rahmaani ai yattakhiza waladaa (92) In kullu man fis samaawaati wal ardi illaaa aatir Rahmaani 'abdaa (93) Laqad ahsaahum wa addahum 'addaa (94) Wa kulluhum aateehi Yawmal Qiyaamati fardaa (95) Innal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati sa yaj'alu lahumur Rahmaanu wuddaa (96) Fa innamaa yassarnaahu bilisaanika litubashshira bihil muttaqeena wa tunzira bihee qawmal luddaa (97) Wa kam ahlaknaa qabla hum min qarnin hal tuhissu minhum min ahadin aw tasma'u lahum rikzaa (98)
196.translationEn: That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son. [91] And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son. [92] There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant. [93] He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting. [94] And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone. [95] Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection. [96] So, [O Muhammad], We have only made Qur'an easy in the Arabic language that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people. [97] And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound? [98]

ayahs.arabic: أَن دَعَوْا۟ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: An da'aw lir Rahmaani waladaa
ayahs.translation: That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa yambaghee lir Rahmaani ai yattakhiza waladaa
ayahs.translation: And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son.

ayahs.arabic: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَبْدًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: In kullu man fis samaawaati wal ardi illaaa aatir Rahmaani 'abdaa
ayahs.translation: There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant.

ayahs.arabic: لَّقَدْ أَحْصَىٰهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Laqad ahsaahum wa addahum 'addaa
ayahs.translation: He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting.

ayahs.arabic: وَكُلُّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فَرْدًا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa kulluhum aateehi Yawmal Qiyaamati fardaa
ayahs.translation: And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وُدًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Innal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati sa yaj'alu lahumur Rahmaanu wuddaa
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوْمًۭا لُّدًّۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Fa innamaa yassarnaahu bilisaanika litubashshira bihil muttaqeena wa tunzira bihee qawmal luddaa
ayahs.translation: So, [O Muhammad], We have only made Qur'an easy in the Arabic language that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people.

ayahs.arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًۢا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa kam ahlaknaa qabla hum min qarnin hal tuhissu minhum min ahadin aw tasma'u lahum rikzaa
ayahs.translation: And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound?

197.arabicText: طه ۝١ مَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِتَشْقَىٰٓ ۝٢ إِلَّا تَذْكِرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ ۝٣ تَنزِيلًۭا مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلْعُلَى ۝٤ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱسْتَوَىٰ ۝٥ لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحْتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ ۝٦ وَإِن تَجْهَرْ بِٱلْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى ۝٧ ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۝٨ وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ ۝٩ إِذْ رَءَا نَارًۭا فَقَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ ٱمْكُثُوٓا۟ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًۭا لَّعَلِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوْ أَجِدُ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ هُدًۭى ۝١٠ فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِىَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ ۝١١ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَٱخْلَعْ نَعْلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًۭى ۝١٢
197.transliteration: Taa-Haa (1) Maaa anzalnaa 'alaikal Qur-aana litashqaaa (2) Illaa tazkiratal limany yakshaa (3) Tanzeelam mimman khalaqal arda was samaawaatil 'ulaa (4) Ar-Rahmaanu 'alal 'Arshis tawaa (5) Lahoo maa fis samaawaati wa maa fil ardi wa maa bainahumaa wa maa tahtassaraa (6) Wa in tajhar bilqawli fainnahoo ya'lamus sirra wa akhfaa (7) Allaahu laaa ilasha illaa Huwa lahul Asmaaa'ul Husnaa (8) Wa hal ataaka hadeesu Moosa (9) Iz ra aa naaran faqaala li alhlihim kusooo inneee aanastu naaral la'alleee aateekum minhaa biqabasin aw ajidu 'alan naari hudaa (10) Falammaaa ataahaa noodiya yaa Moosaa (11) Inneee Ana Rabbuka fakhla' na'laika innaka bilwaadil muqaddasi Tuwaa (12)
197.translationEn: Ta, Ha. [1] We have not sent down to you the Qur'an that you be distressed [2] But only as a reminder for those who fear [Allah] - [3] A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens, [4] The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established. [5] To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil. [6] And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden. [7] Allah - there is no deity except Him. To Him belong the best names. [8] And has the story of Moses reached you? - [9] When he saw a fire and said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire; perhaps I can bring you a torch or find at the fire some guidance." [10] And when he came to it, he was called, "O Moses, [11] Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals. Indeed, you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa. [12]

ayahs.arabic: طه
ayahs.transliteration: Taa-Haa
ayahs.translation: Ta, Ha.

ayahs.arabic: مَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِتَشْقَىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Maaa anzalnaa 'alaikal Qur-aana litashqaaa
ayahs.translation: We have not sent down to you the Qur'an that you be distressed

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا تَذْكِرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Illaa tazkiratal limany yakshaa
ayahs.translation: But only as a reminder for those who fear [Allah] -

ayahs.arabic: تَنزِيلًۭا مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلْعُلَى
ayahs.transliteration: Tanzeelam mimman khalaqal arda was samaawaatil 'ulaa
ayahs.translation: A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱسْتَوَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Ar-Rahmaanu 'alal 'Arshis tawaa
ayahs.translation: The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established.

ayahs.arabic: لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحْتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Lahoo maa fis samaawaati wa maa fil ardi wa maa bainahumaa wa maa tahtassaraa
ayahs.translation: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِن تَجْهَرْ بِٱلْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى
ayahs.transliteration: Wa in tajhar bilqawli fainnahoo ya'lamus sirra wa akhfaa
ayahs.translation: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden.

ayahs.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Allaahu laaa ilasha illaa Huwa lahul Asmaaa'ul Husnaa
ayahs.translation: Allah - there is no deity except Him. To Him belong the best names.

ayahs.arabic: وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa hal ataaka hadeesu Moosa
ayahs.translation: And has the story of Moses reached you? -

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ رَءَا نَارًۭا فَقَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ ٱمْكُثُوٓا۟ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًۭا لَّعَلِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوْ أَجِدُ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ هُدًۭى
ayahs.transliteration: Iz ra aa naaran faqaala li alhlihim kusooo inneee aanastu naaral la'alleee aateekum minhaa biqabasin aw ajidu 'alan naari hudaa
ayahs.translation: When he saw a fire and said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire; perhaps I can bring you a torch or find at the fire some guidance."

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِىَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Falammaaa ataahaa noodiya yaa Moosaa
ayahs.translation: And when he came to it, he was called, "O Moses,

ayahs.arabic: إِنِّىٓ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَٱخْلَعْ نَعْلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًۭى
ayahs.transliteration: Inneee Ana Rabbuka fakhla' na'laika innaka bilwaadil muqaddasi Tuwaa
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals. Indeed, you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa.

198.arabicText: وَأَنَا ٱخْتَرْتُكَ فَٱسْتَمِعْ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ ۝١٣ إِنَّنِىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدْنِى وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكْرِىٓ ۝١٤ إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخْفِيهَا لِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا تَسْعَىٰ ۝١٥ فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنْهَا مَن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرْدَىٰ ۝١٦ وَمَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ ۝١٧ قَالَ هِىَ عَصَاىَ أَتَوَكَّؤُا۟ عَلَيْهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِى وَلِىَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخْرَىٰ ۝١٨ قَالَ أَلْقِهَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ ۝١٩ فَأَلْقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِىَ حَيَّةٌۭ تَسْعَىٰ ۝٢٠ قَالَ خُذْهَا وَلَا تَخَفْ ۖ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۝٢١ وَٱضْمُمْ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخْرَىٰ ۝٢٢ لِنُرِيَكَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا ٱلْكُبْرَى ۝٢٣ ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ ۝٢٤
198.transliteration: Wa anakhtartuka fastami' limaa yoohaa (13) Innaneee Anal laahu laaa ilaaha illaa Ana fa'budnee wa aqimis-salaata lizikree (14) Innas Saa'ata aatiyatun akaadu ukhfeehaa litujzaa kullu nafsim bimaa tas'aa (15) Falaa yasuddannnaka 'anhaa mal laa yu'minu bihaa wattaba'a hawaahu fatardaa (16) Wa maa tilka bi yamee nika yaa Moosaa (17) Qaala hiya 'asaaya atawakka'u alaihaa wa ahushshu bihaa 'alaa ghanamee wa liya feehaa ma aaribu ukhraa (18) Qaala alqihaa yaa Moosaa (19) Fa-alqaahaa fa -izaa hiya haiyatun tas'aa (20) Qaala khuzhaa wa laa ta khaf sanu'eeduhaa seeratahal oolaa (21) Wadmum yadaka ilaa janaahika takhruj baidaaa'a min ghairi sooo'in Aayatan ukhraa (22) Linuriyaka min Aayaatinal Kubra (23) Izhab ilaa Fir'awna innahoo taghaa (24)
198.translationEn: And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed [to you]. [13] Indeed, I am Allah. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance. [14] Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives. [15] So do not let one avert you from it who does not believe in it and follows his desire, for you [then] would perish. [16] And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?" [17] He said, "It is my staff; I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep and I have therein other uses." [18] [Allah] said, "Throw it down, O Moses." [19] So he threw it down, and thereupon it was a snake, moving swiftly. [20] [Allah] said, "Seize it and fear not; We will return it to its former condition. [21] And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign, [22] That We may show you [some] of Our greater signs. [23] Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed." [24]

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَا ٱخْتَرْتُكَ فَٱسْتَمِعْ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa anakhtartuka fastami' limaa yoohaa
ayahs.translation: And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed [to you].

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّنِىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدْنِى وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكْرِىٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Innaneee Anal laahu laaa ilaaha illaa Ana fa'budnee wa aqimis-salaata lizikree
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I am Allah. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخْفِيهَا لِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا تَسْعَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Innas Saa'ata aatiyatun akaadu ukhfeehaa litujzaa kullu nafsim bimaa tas'aa
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنْهَا مَن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرْدَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Falaa yasuddannnaka 'anhaa mal laa yu'minu bihaa wattaba'a hawaahu fatardaa
ayahs.translation: So do not let one avert you from it who does not believe in it and follows his desire, for you [then] would perish.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa maa tilka bi yamee nika yaa Moosaa
ayahs.translation: And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ هِىَ عَصَاىَ أَتَوَكَّؤُا۟ عَلَيْهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِى وَلِىَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخْرَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala hiya 'asaaya atawakka'u alaihaa wa ahushshu bihaa 'alaa ghanamee wa liya feehaa ma aaribu ukhraa
ayahs.translation: He said, "It is my staff; I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep and I have therein other uses."

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ أَلْقِهَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala alqihaa yaa Moosaa
ayahs.translation: [Allah] said, "Throw it down, O Moses."

ayahs.arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِىَ حَيَّةٌۭ تَسْعَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Fa-alqaahaa fa -izaa hiya haiyatun tas'aa
ayahs.translation: So he threw it down, and thereupon it was a snake, moving swiftly.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ خُذْهَا وَلَا تَخَفْ ۖ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala khuzhaa wa laa ta khaf sanu'eeduhaa seeratahal oolaa
ayahs.translation: [Allah] said, "Seize it and fear not; We will return it to its former condition.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱضْمُمْ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخْرَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wadmum yadaka ilaa janaahika takhruj baidaaa'a min ghairi sooo'in Aayatan ukhraa
ayahs.translation: And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign,

ayahs.arabic: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا ٱلْكُبْرَى
ayahs.transliteration: Linuriyaka min Aayaatinal Kubra
ayahs.translation: That We may show you [some] of Our greater signs.

ayahs.arabic: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Izhab ilaa Fir'awna innahoo taghaa
ayahs.translation: Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed."

199.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى ۝٢٥ وَيَسِّرْ لِىٓ أَمْرِى ۝٢٦ وَٱحْلُلْ عُقْدَةًۭ مِّن لِّسَانِى ۝٢٧ يَفْقَهُوا۟ قَوْلِى ۝٢٨ وَٱجْعَل لِّى وَزِيرًۭا مِّنْ أَهْلِى ۝٢٩ هَٰرُونَ أَخِى ۝٣٠ ٱشْدُدْ بِهِۦٓ أَزْرِى ۝٣١ وَأَشْرِكْهُ فِىٓ أَمْرِى ۝٣٢ كَىْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرًۭا ۝٣٣ وَنَذْكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا ۝٣٤ إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرًۭا ۝٣٥ قَالَ قَدْ أُوتِيتَ سُؤْلَكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ ۝٣٦
199.transliteration: Qaala Rabbish rah lee sadree (25) Wa yassir leee amree (26) Wahlul 'uqdatam milli saanee (27) Yafqahoo qawlee (28) Waj'al lee wazeeram min ahlee (29) Haaroona akhee (30) Ushdud biheee azree (31) Wa ashrik hu feee amree (32) Kai nusabbihaka kaseeraa (33) Wa nazkuraka kaseeraa (34) Innaka kunta binaa baseeraa (35) Qaala qad ooteeta su'laka yaa Moosaa (36)
199.translationEn: [Moses] said, "My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance] [25] And ease for me my task [26] And untie the knot from my tongue [27] That they may understand my speech. [28] And appoint for me a minister from my family - [29] Aaron, my brother. [30] Increase through him my strength [31] And let him share my task [32] That we may exalt You much [33] And remember You much. [34] Indeed, You are of us ever Seeing." [35] [Allah] said, "You have been granted your request, O Moses. [36]

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala Rabbish rah lee sadree
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance]

ayahs.arabic: وَيَسِّرْ لِىٓ أَمْرِى
ayahs.transliteration: Wa yassir leee amree
ayahs.translation: And ease for me my task

ayahs.arabic: وَٱحْلُلْ عُقْدَةًۭ مِّن لِّسَانِى
ayahs.transliteration: Wahlul 'uqdatam milli saanee
ayahs.translation: And untie the knot from my tongue

ayahs.arabic: يَفْقَهُوا۟ قَوْلِى
ayahs.transliteration: Yafqahoo qawlee
ayahs.translation: That they may understand my speech.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱجْعَل لِّى وَزِيرًۭا مِّنْ أَهْلِى
ayahs.transliteration: Waj'al lee wazeeram min ahlee
ayahs.translation: And appoint for me a minister from my family -

ayahs.arabic: هَٰرُونَ أَخِى
ayahs.transliteration: Haaroona akhee
ayahs.translation: Aaron, my brother.

ayahs.arabic: ٱشْدُدْ بِهِۦٓ أَزْرِى
ayahs.transliteration: Ushdud biheee azree
ayahs.translation: Increase through him my strength

ayahs.arabic: وَأَشْرِكْهُ فِىٓ أَمْرِى
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ashrik hu feee amree
ayahs.translation: And let him share my task

ayahs.arabic: كَىْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Kai nusabbihaka kaseeraa
ayahs.translation: That we may exalt You much

ayahs.arabic: وَنَذْكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا
ayahs.transliteration: Wa nazkuraka kaseeraa
ayahs.translation: And remember You much.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرًۭا
ayahs.transliteration: Innaka kunta binaa baseeraa
ayahs.translation: Indeed, You are of us ever Seeing."

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ قَدْ أُوتِيتَ سُؤْلَكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala qad ooteeta su'laka yaa Moosaa
ayahs.translation: [Allah] said, "You have been granted your request, O Moses.

200.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَيْكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَىٰٓ ۝٣٧ إِذْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ ۝٣٨ أَنِ ٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ فَلْيُلْقِهِ ٱلْيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّۭ لِّى وَعَدُوٌّۭ لَّهُۥ ۚ وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةًۭ مِّنِّى وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيْنِىٓ ۝٣٩ إِذْ تَمْشِىٓ أُخْتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكْفُلُهُۥ ۖ فَرَجَعْنَٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَىْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ ۚ وَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًۭا فَنَجَّيْنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّٰكَ فُتُونًۭا ۚ فَلَبِثْتَ سِنِينَ فِىٓ أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئْتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٍۢ يَٰمُوسَىٰ ۝٤٠ وَٱصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِى ۝٤١ ٱذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَٰتِى وَلَا تَنِيَا فِى ذِكْرِى ۝٤٢ ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ ۝٤٣ فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوْلًۭا لَّيِّنًۭا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوْ يَخْشَىٰ ۝٤٤ قَالَا رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَآ أَوْ أَن يَطْغَىٰ ۝٤٥ قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآ ۖ إِنَّنِى مَعَكُمَآ أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ ۝٤٦ فَأْتِيَاهُ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبْهُمْ ۖ قَدْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِـَٔايَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۖ وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ۝٤٧ إِنَّا قَدْ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْنَآ أَنَّ ٱلْعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ ۝٤٨
200.transliteration: Wa laqad manannaa 'alaika marratan ukhraaa (37) Iz awhainaaa ilaaa ummika maa yoohaaa (38) Aniqzifeehi fit Taabooti faqzifeehi fil yammi fal yul qihil yammu bis saahili yaakhuzhu 'aduwwul lee wa 'aduwwul lah; wa alqaitu 'alaika mahabbatam minnee wa litusna'a 'alaa 'ainee (39) Iz tamsheee ukhtuka fataqoolu hal adullukum 'alaa mai yakfuluhoo faraja 'naaka ilaaa ummika kai taqarra 'ainuhaa wa laa tahzan; wa qatalta nafsan fanajjainaaka minal ghammi wa fatannaaka futoonaa; falabista sineena feee ahli Madyana summa ji'ta 'alaa qadariny yaa Moosa (40) Wastana' tuka linafsee (41) Izhab anta wa akhooka bi Aayaatee wa laa taniyaa fee zikree (42) Izhabaaa ilaa Fir'awna innahoo taghaa (43) Faqoolaa lahoo qawlal laiyinal la allahoo yatazakkkaru 'aw yakhshaa (44) Qaalaa Rabbanaaa innanaa nakhaafu ai yafruta 'alainaaa aw ai yatghaa (45) Qaala laa takhaafaaa innanee ma'akumaa asma'u wa araa (46) Faatiyaahu faqoolaaa innaa Rasoolaa Rabbika fa arsil ma'anaa Banee Israaa'eela wa laa tu'azzibhum qad ji'naaka bi Aayatim mir Rabbika wassa laamu 'alaa manit taba'al hudaa (47) Innaa qad oohiya ilainaaa annnal 'azaaba 'alaa man kaz zaba wa tawalla (48)
200.translationEn: And We had already conferred favor upon you another time, [37] When We inspired to your mother what We inspired, [38] [Saying], 'Cast him into the chest and cast it into the river, and the river will throw it onto the bank; there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.' And I bestowed upon you love from Me that you would be brought up under My eye. [39] [And We favored you] when your sister went and said, 'Shall I direct you to someone who will be responsible for him?' So We restored you to your mother that she might be content and not grieve. And you killed someone, but We saved you from retaliation and tried you with a [severe] trial. And you remained [some] years among the people of Madyan. Then you came [here] at the decreed time, O Moses. [40] And I produced you for Myself. [41] Go, you and your brother, with My signs and do not slacken in My remembrance. [42] Go, both of you, to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed. [43] And speak to him with gentle speech that perhaps he may be reminded or fear [Allah]." [44] They said, "Our Lord, indeed we are afraid that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress." [45] [Allah] said, "Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see. [46] So go to him and say, 'Indeed, we are messengers of your Lord, so send with us the Children of Israel and do not torment them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord. And peace will be upon he who follows the guidance. [47] Indeed, it has been revealed to us that the punishment will be upon whoever denies and turns away.' " [48]

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَيْكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa laqad manannaa 'alaika marratan ukhraaa
ayahs.translation: And We had already conferred favor upon you another time,

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Iz awhainaaa ilaaa ummika maa yoohaaa
ayahs.translation: When We inspired to your mother what We inspired,

ayahs.arabic: أَنِ ٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ فَلْيُلْقِهِ ٱلْيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّۭ لِّى وَعَدُوٌّۭ لَّهُۥ ۚ وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةًۭ مِّنِّى وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيْنِىٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Aniqzifeehi fit Taabooti faqzifeehi fil yammi fal yul qihil yammu bis saahili yaakhuzhu 'aduwwul lee wa 'aduwwul lah; wa alqaitu 'alaika mahabbatam minnee wa litusna'a 'alaa 'ainee
ayahs.translation: [Saying], 'Cast him into the chest and cast it into the river, and the river will throw it onto the bank; there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.' And I bestowed upon you love from Me that you would be brought up under My eye.

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ تَمْشِىٓ أُخْتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكْفُلُهُۥ ۖ فَرَجَعْنَٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَىْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ ۚ وَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًۭا فَنَجَّيْنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّٰكَ فُتُونًۭا ۚ فَلَبِثْتَ سِنِينَ فِىٓ أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئْتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٍۢ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Iz tamsheee ukhtuka fataqoolu hal adullukum 'alaa mai yakfuluhoo faraja 'naaka ilaaa ummika kai taqarra 'ainuhaa wa laa tahzan; wa qatalta nafsan fanajjainaaka minal ghammi wa fatannaaka futoonaa; falabista sineena feee ahli Madyana summa ji'ta 'alaa qadariny yaa Moosa
ayahs.translation: [And We favored you] when your sister went and said, 'Shall I direct you to someone who will be responsible for him?' So We restored you to your mother that she might be content and not grieve. And you killed someone, but We saved you from retaliation and tried you with a [severe] trial. And you remained [some] years among the people of Madyan. Then you came [here] at the decreed time, O Moses.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِى
ayahs.transliteration: Wastana' tuka linafsee
ayahs.translation: And I produced you for Myself.

ayahs.arabic: ٱذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَٰتِى وَلَا تَنِيَا فِى ذِكْرِى
ayahs.transliteration: Izhab anta wa akhooka bi Aayaatee wa laa taniyaa fee zikree
ayahs.translation: Go, you and your brother, with My signs and do not slacken in My remembrance.

ayahs.arabic: ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Izhabaaa ilaa Fir'awna innahoo taghaa
ayahs.translation: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.

ayahs.arabic: فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوْلًۭا لَّيِّنًۭا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوْ يَخْشَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Faqoolaa lahoo qawlal laiyinal la allahoo yatazakkkaru 'aw yakhshaa
ayahs.translation: And speak to him with gentle speech that perhaps he may be reminded or fear [Allah]."

ayahs.arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَآ أَوْ أَن يَطْغَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Qaalaa Rabbanaaa innanaa nakhaafu ai yafruta 'alainaaa aw ai yatghaa
ayahs.translation: They said, "Our Lord, indeed we are afraid that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress."

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآ ۖ إِنَّنِى مَعَكُمَآ أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala laa takhaafaaa innanee ma'akumaa asma'u wa araa
ayahs.translation: [Allah] said, "Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.

ayahs.arabic: فَأْتِيَاهُ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبْهُمْ ۖ قَدْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِـَٔايَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۖ وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Faatiyaahu faqoolaaa innaa Rasoolaa Rabbika fa arsil ma'anaa Banee Israaa'eela wa laa tu'azzibhum qad ji'naaka bi Aayatim mir Rabbika wassa laamu 'alaa manit taba'al hudaa
ayahs.translation: So go to him and say, 'Indeed, we are messengers of your Lord, so send with us the Children of Israel and do not torment them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord. And peace will be upon he who follows the guidance.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا قَدْ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْنَآ أَنَّ ٱلْعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa qad oohiya ilainaaa annnal 'azaaba 'alaa man kaz zaba wa tawalla
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it has been revealed to us that the punishment will be upon whoever denies and turns away.' "

201.arabicText: قَالَ فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ ۝٤٩ قَالَ رَبُّنَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَعْطَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلْقَهُۥ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ ۝٥٠ قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ ٱلْقُرُونِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۝٥١ قَالَ عِلْمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّى فِى كِتَٰبٍۢ ۖ لَّا يَضِلُّ رَبِّى وَلَا يَنسَى ۝٥٢ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًۭا وَسَلَكَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًۭا وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًۭا مِّن نَّبَاتٍۢ شَتَّىٰ ۝٥٣ كُلُوا۟ وَٱرْعَوْا۟ أَنْعَٰمَكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلنُّهَىٰ ۝٥٤ ۞ مِنْهَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ وَفِيهَا نُعِيدُكُمْ وَمِنْهَا نُخْرِجُكُمْ تَارَةً أُخْرَىٰ ۝٥٥ وَلَقَدْ أَرَيْنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبَىٰ ۝٥٦ قَالَ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتُخْرِجَنَا مِنْ أَرْضِنَا بِسِحْرِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ ۝٥٧ فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحْرٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦ فَٱجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّا نُخْلِفُهُۥ نَحْنُ وَلَآ أَنتَ مَكَانًۭا سُوًۭى ۝٥٨ قَالَ مَوْعِدُكُمْ يَوْمُ ٱلزِّينَةِ وَأَن يُحْشَرَ ٱلنَّاسُ ضُحًۭى ۝٥٩ فَتَوَلَّىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيْدَهُۥ ثُمَّ أَتَىٰ ۝٦٠
201.transliteration: Qaala famar Rabbu kumaa yaa Moosa (49) Qaala Rabbunal lazeee a'taa kulla shai'in khalqahoo summa hadaa (50) Qaala famaa baalul quroonil oolaa (51) Qaala 'ilmuhaa 'inda Rabee fee kitaab, laa yadillu Rabbee wa laa yansaa (52) Allazee ja'ala lakumul arda mahdanw wa salaka lakum feehaa subulanw wa anzala minas samaaa'i maaa'an fa akhrajnaa biheee azwaajam min nabaatin shatta (53) Kuloo war'aw an'aamakum; inna fee zaalika la Aayaatil li ulin nuhaa (54) Minhaa khalaqnaakum wa feehaa nu'eedukum wa minhaa nukhrijukum taaratan ukhraa (55) Wa laqad arainaahu Aayaatinaa kullahaa fakaz zaba wa abaa (56) Qaala aji'tanaa litukhri janaa min ardinaa bisihrika yaa Moosa (57) Falanaatiyannaka bisihrim mislihee faj'al bainanaa wa bainaka maw'idal laa nukhlifuhoo nahnu wa laaa anta makaanan suwaa (58) Qaala maw'idukum yawmuz zeenati wa ai yuhsharan naasu duhaa (59) Fatawallaa Fir'awnu fajjama'a kaidahoo summa ataa (60)
201.translationEn: [Pharaoh] said, "So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses?" [49] He said, "Our Lord is He who gave each thing its form and then guided [it]." [50] [Pharaoh] said, "Then what is the case of the former generations?" [51] [Moses] said, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. My Lord neither errs nor forgets." [52] [It is He] who has made for you the earth as a bed [spread out] and inserted therein for you roadways and sent down from the sky, rain and produced thereby categories of various plants. [53] Eat [therefrom] and pasture your livestock. Indeed, in that are signs for those of intelligence. [54] From the earth We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will extract you another time. [55] And We certainly showed Pharaoh Our signs - all of them - but he denied and refused. [56] He said, "Have you come to us to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses? [57] Then we will surely bring you magic like it, so make between us and you an appointment, which we will not fail to keep and neither will you, in a place assigned." [58] [Moses] said, "Your appointment is on the day of the festival when the people assemble at mid-morning." [59] So Pharaoh went away, put together his plan, and then came [to Moses]. [60]

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala famar Rabbu kumaa yaa Moosa
ayahs.translation: [Pharaoh] said, "So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّنَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَعْطَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلْقَهُۥ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala Rabbunal lazeee a'taa kulla shai'in khalqahoo summa hadaa
ayahs.translation: He said, "Our Lord is He who gave each thing its form and then guided [it]."

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ ٱلْقُرُونِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala famaa baalul quroonil oolaa
ayahs.translation: [Pharaoh] said, "Then what is the case of the former generations?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ عِلْمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّى فِى كِتَٰبٍۢ ۖ لَّا يَضِلُّ رَبِّى وَلَا يَنسَى
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala 'ilmuhaa 'inda Rabee fee kitaab, laa yadillu Rabbee wa laa yansaa
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. My Lord neither errs nor forgets."

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًۭا وَسَلَكَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًۭا وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًۭا مِّن نَّبَاتٍۢ شَتَّىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Allazee ja'ala lakumul arda mahdanw wa salaka lakum feehaa subulanw wa anzala minas samaaa'i maaa'an fa akhrajnaa biheee azwaajam min nabaatin shatta
ayahs.translation: [It is He] who has made for you the earth as a bed [spread out] and inserted therein for you roadways and sent down from the sky, rain and produced thereby categories of various plants.

ayahs.arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱرْعَوْا۟ أَنْعَٰمَكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلنُّهَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Kuloo war'aw an'aamakum; inna fee zaalika la Aayaatil li ulin nuhaa
ayahs.translation: Eat [therefrom] and pasture your livestock. Indeed, in that are signs for those of intelligence.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ مِنْهَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ وَفِيهَا نُعِيدُكُمْ وَمِنْهَا نُخْرِجُكُمْ تَارَةً أُخْرَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Minhaa khalaqnaakum wa feehaa nu'eedukum wa minhaa nukhrijukum taaratan ukhraa
ayahs.translation: From the earth We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will extract you another time.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرَيْنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa laqad arainaahu Aayaatinaa kullahaa fakaz zaba wa abaa
ayahs.translation: And We certainly showed Pharaoh Our signs - all of them - but he denied and refused.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتُخْرِجَنَا مِنْ أَرْضِنَا بِسِحْرِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala aji'tanaa litukhri janaa min ardinaa bisihrika yaa Moosa
ayahs.translation: He said, "Have you come to us to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses?

ayahs.arabic: فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحْرٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦ فَٱجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّا نُخْلِفُهُۥ نَحْنُ وَلَآ أَنتَ مَكَانًۭا سُوًۭى
ayahs.transliteration: Falanaatiyannaka bisihrim mislihee faj'al bainanaa wa bainaka maw'idal laa nukhlifuhoo nahnu wa laaa anta makaanan suwaa
ayahs.translation: Then we will surely bring you magic like it, so make between us and you an appointment, which we will not fail to keep and neither will you, in a place assigned."

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ مَوْعِدُكُمْ يَوْمُ ٱلزِّينَةِ وَأَن يُحْشَرَ ٱلنَّاسُ ضُحًۭى
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala maw'idukum yawmuz zeenati wa ai yuhsharan naasu duhaa
ayahs.translation: [Moses] said, "Your appointment is on the day of the festival when the people assemble at mid-morning."

ayahs.arabic: فَتَوَلَّىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيْدَهُۥ ثُمَّ أَتَىٰ
ayahs.transliteration: Fatawallaa Fir'awnu fajjama'a kaidahoo summa ataa
ayahs.translation: So Pharaoh went away, put together his plan, and then came [to Moses].

202.arabicText: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ وَيْلَكُمْ لَا تَفْتَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا فَيُسْحِتَكُم بِعَذَابٍۢ ۖ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ ۝٦١ فَتَنَٰزَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَىٰ ۝٦٢ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَٰنِ لَسَٰحِرَٰنِ يُرِيدَانِ أَن يُخْرِجَاكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِمَا وَيَذْهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ ٱلْمُثْلَىٰ ۝٦٣ فَأَجْمِعُوا۟ كَيْدَكُمْ ثُمَّ ٱئْتُوا۟ صَفًّۭا ۚ وَقَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْيَوْمَ مَنِ ٱسْتَعْلَىٰ ۝٦٤ قَالُوا۟ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِمَّآ أَن تُلْقِىَ وَإِمَّآ أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَلْقَىٰ ۝٦٥ قَالَ بَلْ أَلْقُوا۟ ۖ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمْ وَعِصِيُّهُمْ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ مِن سِحْرِهِمْ أَنَّهَا تَسْعَىٰ ۝٦٦ فَأَوْجَسَ فِى نَفْسِهِۦ خِيفَةًۭ مُّوسَىٰ ۝٦٧ قُلْنَا لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ ۝٦٨
202.transliteration: Qaala lahum Moosaa wailakum laa taftaroo 'alal laahi kaziban fa yus hitakum bi 'azaab, wa qad khaaba manif taraa (61) Fatanaaza'ooo amrahum bainahum wa asarrun najwaa (62) Qaalooo in haaazaani lasaahiraani yureedaani ai yukhrijaakum min ardikum bisihrihimaa wa yazhabaa bitareeqatikumul muslaa (63) Fa ajmi'oo kaidakum summma'too saffaa; wa qad aflahal yawma manis ta'laa (64) Qaaloo yaa Moosaaa immaaa an tulqiya wa immaaa an nakoona awala man alqaa (65) Qaala bal alqoo fa izaa hibaaluhum wa 'isiyyuhum yuhaiyalu ilaihi min sihrihim annahaa tas'aa (66) Fa awjasa fee nafsihee kheefatam Moosa (67) Qulnaa laa takhaf innaka antal a'laa (68)
202.translationEn: Moses said to the magicians summoned by Pharaoh, "Woe to you! Do not invent a lie against Allah or He will exterminate you with a punishment; and he has failed who invents [such falsehood]." [61] So they disputed over their affair among themselves and concealed their private conversation. [62] They said, "Indeed, these are two magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic and do away with your most exemplary way. [63] So resolve upon your plan and then come [forward] in line. And he has succeeded today who overcomes." [64] They said, "O Moses, either you throw or we will be the first to throw." [65] He said, "Rather, you throw." And suddenly their ropes and staffs seemed to him from their magic that they were moving [like snakes]. [66] And he sensed within himself apprehension, did Moses. [67] Allah said, "Fear not. Indeed, it is you who are superior. [68]

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ وَيْلَكُمْ لَا تَفْتَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا فَيُسْحِتَكُم بِعَذَابٍۢ ۖ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ
